brief.zh: 用前缀和分部求和，把相邻复指数的差界成 2π|θ|。
brief.en: Apply summation by parts to the prefix errors. Bound consecutive phase differences by 2π|θ|.

gaps.statement: ∀ (P : Finset ℕ) (A : ℕ), (∀ p ∈ P, Nat.Prime p) → ∃ n : ℕ, A < n ∧ Even n ∧ ∀ p ∈ P, p < n ∧ ¬ Nat.Prime (n-p)

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 小偶数覆盖 · FR-7026 · 固定候选素数表存在任意大的遗漏
plain_statement.en: New route · Finite-range coverage · FR-7026 · Arbitrarily large misses for any fixed prime table

brief.zh: 为每个 p 选互异奇素数 ℓp，再用 CRT 同时使 n≡p mod ℓp，令全部 n−p 大于对应素因子。可用来判断固定表方案何处必须增加输入。
brief.en: Assign a distinct odd prime modulus to each candidate. Use CRT and take a large representative so each difference has a proper prime divisor.

gaps.statement: ∀ (n p a b : ℕ), Nat.Prime a → Nat.Prime b → 2 ≤ n-p → a*b=n-p → a ≤ b → a^2 ≤ n-p ∧ n-p ≤ b^2 ∧ p % a = n % a

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 小偶数覆盖 · FR-7027 · 半素数按最小因子交给双线性组
plain_statement.en: New route · Finite-range coverage · FR-7027 · Least-factor window for semiprime switching

brief.zh: 固定最小因子后，交给双线性组的是同一剩余类上截断的素数和。保留 a=b 的平方边界。
brief.en: After fixing the least factor, the target is a truncated prime sum in one residue class. Keep the square case a=b.

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 小偶数覆盖 · FR-7028 · 七个候选覆盖模 2310 的偶数类
plain_statement.en: New route · Finite-range coverage · FR-7028 · Seven candidates cover even residues modulo 2310

brief.zh: 逐类检查。在上一层已避开 2、3、5、7 后，再避开 11。这给出 13 粗的候选。
brief.en: Check all even residues. Excluding 11 in addition to 2, 3, 5, and 7 gives a 13-rough candidate.

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 小偶数覆盖 · FR-7029 · 十个候选覆盖模 30030 的偶数类
plain_statement.en: New route · Finite-range coverage · FR-7029 · Ten candidates cover even residues modulo 30030

brief.zh: 可用 CRT 分列复核 15015 个偶类。避开素数 13 后得到 17 粗的候选。
brief.en: Use CRT to verify all 15015 even residues. Excluding 13 gives a 17-rough candidate.

gaps.statement: ∀ n : ℕ, 4 ≤ n → Even n → (n:ℝ) < Real.exp (Real.exp (19/5)) → ∃ p : ℕ, Nat.Prime p ∧ 2 ≤ n-p ∧ (n-p).primeFactorsList.length ≤ 15

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 小偶数覆盖 · FR-7030 · 将第 75 带的因子上界降至十五
plain_statement.en: New route · Finite-range coverage · FR-7030 · Reduce the factor bound in band 75 to fifteen

brief.zh: 对 n≥200 用 17 粗候选与 exp(3.8)<16 log 17。更小偶数可以用有限素数表。
brief.en: For n≥200 use a 17-rough witness and exp(3.8)<16 log 17. Check smaller even targets with a finite prime table.

gaps.statement: ∀ n : ℕ, 4 ≤ n → Even n → (n:ℝ) < Real.exp (Real.exp 5) → ∃ p : ℕ, Nat.Prime p ∧ 2 ≤ n-p ∧ (n-p).primeFactorsList.length ≤ 52

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 小偶数覆盖 · FR-7031 · 将原型全域因子上界降至五十二
plain_statement.en: New route · Finite-range coverage · FR-7031 · Reduce the full prototype factor bound to fifty-two

brief.zh: 使用同一 17 粗候选和 exp(5)<53 log 17。
brief.en: Use the same 17-rough witness and exp(5)<53 log 17.

gaps.statement: let w := fun k : ℕ => if Nat.Prime k then Real.log (k:ℝ) else 0; let E := fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (((2*Real.pi*x:ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.I); let S := fun (n : ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ℝ) => Finset.sum (Finset.range (n+1)) (fun k => (w k:ℂ)*E ((k:ℝ)*t)); let Q := fun n : ℕ => (Nat.log 2 (n+2))^2; let arcs := fun n : ℕ => {t : ℝ | ∃ q a : ℕ, 1≤q ∧ q≤Q n ∧ a≤q ∧ Nat.Coprime a q ∧ |t-(a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ)| ≤ (Q n:ℝ)/((q:ℝ)*(n:ℝ))}; let low := fun (n k : ℕ) => if k^3≤n then w k else 0; let high := fun (n k : ℕ) => w k-low n k; let f := fun (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) => (S n w t)^2*E (-(n:ℝ)*t); let I := fun (n:ℕ) (a b:ℕ→ℝ) => intervalIntegral (fun t => (arcs n)ᶜ.indicator (fun u => S n a u*S n b u*E (-(n:ℝ)*u)) t) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume; let minor := fun n : ℕ => intervalIntegral (fun t => (arcs n)ᶜ.indicator (fun t => (S n w t)^2*E (-(n:ℝ)*t)) t) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume; let major := fun n : ℕ => intervalIntegral (fun t => (arcs n).indicator (f n) t) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume; (((∃ (c : ℝ) (N : ℕ), 0<c ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, N≤n → Even n → c*(n:ℝ) ≤ (major n).re) → (∀ e : ℝ, 0<e → ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, N≤n → Even n → -(e*(n:ℝ)) ≤ (minor n).re) → ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, N≤n → Even n → ∃ p q : ℕ, Nat.Prime p ∧ Nat.Prime q ∧ p+q=n)) → ((∃ (c : ℝ) (N : ℕ), 0<c ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, N≤n → Even n → c*(n:ℝ) ≤ (major n).re)) → (∀ n:ℕ, I n w w=I n (low n) (low n)+2*I n (low n) (high n)+I n (high n) (high n)) → (∀ e:ℝ, 0<e → ∃ N:ℕ, ∀ n:ℕ, N≤n → ‖I n (low n) (low n)‖≤e*(n:ℝ)) → (∀ e:ℝ, 0<e → ∃ N:ℕ, ∀ n:ℕ, N≤n → ‖I n (low n) (high n)‖≤e*(n:ℝ)) → (∀ e:ℝ, 0<e → ∃ N:ℕ, ∀ n:ℕ, N≤n → Even n → -(e*(n:ℝ))≤(I n (high n) (high n)).re) → ∃ N:ℕ, ∀ n:ℕ, N≤n → Even n → ∃ p q:ℕ, Nat.Prime p ∧ Nat.Prime q ∧ p+q=n

plain_statement.zh: 若主弧下界、次弧拆分、两个 o(n) 估计与高高项的单侧下界同时成立，则每个充分大的偶数都是两个素数之和。
plain_statement.en: If the major-arc floor, the minor-arc split, the two o(n) bounds and the bulk one-sided floor all hold, then every sufficiently large even number is a sum of two primes.

brief.zh: 把 arc-budget-transfer、arc-major-floor、minor-bilinear-split、small-small-saving、small-bulk-saving、bulk-signed-floor 六条已发布结论机械接起来的最后一条边。它说明唯一未决的 bulk-signed-floor 不是通往定理的一步，而是已经足够推出定理本身。同文件的 bulk_floor_of_minor 进一步证明截断与不截断互相蕴含，所以 k^3≤n 的拆分没有降低难度。
brief.en: The missing edge that composes six published statements: arc-budget-transfer, arc-major-floor, minor-bilinear-split, small-small-saving, small-bulk-saving and bulk-signed-floor. It shows that the one remaining open item, bulk-signed-floor, is not a step towards the theorem but is already strong enough to be the theorem. The companion lemma bulk_floor_of_minor proves the converse as well, so truncating at k^3 <= n did not lower the difficulty.

gaps.statement:
∀ (Q : ℕ) (δ : ℝ), 0 < Q → 0 ≤ δ →
      let A := {x : ℝ | ∃ d c : ℕ, 1 ≤ d ∧ d ≤ Q ∧ c ≤ d ∧ c.Coprime d ∧ |x-(c:ℝ)/d| ≤ δ/d}
      let D := ((Finset.Icc 1 Q) ×ˢ (Finset.Icc 1 Q)).filter (fun p => Q < p.1+p.2 ∧ p.1.Coprime p.2)
      (Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1 ⊆ A ↔ 1 ≤ δ*((Q:ℝ)+1)) ∧
      MeasureTheory.volume (Aᶜ ∩ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1) =
        ∑ p ∈ D, ENNReal.ofReal ((1-δ*((p.1:ℝ)+p.2))/((p.1:ℝ)*p.2)) ∧
      ∃ ab : ℕ × ℕ → ℕ × ℕ,
        (∀ p ∈ D, (ab p).1 ≤ p.1 ∧ (ab p).2 ≤ p.2 ∧ (ab p).2*p.1 = (ab p).1*p.2+1) ∧
        ∀ f : ℝ → ℂ, MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn f (Set.Icc 0 1) →
          (∫ x in Aᶜ ∩ Set.Icc (0:ℝ) 1, f x) =
            ∑ p ∈ D, ∫ x in Set.Ioo ((((ab p).1:ℝ)+δ)/p.1) ((((ab p).2:ℝ)-δ)/p.2), f x

plain_statement.zh: 对半径为 δ/q 的所有既约有理圆弧，精确判定何时覆盖 [0,1]，给出补集的测度，并把任意可积复函数在补集上的积分写成相邻 Farey 分数之间的无交区间积分之和。
plain_statement.en: For all reduced rational arcs of radius δ/q up to denominator Q, characterize full coverage of [0,1], compute the exact uncovered measure, and split the integral of any integrable complex function on the exterior into disjoint Farey gaps.

brief.zh: 相邻端点 a/q、b/s 满足 bq−as=1、q+s>Q。补集在该格内恰为 ((a+δ)/q,(b−δ)/s)，允许空区间。全覆盖当且仅当 δ(Q+1)≥1。令 δ=H/n 即可用于宽弧补集，保留原来的复相位；逐偶数的有符号估计仍需另证。
brief.en: Consecutive endpoints a/q and b/s satisfy bq−as=1 and q+s>Q. The uncovered portion of that cell is ((a+δ)/q,(b−δ)/s), possibly empty. Full coverage holds exactly when δ(Q+1)≥1. Taking δ=H/n gives a cellwise integral for the wide-arc exterior with its original complex phase. Pointwise signed cancellation remains open.

gaps.statement: ∀ (N Q : ℕ) [NeZero Q] (a : ℕ → ℂ), (∑ r : ZMod Q, ‖∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), a n * ZMod.stdAddChar (r * (n : ZMod Q))‖ ^ 2) ≤ (N + Q : ℝ) * ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), ‖a n‖ ^ 2

plain_statement.zh: 有限大筛法：ZMod Q 上 N+1 项指数和均方不超过 (N+Q) 倍系数能量。
plain_statement.en: Finite large sieve: the mean square of N+1 exponential sums on ZMod Q is at most (N+Q) times the coefficient energy.

brief.zh: 用 ZMod 的 Parseval 与按余类分纤维的 Cauchy–Schwarz；不依赖素数，是 Type-II 色散估计的基础。
brief.en: Use ZMod Parseval and Cauchy–Schwarz on residue-class fibers; this is prime-independent and supports Type-II dispersion estimates.

gaps.statement: (let w := fun k : ℕ => if Nat.Prime k then Real.log (k:ℝ) else 0; let E := fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (((2*Real.pi*x:ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.I); let S := fun (n : ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ℝ) => Finset.sum (Finset.range (n+1)) (fun k => (w k:ℂ)*E ((k:ℝ)*t)); let Q := fun n : ℕ => (Nat.log 2 (n+2))^2; let arcs := fun n : ℕ => {t : ℝ | ∃ q a : ℕ, 1≤q ∧ q≤Q n ∧ a≤q ∧ Nat.Coprime a q ∧ |t-(a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ)| ≤ (Q n:ℝ)/((q:ℝ)*(n:ℝ))}; let f := fun (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) => (S n w t)^2*E (-(n:ℝ)*t); let minor := fun n : ℕ => intervalIntegral (fun t => (arcs n)ᶜ.indicator (f n) t) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume; (∀ e : ℝ, 0<e → ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, N≤n → Even n → -(e*(n:ℝ)) ≤ (minor n).re)) ↔ (let w := fun k : ℕ => if Nat.Prime k then Real.log (k:ℝ) else 0; let E := fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (((2*Real.pi*x:ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.I); let S := fun (n : ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ℝ) => Finset.sum (Finset.range (n+1)) (fun k => (w k:ℂ)*E ((k:ℝ)*t)); let Q := fun n : ℕ => (Nat.log 2 (n+2))^2; let arcs := fun n : ℕ => {t : ℝ | ∃ q a : ℕ, 1≤q ∧ q≤Q n ∧ a≤q ∧ Nat.Coprime a q ∧ |t-(a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ)| ≤ (Q n:ℝ)/((q:ℝ)*(n:ℝ))}; let f := fun (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) => (S n w t)^2*E (-(n:ℝ)*t); let major := fun n : ℕ => intervalIntegral (fun t => (arcs n).indicator (f n) t) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume; let conv := fun (u v : ℕ → ℝ) (n : ℕ) => Finset.sum (Finset.range (n+1)) (fun k => u k*v (n-k)); (∀ e : ℝ, 0<e → ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, N≤n → Even n → (major n).re ≤ conv w w n + e*(n:ℝ)))

plain_statement.zh: 对每个 ε>0，所有充分大的偶数 n 满足：次弧带符号下界 `−εn ≤ Re(minor n)` 等价于 `Re(major n) ≤ conv n + εn`，其中 `conv n = Σ_{k≤n} w_k·w_{n−k}` 是素数对数权卷积（w(k)=log k 当 k 素数，否则 0）。
plain_statement.en: For every ε>0, all sufficiently large even n satisfy: the signed minor-arc lower bound `−εn ≤ Re(minor n)` is equivalent to `Re(major n) ≤ conv n + εn`, where `conv n = Σ_{k≤n} w k · w (n−k)` is the prime-log weighted convolution (w(k)=log k for prime k, else 0).

brief.zh: 对已接受的 major+minor=conv 恒等式取实部并移项，双向重写目标；这是把目标接到主弧估计与未知计数比较的接口。
brief.en: Take real parts in the accepted major+minor identity and rearrange both ways. This exposes the target as a comparison between a major-arc estimate and the unknown weighted prime-pair count.

gaps.statement: let w := fun k : ℕ => if Nat.Prime k then Real.log (k:ℝ) else 0; let E := fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (((2*Real.pi*x:ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.I); let S := fun (n : ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ℝ) => Finset.sum (Finset.range (n+1)) (fun k => (w k:ℂ)*E ((k:ℝ)*t)); let Q := fun n : ℕ => (Nat.log 2 (n+2))^2; let arcs := fun n : ℕ => {t : ℝ | ∃ q a : ℕ, 1≤q ∧ q≤Q n ∧ a≤q ∧ Nat.Coprime a q ∧ |t-(a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ)| ≤ (Q n:ℝ)/((q:ℝ)*(n:ℝ))}; let f := fun (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) => (S n w t)^2*E (-(n:ℝ)*t); let minor := fun n : ℕ => intervalIntegral (fun t => (arcs n)ᶜ.indicator (f n) t) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume; let A := fun n : ℕ => intervalIntegral (fun t => (arcs n)ᶜ.indicator (fun x => ‖S n w x‖^2) t) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume; let B := fun n : ℕ => intervalIntegral (fun t => (arcs n)ᶜ.indicator (fun x => ((S n w x)*E (-(n:ℝ)*x/2)).im^2) t) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume; (∀ e : ℝ, 0<e → ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, N≤n → Even n → -(e*(n:ℝ)) ≤ (minor n).re) ↔ (∀ e : ℝ, 0<e → ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, N≤n → Even n → 2*B n ≤ A n+e*(n:ℝ))

plain_statement.zh: 令 A(n) 为次弧上 |S|² 的积分，B(n) 为同一集合上 S(t)e(−nt/2) 的虚部平方的积分，e(x)=exp(2πix)。以下两项等价：对每个 ε>0，所有充分大的偶数 n 满足 Re(minor(n))≥−εn；对每个 ε>0，所有充分大的偶数 n 满足 2B(n)≤A(n)+εn。
plain_statement.en: Let A(n) integrate |S|² over the minor arcs and let B(n) integrate the squared imaginary part of S(t)e(−nt/2) over the same set, with e(x)=exp(2πix). The following are equivalent: for every ε>0, all sufficiently large even n satisfy Re(minor(n))≥−εn; for every ε>0, all sufficiently large even n satisfy 2B(n)≤A(n)+εn.

brief.zh: 在已登记的素数对数权和弧宽下，去掉半个傅里叶相位后有 Re(minor(n))=A(n)−2B(n)。这给逐点估计提供了一个实二次型；所需的正弦能量上界仍待证明。
brief.en: Removing half the Fourier phase gives Re(minor(n))=A(n)−2B(n) for the registered prime weights and arc widths. This gives a real quadratic form for a pointwise estimate. The required upper bound for the sine energy remains open.

gaps.statement: let cut (h : ℕ) (f : ArithmeticFunction ℝ) : ArithmeticFunction ℝ := ⟨fun k => if k ≤ h then f k else 0, (ite_eq_left (Nat.zero_le h)).trans f.map_zero⟩; let L := ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt; let m : ArithmeticFunction ℝ := ArithmeticFunction.moebius; let z : ArithmeticFunction ℝ := ArithmeticFunction.zeta; let h (n : ℕ) := Nat.sqrt (Nat.sqrt n); let a (n : ℕ) := cut (h n) m; let b (n : ℕ) := cut (h n) L; let I (n : ℕ) := a n * ArithmeticFunction.log - a n * b n * z; let J (n : ℕ) := (m-a n) * ((L-b n) * z); let w (k : ℕ) := if Nat.Prime k then Real.log (k : ℝ) else 0; let E (x : ℝ) := Complex.exp (((2 * Real.pi * x : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I); let S (n : ℕ) (u : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ℝ) := ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n+1), (u k : ℂ) * E ((k : ℝ)*t); let Q (n : ℕ) := (Nat.log 2 (n+2))^2; let A (n : ℕ) := {t : ℝ | ∃ q a : ℕ, 1≤q ∧ q≤Q n ∧ a≤q ∧ Nat.Coprime a q ∧ |t-(a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ)| ≤ (Q n:ℝ)/((q:ℝ)*(n:ℝ))}; let B (n : ℕ) (u v : ℕ → ℝ) := (intervalIntegral ((A n)ᶜ.indicator (fun t => S n u t * S n v t * E (-(n : ℝ)*t))) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume).re; let lower (F : ℕ → ℝ) := ∀ e : ℝ, 0 < e → ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N, Even n → -(e*(n:ℝ)) ≤ F n; lower (fun n => B n (I n) L) → lower (fun n => B n (J n) L) → lower (fun n => B n w w)

plain_statement.en: Two signed Vaughan coefficient estimates imply the published minor-arc saving
plain_statement.zh: 两类沃恩带符号系数估计推出已公布的次弧下界

brief.en: Use the four-term identity with fourth-root cutoffs. Bound the short term by Parseval and Cauchy–Schwarz, then replace Λ by the prime-only weight. Both signed hypotheses remain analytic obligations.
brief.zh: 采用四次方根截断分解。用帕塞瓦尔等式和柯西不等式处理短项，再换成仅支撑于素数的权重。两项带符号假设仍需解析估计。

gaps.statement: ∀ (n m : ℕ) (b : ℕ → Fin m → ℝ), ∃ s : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ k, s k = 1 ∨ s k = -1) ∧ (∑ j, (∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, s k * b k j)^2) ≤ ∑ j, ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, (b k j)^2

plain_statement.zh: 给定 n 个 m 维实向量，可为每个向量选择一个共用于所有坐标的正负号，使带符号向量和的平方欧氏范数不超过原向量平方范数之和。
plain_statement.en: For every n real vectors in m dimensions, there is one sign per vector, shared across all coordinates, such that the squared Euclidean norm of their signed sum is at most the sum of their squared norms.

brief.zh: 对每一步加入的新向量，比较正负两个候选的平方能量；由平行四边形恒等式选取能量较低者。应用时把每个反射对在有限频率采样点的实部和虚部拼接成向量。本命题仅给出有限采样总能量界，不是逐点傅里叶上界或次弧抵消。
brief.en: At each insertion, choose the sign with smaller squared energy using the parallelogram identity. For reflection pairs concatenate the real and imaginary parts at a finite grid of frequencies into each vector. This controls total sampled energy, not a pointwise Fourier supremum or minor-arc cancellation.

gaps.statement: ∀ (n m : ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (a : ℕ → Fin m → ℝ), (∀ k, 0 ≤ w k) → ∃ v : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ k, 0 ≤ v k ∧ v k ≤ 2*w k) ∧ (∀ k ≤ 2*n, v k * v (2*n-k) = 0) ∧ v n = 0 ∧ (∑ j, ((∑ k ∈ Finset.range (2*n+1), (v k-w k)*a k j) + w n*a n j)^2) ≤ ∑ j, ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, (w k*a k j-w (2*n-k)*a (2*n-k) j)^2

plain_statement.zh: 对任意非负实权 w、半长 n 和有限维实观测 a，存在权 v，使 0≤v≤2w、中央点 v(n)=0，所有 k≤2n 的反射对乘积均为零；将中央点误差单独补回后，观测误差的平方和不超过所有反射对观测差的平方和。
plain_statement.en: For every nonnegative real weight w, half-length n, and finite-dimensional real observations a, there exists a weight v with 0≤v≤2w, v(n)=0, and zero reflected products at every k≤2n. After restoring the central-point contribution, the sum of squared observation errors is bounded by the sum of squared differences of the reflected observations.

brief.zh: 用共同符号平衡控制全部观测，再将反射对的权分别乘以 1+s 和 1−s。明确中央项与全区间求和的重排。该结论针对人为构造的扰动权，不能代替真实素数权的逐点次弧估计。
brief.en: Use simultaneous sign balancing for the observations, multiply each reflected pair by 1+s and 1−s, and split the full sum with its central term explicit. This is a statement about constructed perturbations, not cancellation for the actual prime weights.

gaps.statement: let Q (n : ℕ) := (Nat.log 2 (n + 2)) ^ 2; let arcs (n : ℕ) := {t : ℝ | ∃ q a : ℕ, 1 ≤ q ∧ q ≤ Q n ∧ a ≤ q ∧ Nat.Coprime a q ∧ |t - (a : ℝ) / q| ≤ (Q n : ℝ) / ((q : ℝ) * n)}; ∀ (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ), 1 ≤ Q n → Q n ≤ n → t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 → t ∉ arcs n → ∃ q a : ℕ, Q n < q ∧ q ≤ n / Q n ∧ a ≤ q ∧ Nat.Coprime a q ∧ |t - (a : ℝ) / q| ≤ 1 / ((q : ℝ) * (((n / Q n : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1))

plain_statement.en: Each point in [0,1] outside the Goldbach major arcs has a reduced approximation a/q with Q < q ≤ H and error at most 1/(q(H+1)), where H = ⌊n/Q⌋.
plain_statement.zh: 令 H = ⌊n/Q⌋。区间 [0,1] 内的每个次弧点都有既约逼近 a/q，满足 Q < q ≤ H、0 ≤ a ≤ q，且误差至多为 1/(q(H+1))。

brief.en: Use Dirichlet’s theorem of order H. The inequality n < Q(H+1) puts any candidate with q ≤ Q inside the posted major arc of radius Q/(qn).
brief.zh: 应用 H 阶狄利克雷逼近定理。由 n < Q(H+1)，若候选分母 q ≤ Q，则该点必落入目录定义的半径为 Q/(qn) 的主弧。

gaps.statement: let E (y : ℝ) := Complex.exp (((2 * Real.pi * y : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I); let cap (H y : ℝ) := if E y = 1 then H else min H (2 / ‖1 - E y‖); ∀ (a q : ℕ) (t x H : ℝ), 1 ≤ q → Nat.Coprime a q → 0 ≤ H → |t - (a : ℝ) / q| ≤ 1 / (q : ℝ)^2 → (∑ r ∈ Finset.range q, cap H (x + (r : ℝ)*t)) ≤ 6 * (H + (q : ℝ) * Real.log (2 * q))

plain_statement.en: If |t−a/q| ≤ q⁻² with a/q reduced, the capped reciprocal-chord sum over x, x+t, …, x+(q−1)t is at most 6(H + q log(2q)), uniformly in x. A resonant term contributes H.
plain_statement.zh: 若既约分数 a/q 满足 |t−a/q| ≤ q⁻²，则在 x, x+t, …, x+(q−1)t 上的截断倒弦长之和不超过 6(H + q log(2q))，该界与 x 无关。共振项取 H。

brief.en: Associate to each sample the integer round(qx)+ar−q round(x+rt). Coprimality makes these indices distinct. Bound each term with absolute index below 3 by H. For the other indices, the sine chord inequality bounds each term by q divided by the absolute index.
brief.zh: 给第 r 项配以整数 round(qx)+ar−q round(x+rt)。互素性保证这些整数两两不同。绝对值小于 3 的项用 H 控制，其余项由正弦弦长不等式以 q 除以指标绝对值控制。

gaps.statement: let E (x : ℝ) := Complex.exp (((2 * Real.pi * x : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I); let S (n : ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ℝ) := ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n+1), (w k : ℂ) * E ((k : ℝ)*t); ∀ (n : ℕ) (u v : ℕ → ℝ) (A : Set ℝ) (U : ℝ), MeasurableSet A → 0 ≤ U → (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, t ∉ A → ‖S n u t‖ ≤ U) → ‖intervalIntegral (Aᶜ.indicator (fun t => S n u t * (S n v t)^2 * E (-(n : ℝ)*t))) (0 : ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume‖ ≤ U * ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n+1), (v k)^2

plain_statement.en: A bound U on |Sᵤ| off a measurable arc set gives a bound U∑v(k)² for the norm of the complementary ternary coefficient SᵤSᵥ².
plain_statement.zh: 若在可测弧集的补集上有 |Sᵤ| ≤ U，则 SᵤSᵥ² 在该补集上的三元系数的模不超过 U∑v(k)²。

brief.en: In the integral, the phase has norm one and |Sᵤ| costs at most U. Integrating |Sᵥ|² over the full period gives the discrete coefficient energy by Parseval.
brief.zh: 积分中的相位因子模为 1，|Sᵤ| 至多为 U。再由帕塞瓦尔恒等式，|Sᵥ|² 在整周期上的积分等于离散系数的平方和。

gaps.statement: let w := fun k : ℕ => if Nat.Prime k then Real.log (k:ℝ) else 0; let E := fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (((2*Real.pi*x:ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.I); let S := fun (n : ℕ) (u : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ℝ) => Finset.sum (Finset.range (n+1)) (fun k => (u k:ℂ)*E ((k:ℝ)*t)); let Q := fun n : ℕ => (Nat.log 2 (n+2))^2; let Q₁ := fun n : ℕ => ⌊(n:ℝ)^(1/3:ℝ)⌋₊; let H := fun n : ℕ => 256 * Q₁ n * Q n; let wideArcs := fun n : ℕ => {t : ℝ | ∃ q a : ℕ, 1≤q ∧ q≤Q₁ n ∧ a≤q ∧ Nat.Coprime a q ∧ |t-(a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ)| ≤ (H n:ℝ)/((q:ℝ)*(n:ℝ))}; let deepCoeff := fun (n m : ℕ) => intervalIntegral (fun t => (wideArcs n)ᶜ.indicator (fun u => (S n w u)^2 * E (-(m:ℝ)*u)) t) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume; let F := fun (n : ℕ) => (wideArcs n)ᶜ.indicator (fun u => (S n w u)^2); ∀ (n m H : ℕ), 0 < H → Even m → n ≤ m → m+4*(H-1) ≤ 2*n → ((∑ i ∈ Finset.range H, ∑ j ∈ Finset.range H, ‖deepCoeff n (m+2*(i+(H-1)-j))‖^2 : ℝ):ℂ) = intervalIntegral (fun u => intervalIntegral (fun v => F n u * (starRingEnd ℂ) (F n v) * E (-((m+2*(H-1):ℕ):ℝ)*(u-v)) * ((‖∑ j ∈ Finset.range H, E (2*(j:ℝ)*(u-v))‖^2:ℝ):ℂ)) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 特征与分母扩窗 · CW-8006 · 把短偶移窗内的系数能量写成 Fejér 核双积分
plain_statement.en: New route · Characters and extended arcs · CW-8006 · Express the local even-shift coefficient energy by a Fejér double integral

brief.zh: 把每个系数模方展开为双积分，先合并 i−j，再求几何和。除以 H 得三角形窗。与全区间 Bessel 预算相比，本题保留窗口中心和半整数共振。
brief.en: Expand each squared coefficient as a double integral, group i−j and evaluate the geometric sum. Division by H gives the triangular window. It retains the window center and half-integer resonances.

gaps.statement: ∀ (k : ℕ), 3 ≤ k → ∀ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (2^k), χ^2 = 1 → ∃ χ₈ : DirichletCharacter ℂ 8, ∀ a : ℕ, χ (a : ZMod (2^k)) = χ₈ (a : ZMod 8)

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 特征与分母扩窗 · CW-8003 · 将二幂塔上的实特征降到模八
plain_statement.en: New route · Characters and extended arcs · CW-8003 · Descend real characters on the dyadic tower to modulus eight

brief.zh: 证明 1 模 8 的单位在模 2^k 都是平方，再沿商群下降。这样可隔离实特征；非实特征和中心素数对相关仍待估计。
brief.en: Prove that every unit congruent to one modulo eight is a square modulo 2^k, then descend through the quotient. The complex characters and central prime correlation remain.

gaps.statement: ∀ (d n : ℕ) [NeZero d] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ d), d ∣ n → χ^2 = 1 → (∑ a : (ZMod d)ˣ, χ (a : ZMod d) * χ ((n : ZMod d) - (a : ZMod d))) = (Nat.totient d : ℂ) * χ (-1)

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 特征与分母扩窗 · CW-8001 · 计算导子整除目标时实特征对的反射项
plain_statement.en: New route · Characters and extended arcs · CW-8001 · Evaluate the reflected quadratic-character pair at multiples of the conductor

brief.zh: 在单位群上把 n−a 换成 −a，再用 χ²=1。奇特征给 −φ(d)，偶特征给正号。剩余零点和交叉项仍须估计。
brief.en: On the units n−a equals −a. Apply χ²=1 there. Odd parity gives −φ(d), even parity gives the positive sign. Other zeros and cross terms still need estimates.

gaps.statement: ∀ (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ p), χ ≠ 1 → χ^2 = 1 → ∀ t : ZMod p, t ≠ 0 → (∑ a : ZMod p, χ a * χ (t-a)) = -χ (-1)

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 特征与分母扩窗 · CW-8002 · 计算素导子与目标互素时的 Jacobi 项
plain_statement.en: New route · Characters and extended arcs · CW-8002 · Evaluate the Jacobi term when the prime conductor misses the target

brief.zh: 换元 a=t u，利用 χ(t)²=1。再用 u/(1−u) 将去掉 u=1 的和化为非平凡特征和。两种符号均保留。
brief.en: Scale by t using χ(t)²=1. On u≠1 use u/(1−u) and the complete nontrivial character sum. Retain the parity sign.

gaps.statement: let liouville := fun n : ℕ => (-1:ℤ)^n.primeFactorsList.length; Nat.Prime 97 ∧ Nat.Prime 103 ∧ Nat.Prime 67 ∧ Nat.Prime 7 ∧ Nat.Prime 19 ∧ 133 = 7*19 ∧ 97+103=200 ∧ 67+133=200 ∧ (∀ x ∈ ({97,103,67,133} : Finset ℕ), 200 ≤ 3*x ∧ 3*x ≤ 400) ∧ (∀ m : ℕ, m ∣ 30 → ∀ F : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ, F (97%m) (103%m)=F (67%m) (133%m)) ∧ liouville 97 * liouville 103 = 1 ∧ liouville 67 * liouville 133 = -1

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 特征与分母扩窗 · CW-8009 · 核验中央窗内余类相同而素因子奇偶不同的两组分解
plain_statement.en: New route · Characters and extended arcs · CW-8009 · Check two central pairs with identical residue data and different factor parity

brief.zh: 检验 200 的两组分解并把模 30 的同余降到每个因子模数。可作为有限余类测试的反例。进一步的 Theta 测试须提供额外的双变量输入。
brief.en: Check both pairs and reduce the congruences modulo 30 to each divisor of 30. This is a finite test for residue-based models. A theta model needs extra two-variable data.

gaps.statement: ∀ (u v : ℝ) (ρ : ℂ), 1 ≤ u → u ≤ v → 0 ≤ ρ.re → ρ ≠ 0 → ‖((v:ℂ)^ρ-(u:ℂ)^ρ)/ρ‖ ≤ (v:ℝ)^ρ.re * min (Real.log (v/u)) (2/‖ρ‖)

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 特征与分母扩窗 · CW-8005 · 为截断显式公式的单个零点给出双端点增量界
plain_statement.en: New route · Characters and extended arcs · CW-8005 · Bound one zero contribution across two explicit-formula endpoints

brief.zh: 沿正实轴积分 x^(ρ−1) 得对数窗界，再用两个端点得 2/|ρ| 界。可按重数求和；该估计允许实零点靠近 1。
brief.en: Integrate x^(ρ−1) on the positive ray for the logarithmic width. Bound the endpoints for 2/|ρ|. Multiplicities survive summation and real zeros near one remain possible.

gaps.statement: let E := fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (((2*Real.pi*x:ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.I); let Λ := ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt; ∀ (q n : ℕ), 0 < q → let D := fun r : ℕ => if Nat.Coprime r q then (∑ k ∈ (Finset.range (n+1)).filter (fun k => k%q=r), Λ k) - (n:ℝ)/Nat.totient q else 0; (∑ a ∈ Finset.range q, ‖∑ r ∈ Finset.range q, (D r:ℂ)*E ((a:ℝ)*r/q)‖^2) = (q:ℝ)*(∑ r ∈ Finset.range q, (D r)^2)

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 特征与分母扩窗 · CW-8004 · 把有理频率总能量精确还原为单位余类方差
plain_statement.en: New route · Characters and extended arcs · CW-8004 · Recover the unit-class variance from the rational-frequency energy

brief.zh: 对所有分子取平方均值并用加法正交。非单位类按零延拓。用于检验频率预算，3/5 水平的逐类最大误差及模数和另需输入。
brief.en: Sum over every numerator and apply additive orthogonality with zero extension on nonunits. The maximum class error and the sum over moduli at level 3/5 need additional bounds.

gaps.statement: let Q := fun n : ℕ => (Nat.log 2 (n+2))^2; let Q₁ := fun n : ℕ => ⌊(n:ℝ)^(1/3:ℝ)⌋₊; let Q₂ := fun n : ℕ => ⌊Real.sqrt (n:ℝ)/((Nat.log 2 (n+2):ℝ)^4)⌋₊; ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N, Q₁ n < Q₂ n ∧ 2*(256*Q₂ n*Q n)*Q₂ n < n

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 特征与分母扩窗 · CW-8007 · 核验扩带后的分母增长和 Farey 分离尺度
plain_statement.en: New route · Characters and extended arcs · CW-8007 · Verify growth and Farey separation at the extended cutoff

brief.zh: 两端取整后比较 n^(1/6) 与对数四次幂。分离式的比值至多 512/log₂(n+2)^6，可用分数间距逐弧积分。
brief.en: After flooring compare n^(1/6) to the fourth power of the logarithm. The separation ratio is at most 512/log₂(n+2)^6, which permits termwise arc integration.

gaps.statement: let w := fun k : ℕ => if Nat.Prime k then Real.log (k:ℝ) else 0; let E := fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (((2*Real.pi*x:ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.I); let S := fun (n : ℕ) (u : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ℝ) => Finset.sum (Finset.range (n+1)) (fun k => (u k:ℂ)*E ((k:ℝ)*t)); let Q := fun n : ℕ => (Nat.log 2 (n+2))^2; let f := fun (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) => (S n w t)^2*E (-(n:ℝ)*t); let Q₁ := fun n : ℕ => ⌊(n:ℝ)^(1/3:ℝ)⌋₊; let H := fun n : ℕ => 256 * Q₁ n * Q n; let wideArcs := fun n : ℕ => {t : ℝ | ∃ q a : ℕ, 1≤q ∧ q≤Q₁ n ∧ a≤q ∧ Nat.Coprime a q ∧ |t-(a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ)| ≤ (H n:ℝ)/((q:ℝ)*(n:ℝ))}; let Q₂ := fun n : ℕ => ⌊Real.sqrt (n : ℝ) / ((Nat.log 2 (n + 2) : ℝ) ^ 4)⌋₊; let sqrtArcs := fun n : ℕ => {t : ℝ | ∃ q a : ℕ, 1 ≤ q ∧ q ≤ Q₂ n ∧ a ≤ q ∧ Nat.Coprime a q ∧ |t - (a : ℝ) / (q : ℝ)| ≤ ((256 * Q₂ n * Q n : ℕ) : ℝ) / ((q : ℝ) * (n : ℝ))}; ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → Q₁ n ≤ Q₂ n → let old := {t : ℝ | ∃ q a : ℕ, 1 ≤ q ∧ q ≤ Q₁ n ∧ a ≤ q ∧ Nat.Coprime a q ∧ |t-(a:ℝ)/q| ≤ ((256*Q₂ n*Q n:ℕ):ℝ)/((q:ℝ)*n)}; let J := fun A : Set ℝ => intervalIntegral (fun t => A.indicator (f n) t) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume; J ((wideArcs n)ᶜ) = J (old \ wideArcs n) + J (sqrtArcs n \ old) + J ((sqrtArcs n)ᶜ)

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 特征与分母扩窗 · CW-8008 · 把原深弧系数分成旧分母外环、新增区域和外侧余项
plain_statement.en: New route · Characters and extended arcs · CW-8008 · Split the old deep coefficient into old annuli, new area and the exterior

brief.zh: 使用 W⊆old⊆U 的可测嵌套和相同 f。新分母只计 old 外的区域。父题只含前两项，第三项仍进入原深弧。
brief.en: Use the nested measurable masks W⊆old⊆U with the same f. Count new centers only outside old. The parent controls the first two terms. The exterior remains in the original deep coefficient.

gaps.statement: ¬ (let w := fun k : ℕ => if Nat.Prime k then Real.log (k:ℝ) else 0; let E := fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (((2*Real.pi*x:ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.I); let S := fun (n : ℕ) (u : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ℝ) => Finset.sum (Finset.range (n+1)) (fun k => (u k:ℂ)*E ((k:ℝ)*t)); let Q := fun n : ℕ => (Nat.log 2 (n+2))^2; let Q₁ := fun n : ℕ => ⌊(n:ℝ)^(1/3:ℝ)⌋₊; let H := fun n : ℕ => 256 * Q₁ n * Q n; let wideArcs := fun n : ℕ => {t : ℝ | ∃ q a : ℕ, 1≤q ∧ q≤Q₁ n ∧ a≤q ∧ Nat.Coprime a q ∧ |t-(a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ)| ≤ (H n:ℝ)/((q:ℝ)*(n:ℝ))}; ∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, N ≤ n → intervalIntegral (fun t => (wideArcs n)ᶜ.indicator (fun u => ‖S n w u‖ ^ 4) t) (0 : ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume ≤ (n : ℝ) ^ (2 + η))

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 深次弧四次矩反驳 · MR-8001 · 反驳已撤下的深次弧四次矩上界
plain_statement.en: New route · Deep fourth-moment refutation · MR-8001 · Refute the retired deep-arc fourth-moment bound

brief.zh: 取 η=1/6，在立方根截断刚外侧选择平方自由分母。对全部既约分子求和，用 Ramanujan 和、Farey 分离及 Hölder 给出任意大尺度的反例。提交整个冻结声明的否定。
brief.en: Take η=1/6 and squarefree denominators just beyond the cube-root cutoff. Sum over reduced numerators, use Ramanujan sums, Farey separation and Hölder, and obtain counterexamples at arbitrarily large cutoffs.

gaps.statement: let E (x : ℝ) := Complex.exp (((2 * Real.pi * x : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I); let Q (n : ℕ) := (Nat.log 2 (n + 2)) ^ 2; let numerators (q : ℕ) := (Finset.range (q + 1)).filter (fun a => Nat.Coprime a q); let center (q a : ℕ) := (a : ℝ) / q; let width (n q : ℕ) := (Q n : ℝ) / ((q : ℝ) * n); let K (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) := ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), E ((k : ℝ) * t); let unitMean (q a : ℕ) := (∑ b ∈ (Finset.range q).filter (fun b => Nat.Coprime b q), E ((b : ℝ) * center q a)) / (q.totient : ℂ); let finiteFourier (q a : ℕ) (v : ℕ → ℝ) := ∑ b ∈ Finset.range q, (v b : ℂ) * E ((b : ℝ) * center q a); let secondary (d : ℕ) (c : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (ψ : ℕ → ℝ) (m q b : ℕ) := if d ∣ q then c q b * ψ m / q.totient else 0; let profileSize (n d : ℕ) (c : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (ψ : ℕ → ℝ) (q a : ℕ) := (Finset.range (n + 2)).sup' ⟨0, Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.zero_lt_succ (n + 1))⟩ (fun m => ‖finiteFourier q a (secondary d c ψ m q)‖); let amplified (n : ℕ) (D β : ℝ) := D * (1 + 2 * Real.pi * n * |β|); let prefixCost (n q a : ℕ) (D β : ℝ) := amplified n D β * (2 * ‖unitMean q a * K n β‖ + amplified n D β); let leftEnd (n q a : ℕ) := max (center q a - width n q) 0 - center q a; let rightEnd (n q a : ℕ) := min (center q a + width n q) 1 - center q a; let exceptionalBudget (n d : ℕ) (D : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) := ∑ q ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 (Q n)).filter (fun q => d ∣ q), ∑ a ∈ numerators q, intervalIntegral (prefixCost n q a (D q a)) (leftEnd n q a) (rightEnd n q a) MeasureTheory.volume; ∀ Q₀ : ℕ, ∃ (d n : ℕ) (c : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (β : ℝ), Nat.Prime d ∧ Q₀ ≤ d ∧ d ≤ Q n ∧ 100000000000 < n ∧ Even n ∧ 0 < β ∧ β < 1 ∧ (∀ m : ℕ, m ≤ n + 1 → |(m : ℝ) ^ β| ≤ m) ∧ (∀ q ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (Q n), d ∣ q → ∀ a ∈ numerators q, ‖finiteFourier q a (c q)‖ ≤ Real.sqrt (d : ℝ)) ∧ (n : ℝ) / 288 < exceptionalBudget n d (profileSize n d c (fun m => (m : ℝ) ^ β))

plain_statement.en: Above every proposed conductor cutoff there is a prime d and an even n > 10¹¹ for which every reduced-numerator Fourier norm obeys the √d cap and the power profile obeys its envelope, yet the exceptional arc budget exceeds n/288.
plain_statement.zh: 对每个给定的导子下限，存在素数导子 d 和偶数 n > 10¹¹，使每个既约分子对应的傅里叶范数均不超过 √d，幂函数也满足包络界，而例外弧预算仍大于 n/288。

brief.en: Choose a sufficiently large prime conductor and construct the profile from its quadratic character. The exact Gauss norm and the integrated prefix costs give a lower bound for the exceptional budget.
brief.zh: 选取充分大的素数导子，用二次特征构造剖面，由精确的高斯和范数与前缀代价的积分给出例外预算的下界。

gaps.statement: let E (x : ℝ) := Complex.exp (((2 * Real.pi * x : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I); ∀ p a : ℕ, Nat.Prime p → 2 < p → Nat.Coprime a p → ‖∑ b ∈ Finset.range p, (jacobiSym (b : ℤ) p : ℂ) * E ((b : ℝ) * ((a : ℝ) / p))‖ = Real.sqrt (p : ℝ)

plain_statement.en: For every odd prime p and every natural a coprime to p, the complex Fourier sum of the Jacobi symbol at frequency a has norm exactly √p.
plain_statement.zh: 对每个奇素数 p 和每个与 p 互素的自然数 a，雅可比符号在频率 a 的复傅里叶和的范数恰为 √p。

brief.en: Identify the phase with the standard additive character on ℤ/pℤ. Twisting by the unit a preserves the Gauss norm, and the quadratic Gauss sum identity gives √p.
brief.zh: 将相位识别为模 p 剩余类环的标准加法特征。单位元 a 的扭转保持高斯和范数，再由二次高斯和恒等式得到 √p。

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · K01 · 分类保持固定和的整数幺模矩阵在纤维上的作用
plain_statement.en: New route · K01 · Classify the slopes of sum-preserving unimodular matrices on a fixed fiber

brief.zh: 分类保持固定和的整数幺模矩阵在纤维上的作用
brief.en: Classify the slopes of sum-preserving unimodular matrices on a fixed fiber

gaps.statement: let bad := fun n : ℕ => n%6=4 ∧ ¬ ∃ p q : ℕ, Nat.Prime p ∧ Nat.Prime q ∧ p+q=n ∧ (p+2).primeFactorsList.length ≤ 2 ∧ (q+2).primeFactorsList.length ≤ 2 ∧ (p-q)^2 ≤ n ∧ (q-p)^2 ≤ n; ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ δ < 1 ∧ ∃ X₀ : ℕ, ∀ X : ℕ, X₀ ≤ X → ((@Finset.filter ℕ bad (Classical.decPred bad) (Finset.Icc 4 X)).card : ℝ) ≤ (X : ℝ)^(1-δ)

plain_statement.zh: 在模 6 余 4 的目标中，除 O(X^(1−δ)) 个例外，每个 n 都有一对陈素数之和表示，且两素数之差至多 √n。
plain_statement.en: Represent all but O(X^(1−δ)) targets congruent to 4 modulo 6 by two Chen primes with absolute difference at most sqrt(n).

brief.zh: 对照 Grimmelt–Teräväinen 定理 1.1，把两个筛权局部化到以 n/2 为中心、宽度仅 √n 的同一反射窗口。必须在该窗口内重新证明均值与误差估计。两个自然数截断差同时受限；忽略间距可恢复原定理的幂节省结论。
brief.en: Localize both sieve weights in the same reflected window before estimating errors. Both truncated differences are bounded, capturing absolute distance. Forgetting the gap recovers the qualitative power saving of Theorem 1.1.

gaps.statement:
∀ (m : ℕ) [NeZero m] (N : ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℂ) (s : Finset (DirichletCharacter ℂ m)),
  (∑ χ ∈ s, ‖(∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N+1), w n * star (χ (n : ZMod m))) /
      (Real.sqrt (m.totient : ℝ) : ℂ)‖^2) ≤
    (1 + (N/m : ℕ) : ℝ) * ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N+1), ‖w n‖^2

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 二进反射与 Levent GRH · DR-0015 · 按整数纤维长度控制任意特征频段的权能量
plain_statement.en: New route · Dyadic reflection and Levent GRH · DR-0015 · Bound character-band energy by the integer fiber length

brief.zh: 先在长度 N+1 的整数窗中逐同余类用 Cauchy–Schwarz，再用单位群 Parseval。显式因子 1+⌊N/m⌋ 允许细层模数超过 N。
brief.en: Apply Cauchy–Schwarz to each residue fiber of the N+1 integers, then use Parseval on the unit group. The factor 1+⌊N/m⌋ also covers a modulus above N.

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 二进反射与 Levent GRH · DR-0001 · 计算反射相关在一次二进细分中的带符号增量
plain_statement.en: New route · Dyadic reflection and Levent GRH · DR-0001 · Compute the signed increment of a reflected correlation across one dyadic refinement

brief.zh: 展开同一粗类的两个子类。目标减去代表后是否落在上半模，决定反射是否交换两个子类。该公式供 DR-0002 和 DR-0012 使用。
brief.en: Expand the two children of each coarse class. The upper-half residue of the target minus its representative determines whether reflection swaps the children. DR-0002 and DR-0012 use this formula.

gaps.statement:
∀ (N K : ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ), N < 2^K →
  let M : ℕ := 2^K
  let A := fun (d r : ℕ) => ∑ n ∈ (Finset.range (N+1)).filter (fun n => n % d = r), w n
  let C := fun k : ℕ =>
    let q : ℕ := 2^k
    let D := fun r : ℕ => A (2*q) r - A (2*q) (r+q)
    (q : ℝ) / M * ∑ r ∈ Finset.range q,
      (if (N+2*q-r)%(2*q) < q then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * D r * D ((N+q-r)%q)
  (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N+1), w n * w (N-n)) =
    (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N+1), w n)^2 / M + ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K, C k

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 二进反射与 Levent GRH · DR-0002 · 从逐层反射增量还原指定整数的卷积
plain_statement.en: New route · Dyadic reflection and Levent GRH · DR-0002 · Recover the convolution at a fixed integer from its reflected increments

brief.zh: 令 M=2^K>N。顶层上两个非零权的整数和必须等于 N，底层为总质量的平方除以 M。N 本身是二次幂时取严格更大的 M。
brief.en: Take M=2^K>N. Two surviving weights on the top level have integer sum N. The bottom level is the mass squared divided by M. The modulus is strictly larger even when N is a power of two.

gaps.statement:
∀ (k : ℕ) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (2^(k+1))), 1 ≤ k →
  (χ.IsPrimitive ↔ χ ((1 + 2^k : ℕ) : ZMod (2^(k+1))) = -1)

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 二进反射与 Levent GRH · DR-0003 · 用约化核筛出二幂模数的全部本原特征
plain_statement.en: New route · Dyadic reflection and Levent GRH · DR-0003 · Select all primitive characters at a power of two using the reduction kernel

brief.zh: 模 2^(k+1) 约化到模 2^k 的单位核恰为 1 与 1+2^k。本原条件等价于后一个元素取值 −1。最低的比较是模 4 与模 2。
brief.en: The kernel of unit reduction from 2^(k+1) to 2^k consists of 1 and 1+2^k. Primitivity means the latter evaluates to −1. The first comparison is modulus 4 with modulus 2.

gaps.statement:
∀ (N K : ℕ) (Q C : ℝ), 4 ≤ N → Even N → N < 2^K → 0 ≤ Q → 2*Q ≤ N → 0 ≤ C →
  (∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k → k < K → (2^k : ℝ) ≤ Q →
    ∀ χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (2^(k+1)), χ.IsPrimitive →
      ‖∑ n ∈ (Finset.range (N+1)).filter Nat.Prime,
        (Real.log (n : ℝ) : ℂ) * star (χ (n : ZMod (2^(k+1))))‖ ≤
          C * Real.sqrt (N : ℝ) * (Real.log (2*N : ℝ))^2) →
  let w := fun n : ℕ => if n.Prime then Real.log (n : ℝ) else 0
  let A := fun (d r : ℕ) => ∑ n ∈ (Finset.range (N+1)).filter (fun n => n%d=r), w n
  let S := (Finset.range K).filter (fun k => 1 ≤ k ∧ (2^k : ℝ) ≤ Q)
  (∑ k ∈ S,
    let q : ℕ := 2^k
    let D := fun r : ℕ => A (2*q) r - A (2*q) (r+q)
    |(q : ℝ) / ((2^K : ℕ) : ℝ) * ∑ r ∈ Finset.range q,
      (if (N+2*q-r)%(2*q) < q then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * D r * D ((N+q-r)%q)|) ≤
    4 * C^2 * Q * (Real.log (2*N : ℝ))^4 + (Real.log 2)^2

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 二进反射与 Levent GRH · DR-0017 · 用真素数扭曲和控制二进粗层的逐点总误差
plain_statement.en: New route · Dyadic reflection and Levent GRH · DR-0017 · Use the twisted prime sum to control the coarse layers at each target

brief.zh: 逐层用本原 Parseval，再按 q 的几何和求总误差。冻结前提仅需所用模数 m=2q 的扭曲界和 2Q≤N，符合 #2829 所用的模数上限。
brief.en: Use primitive Parseval on each layer and sum the geometric weights q. The declared premise uses only the twisted bounds at m=2q and 2Q≤N, which meets the modulus limit of PR #2829.

gaps.statement:
∀ (N k : ℕ), Even N → 1 ≤ k →
  let m : ℕ := 2^(k+1)
  m ∣ 2*N →
    ∀ (χ ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ m), ψ.IsPrimitive →
      (∑ x : (ZMod m)ˣ, star (χ (x : ZMod m)) * ψ ((N : ZMod m) - (x : ZMod m))) /
        (m.totient : ℂ) =
      if χ=ψ then if m ∣ N then ψ (-1) else -ψ (-1) else 0

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 二进反射与 Levent GRH · DR-0014 · 在模数整除两倍目标时计算本原特征的对角符号
plain_statement.en: New route · Dyadic reflection and Levent GRH · DR-0014 · Compute the primitive diagonal signs when the modulus divides twice the even target

brief.zh: 在奇单位上把反射写成乘 N−1。若模数整除 N，符号为 χ(−1)。否则要额外乘 −1。此项刻画二次幂目标的最顶层及其以下各层。
brief.en: On odd units, reflection is multiplication by N−1. The sign is χ(−1) when the modulus divides N and gains a factor −1 otherwise. This gives the top and lower layers at a power-of-two target.

gaps.statement:
∀ (k : ℕ), 1 ≤ k →
  let q : ℕ := 2^k
  let m : ℕ := 2^(k+1)
  ∀ f : ZMod m → ℝ,
    (∑ r ∈ (Finset.range q).filter (fun r => Odd r), (f (r : ZMod m) - f ((r+q : ℕ) : ZMod m))^2) =
      2 / (m.totient : ℝ) * ∑ χ ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (DirichletCharacter ℂ m)).filter (fun χ => χ.conductor = m),
        ‖∑ x : (ZMod m)ˣ, (f (x : ZMod m) : ℂ) * star (χ (x : ZMod m))‖^2

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 二进反射与 Levent GRH · DR-0004 · 把两子类之差的平方和转换为本原特征能量
plain_statement.en: New route · Dyadic reflection and Levent GRH · DR-0004 · Convert the squared differences of the two child classes to primitive character energy

brief.zh: 将任意实的模 2q 权 f 投影为 (f(x)−f(x+q))/2。每对奇代表只计一次，故能量系数为 2/φ(2q)。用于 DR-0012 和 DR-0017。
brief.en: Project the real weight f at modulus 2q to (f(x)−f(x+q))/2. Count each odd pair once to obtain the factor 2/φ(2q). DR-0012 and DR-0017 use this normalization.

gaps.statement:
∀ (N k : ℕ), Even N → 1 ≤ k →
  let q : ℕ := 2^k
  let m : ℕ := 2^(k+1)
  ∀ f : ZMod m → ℝ,
    let D := fun r : ℕ => f (r : ZMod m) - f ((r+q : ℕ) : ZMod m)
    let s := (Finset.univ : Finset (DirichletCharacter ℂ m)).filter (fun χ => χ.conductor = m)
    let v := fun χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ m =>
      (∑ x : (ZMod m)ˣ, (f (x : ZMod m) : ℂ) * star (χ (x : ZMod m))) /
        (Real.sqrt (m.totient : ℝ) : ℂ)
    let H := fun χ ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ m =>
      (∑ x : (ZMod m)ˣ, star (χ (x : ZMod m)) * ψ ((N : ZMod m) - (x : ZMod m))) / (m.totient : ℂ)
    (∑ r ∈ (Finset.range q).filter (fun r => Odd r),
      (if (N+2*q-r)%(2*q) < q then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * D r * D ((N+q-r)%q)) =
      2 * (∑ χ ∈ s, ∑ ψ ∈ s, star (v χ) * H χ ψ * v ψ).re

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 二进反射与 Levent GRH · DR-0012 · 用本原特征二次型精确计算奇余类的反射增量
plain_statement.en: New route · Dyadic reflection and Levent GRH · DR-0012 · Compute the odd-residue increment exactly by a primitive-character quadratic form

brief.zh: 用 f 的半差作本原投影。写成单位群正交归一基中的二次型后，两子类各贡献一次，粗类带符号的和等于二次型实部的两倍。
brief.en: Project f by taking its half-difference across the two children. In the orthonormal unit basis, the two children give the same contribution. The signed coarse sum equals twice the real part of the form.

gaps.statement:
∀ (N k : ℕ), 4 ≤ N → Even N → 1 ≤ k →
  let q : ℕ := 2^k
  let A := fun r : ℕ => ∑ n ∈ (Finset.range (N+1)).filter (fun n => n%(2*q)=r ∧ n.Prime), Real.log (n : ℝ)
  let D := fun r : ℕ => A r - A (r+q)
  (∑ r ∈ (Finset.range q).filter (fun r => Even r),
    (if (N+2*q-r)%(2*q) < q then (1 : ℝ) else -1) * D r * D ((N+q-r)%q)) =
    (if N%(2*q)=4%(2*q) then (1 : ℝ) else if N%(2*q)=(4+q)%(2*q) then -1 else 0) * (Real.log 2)^2

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 二进反射与 Levent GRH · DR-0013 · 精确分出素数 2 在偶余类上的带符号贡献
plain_statement.en: New route · Dyadic reflection and Levent GRH · DR-0013 · Compute the signed contribution of the prime 2 in the even residues

brief.zh: 在 q≥2 的二幂层按 N=4 或 4+q 模 2q 取正负号，其余目标给零。结果可跨层给出小于 (log 2)^2 的绝对预算。
brief.en: On each power-of-two layer q≥2, the sign is positive at N≡4 and negative at N≡4+q modulo 2q. The other targets give zero. Summing the absolute costs gives a budget below (log 2)^2.

gaps.statement:
∀ (N m : ℕ) [NeZero m] (C B : ℝ), 2 ≤ N → 2 ≤ m → m ≤ 2*N → 0 ≤ C → 0 ≤ B →
  let u : ℝ := (N : ℝ) + 1/2
  let zeros := fun (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ m) (T : ℝ) =>
    {ρ : ℂ | 0 < ρ.re ∧ ρ.re < 1 ∧ |ρ.im| < T ∧ DirichletCharacter.LFunction χ ρ = 0}
  let ord := fun (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ m) (ρ : ℂ) => analyticOrderNatAt (DirichletCharacter.LFunction χ) ρ
  let low := fun χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ m => ∑ᶠ ρ ∈ zeros χ 1, (ord χ ρ : ℝ) / ‖ρ‖
  let V := fun χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ m =>
    ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N+1), (ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n : ℂ) * χ⁻¹ (n : ZMod m)
  let Z := fun χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ m =>
    -(∑ᶠ ρ ∈ zeros χ⁻¹ N, (ord χ⁻¹ ρ : ℂ) * ((u : ℂ)^ρ / ρ))
  let s := (Finset.univ : Finset (DirichletCharacter ℂ m)).filter (fun χ => χ.conductor = m)
  (∀ χ ∈ s, (zeros χ⁻¹ N).Finite ∧
    ‖V χ-Z χ‖ ≤ C * (u * (Real.log ((m : ℝ)*u*N))^2 / N + Real.log ((m : ℝ)*u) + low χ⁻¹)) →
  (∀ χ ∈ s, low χ⁻¹ ≤ B * Real.log (2*m : ℝ)) →
    (∑ χ ∈ s, ‖(V χ-Z χ) / (Real.sqrt (m.totient : ℝ) : ℂ)‖^2) ≤
      (16*C*(1+B)*(Real.log (2*N : ℝ))^2)^2

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 二进反射与 Levent GRH · DR-0019 · 将半整数截断显式公式的余项转为本原振幅误差
plain_statement.en: New route · Dyadic reflection and Levent GRH · DR-0019 · Convert the half-integer explicit-formula remainders into a primitive amplitude error

brief.zh: 按重数保留严格高度窗，取 u=N+1/2 和 T=N。冻结前提分别给出每个特征的 Perron 余项及低零点和。把两项统一为欧氏误差供 DR-0018 使用，允许模数超过 N。
brief.en: Keep multiplicities and the strict height cutoff at u=N+1/2 and T=N. The premises record the Perron remainder and the low-zero sum for each character. Convert them to one Euclidean error for DR-0018, including moduli above N.

gaps.statement:
∀ (N K : ℕ) (S : Finset ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ)
    (z : (k : ℕ) → DirichletCharacter ℂ (2^(k+1)) → ℂ) (E : ℝ),
  N < 2^K → 0 ≤ E → (∀ k ∈ S, 1 ≤ k ∧ k < K) →
  let s := fun k : ℕ => (Finset.univ : Finset (DirichletCharacter ℂ (2^(k+1)))).filter (fun χ => χ.conductor = 2^(k+1))
  let v := fun (k : ℕ) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (2^(k+1))) =>
    (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N+1), (w n : ℂ) * star (χ (n : ZMod (2^(k+1))))) /
      (Real.sqrt (((2^(k+1) : ℕ).totient) : ℝ) : ℂ)
  let R := fun (k : ℕ) (a : DirichletCharacter ℂ (2^(k+1)) → ℂ) =>
    (∑ χ ∈ s k, ∑ ψ ∈ s k, star (a χ) *
      ((∑ x : (ZMod (2^(k+1)))ˣ, star (χ (x : ZMod (2^(k+1)))) * ψ ((N : ZMod (2^(k+1))) - (x : ZMod (2^(k+1))))) /
        (((2^(k+1) : ℕ).totient) : ℂ)) * a ψ).re
  (∀ k ∈ S, (∑ χ ∈ s k, ‖v k χ-z k χ‖^2) ≤ E^2) →
    |∑ k ∈ S, ((2^(k+1) : ℕ) : ℝ) / ((2^K : ℕ) : ℝ) * (R k (v k) - R k (z k))| ≤
      10 * E * Real.sqrt (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N+1), (w n)^2) + 2*E^2

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 二进反射与 Levent GRH · DR-0018 · 控制二幂层上归一化二次型的总替换误差
plain_statement.en: New route · Dyadic reflection and Levent GRH · DR-0018 · Control the total replacement error of normalized forms on dyadic layers

brief.zh: 给统一坐标向量误差 E，在任意选定的层上保留原权 m/M。两项几何和分别控制混合项和误差的平方，可接真实零点向量。
brief.en: Given one vector error E, retain m/M on any selected layers. Two geometric sums control the mixed term and the squared error. The formula can use the actual zero vector.

gaps.statement:
∀ (m : ℕ) [NeZero m] (N : ZMod m),
  let H : Matrix (DirichletCharacter ℂ m) (DirichletCharacter ℂ m) ℂ := fun χ ψ =>
    (∑ x : (ZMod m)ˣ, star (χ (x : ZMod m)) * ψ (N - (x : ZMod m))) / (m.totient : ℂ)
  H.IsHermitian ∧ ∀ (s : Finset (DirichletCharacter ℂ m)) (v : DirichletCharacter ℂ m → ℂ),
    (∑ χ ∈ s, ‖∑ ψ ∈ s, H χ ψ * v ψ‖^2) ≤ ∑ χ ∈ s, ‖v χ‖^2

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 二进反射与 Levent GRH · DR-0006 · 在任意特征子集上核对反射矩阵的自伴和范数
plain_statement.en: New route · Dyadic reflection and Levent GRH · DR-0006 · Verify the character reflection matrix is Hermitian and contractive on any character subset

brief.zh: 在单位余类上使用 φ(m) 的平方根归一化。先将特征向量零延拓，再用反射的部分置换和有限 Parseval。该范数界控制 DR-0016、DR-0018 的两种替换。
brief.en: Normalize characters by the square root of φ(m). Extend the coefficient vector by zero and use the partial permutation and finite Parseval. DR-0016 and DR-0018 use this bound for their replacements.

gaps.statement:
let H := fun (m : ℕ) [NeZero m] (N : ℕ) (χ ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ m) =>
  (∑ x : (ZMod m)ˣ, star (χ (x : ZMod m)) * ψ ((N : ZMod m) - (x : ZMod m))) / (m.totient : ℂ)
∀ (m d : ℕ) [NeZero m] [NeZero d] (N : ℕ), m.Coprime d →
  ∀ (χ ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ m) (ξ η : DirichletCharacter ℂ d),
    H (m*d) N
      (χ.changeLevel (Nat.dvd_mul_right m d) * ξ.changeLevel (Nat.dvd_mul_left d m))
      (ψ.changeLevel (Nat.dvd_mul_right m d) * η.changeLevel (Nat.dvd_mul_left d m)) =
      H m N χ ψ * H d N ξ η

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 二进反射与 Levent GRH · DR-0010 · 分解互素模数上的反射特征交叉项
plain_statement.en: New route · Dyadic reflection and Levent GRH · DR-0010 · Factor reflection cross terms across coprime moduli

brief.zh: 通过模环约化组合两侧特征。CRT 将单位与反射同时分解，欧拉函数相乘，故归一化系数也是两系数的乘积。
brief.en: Pull back the two characters by reduction. CRT splits both the units and the reflection and the totients multiply. The normalized entry is the product of the two entries.

gaps.statement:
∀ (p j k : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime], 1 ≤ j → j ≤ k →
  ∀ (h : p^j ∣ p^k) (N : ZMod (p^k)) (f : ZMod (p^k) → ℂ),
    let π := ZMod.castHom h (ZMod (p^j))
    let P := fun (g : ZMod (p^k) → ℂ) (x : ZMod (p^k)) =>
      (∑ y ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod (p^k))).filter (fun y => IsUnit y ∧ π y = π x), g y) /
        ((p : ℂ)^(k-j))
    let K := fun (g : ZMod (p^k) → ℂ) (x : ZMod (p^k)) =>
      if IsUnit x ∧ IsUnit (N-x) then g (N-x) else 0
    P (K f) = K (P f)

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 二进反射与 Levent GRH · DR-0007 · 证明素幂纤维平均与单位反射交换
plain_statement.en: New route · Dyadic reflection and Levent GRH · DR-0007 · Commute averaging over prime-power fibers with unit reflection

brief.zh: 固定 1≤j≤k。模 p^j 的约化保留单位条件，并把反射后的纤维送到反射类，纤维大小是 p^(k−j)。最低模 p 留在分解内。
brief.en: Fix 1≤j≤k. Reduction to p^j preserves the unit mask and reflection sends each fiber to the reflected class. The fiber size is p^(k−j). Keep the level modulo p as the bottom block.

gaps.statement:
∀ (p k : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime], 1 ≤ k →
  ∀ (N : ZMod (p^k)) (χ ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ (p^k)),
    max p χ.conductor ≠ max p ψ.conductor →
      (∑ x : (ZMod (p^k))ˣ, star (χ (x : ZMod (p^k))) * ψ (N - (x : ZMod (p^k)))) = 0

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 二进反射与 Levent GRH · DR-0008 · 排除不同活跃导子层之间的反射项
plain_statement.en: New route · Dyadic reflection and Levent GRH · DR-0008 · Eliminate reflection entries between distinct active conductor layers

brief.zh: 用模 p^j 的平均作正交投影，选择一个只使两特征之一通过的 j。导子 1 和 p 放在同一最低块，因此冻结结论只区分 max(p,导子)。
brief.en: Use the average modulo p^j as an orthogonal projector and choose j so exactly one character passes. Conductors 1 and p share the bottom block, so the statement distinguishes max(p,conductor).

gaps.statement:
∀ (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (t : ZMod p) (χ ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ p),
  (∑ x : (ZMod p)ˣ, star (χ (x : ZMod p)) * ψ (t - (x : ZMod p))) =
    if t = 0 then (if χ = ψ then (p.totient : ℂ) * ψ (-1) else 0)
    else star (χ t) * ψ t * jacobiSum χ⁻¹ ψ

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 二进反射与 Levent GRH · DR-0011 · 核对素模反射的 Jacobi 相位及零目标的对角项
plain_statement.en: New route · Dyadic reflection and Levent GRH · DR-0011 · Compute the Jacobi phase at a prime modulus and the diagonal at target zero

brief.zh: 非零 t 时换元 x=t·y，并保留两特征各自的相位。t=0 时用单位群正交性，实二次特征已有结论可用作检验。
brief.en: For t≠0 use x=t·y and keep the separate phases of both characters. For t=0 use orthogonality on the unit group. The existing real quadratic result supplies a check.

gaps.statement:
∀ (m : ℕ) [NeZero m] (N : ZMod m),
  let A := (Finset.univ : Finset (ZMod m)).filter (fun x => IsUnit x ∧ IsUnit (N-x))
  let F := A.filter (fun x => N-x=x)
  let K : Matrix (ZMod m) (ZMod m) ℂ := fun x y => if x ∈ A ∧ y=N-x then 1 else 0
  (K*K = Matrix.diagonal (fun x => if x ∈ A then (1 : ℂ) else 0)) ∧
    2 * Module.finrank ℂ (Module.End.eigenspace K.mulVecLin 1) = A.card+F.card ∧
    2 * Module.finrank ℂ (Module.End.eigenspace K.mulVecLin (-1)) = A.card-F.card

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 二进反射与 Levent GRH · DR-0005 · 计算单位反射矩阵的平方及其正负空间维数
plain_statement.en: New route · Dyadic reflection and Levent GRH · DR-0005 · Compute the square and the two signed dimensions of the unit reflection matrix

brief.zh: 在完整剩余系上以零填充，仅保留 x 与 N−x 都为单位的坐标。每个二循环贡献一个正方向和一个负方向，每个不动点贡献一个正方向。
brief.en: Use the whole residue ring with zeros outside the retained coordinates where both x and N−x are units. Each transposition contributes one direction of each sign and each fixed point contributes one positive direction.

gaps.statement:
∀ (m : ℕ) [NeZero m] (N : ℕ) (s : Finset (DirichletCharacter ℂ m)), 2 ≤ N →
  let w := fun n : ℕ => if n.Prime then Real.log (n : ℝ) else 0
  let v := fun (a : ℕ → ℝ) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ m) =>
    (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N+1), (a n : ℂ) * star (χ (n : ZMod m))) / (Real.sqrt (m.totient : ℝ) : ℂ)
  let H := fun χ ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ m =>
    (∑ x : (ZMod m)ˣ, star (χ (x : ZMod m)) * ψ ((N : ZMod m) - (x : ZMod m))) / (m.totient : ℂ)
  let R := fun z : DirichletCharacter ℂ m → ℂ => (∑ χ ∈ s, ∑ ψ ∈ s, star (z χ) * H χ ψ * z ψ).re
  |R (v ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt) - R (v w)| ≤
    2 * (1 + (N/m : ℕ) : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (((N+1) * (Nat.sqrt N+1) * (Nat.log 2 N+1) : ℕ) : ℝ) *
      (Real.log (N : ℝ))^2

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 二进反射与 Levent GRH · DR-0016 · 估计反射二次型内替换真素数权的素数幂误差
plain_statement.en: New route · Dyadic reflection and Levent GRH · DR-0016 · Bound prime-power replacement inside the reflected quadratic form

brief.zh: 将差写成两个混合项。用窗口纤维界、反射压缩界和已收录的真幂计数给出可跨二幂层相加的显式误差。
brief.en: Write the difference as two mixed terms. Use the window fiber bound, the contraction and the recorded proper-power count to obtain an explicit cost that can be summed over dyadic layers.

gaps.statement:
∀ (m : ℕ) [NeZero m] (N : ℕ) (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ m),
  let d := m / Nat.gcd m N
  let R := fun ψ : DirichletCharacter ℂ m =>
    ∑ x : (ZMod m)ˣ, star (χ (x : ZMod m)) * ψ ((N : ZMod m) - (x : ZMod m))
  (∀ ψ, R ψ ≠ 0 → (χ⁻¹ * ψ).conductor ∣ d) ∧
    ((Finset.univ : Finset (DirichletCharacter ℂ m)).filter (fun ψ => R ψ ≠ 0)).card ≤ d.totient

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 二进反射与 Levent GRH · DR-0009 · 限制非零反射系数的导子并界定每行支撑
plain_statement.en: New route · Dyadic reflection and Levent GRH · DR-0009 · Restrict the conductor of nonzero reflection entries and bound the row support

brief.zh: 对稳定元 b 满足 (b−1)N=0 的单位作换元。它们构成约化到 m/gcd(m,N) 的核。用诱导特征的唯一性数每行，包含商模 1。
brief.en: Change variables by units b with (b−1)N=0. These are the kernel of reduction to m/gcd(m,N). Count induced characters by uniqueness, including quotient modulus 1.

plain_statement.en: Every n ≥ 1,000,000 satisfies the strict disjointness criterion for the catalogue cutoff Q = ⌊log₂(n+2)⌋².
plain_statement.zh: 对于目录中的截断 Q = ⌊log₂(n+2)⌋²，每个 n ≥ 1,000,000 都满足弧不相交所需的严格不等式。

brief.en: For k ≥ 19, prove 2k⁴ + 3 ≤ 2ᵏ by induction. At k = ⌊log₂(n+2)⌋, the extra three units give the strict bound 2k⁴ < n.
brief.zh: 用归纳法证明 k ≥ 19 时有 2k⁴ + 3 ≤ 2ᵏ。取 k = ⌊log₂(n+2)⌋，预留的 3 保证严格不等式 2k⁴ < n。

gaps.statement: let w (k : ℕ) := if Nat.Prime k then Real.log (k : ℝ) else 0; let E (x : ℝ) := Complex.exp (((2 * Real.pi * x : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I); let S (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) := ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n+1), (w k : ℂ) * E ((k : ℝ)*t); let Q (n : ℕ) := (Nat.log 2 (n+2))^2; let arcs (n : ℕ) := {t : ℝ | ∃ q a : ℕ, 1≤q ∧ q≤Q n ∧ a≤q ∧ Nat.Coprime a q ∧ |t-(a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ)| ≤ (Q n:ℝ)/((q:ℝ)*(n:ℝ))}; let f (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) := (S n t)^2 * E (-(n:ℝ)*t); let major (n : ℕ) := intervalIntegral ((arcs n).indicator (f n)) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume; let minor (n : ℕ) := intervalIntegral ((arcs n)ᶜ.indicator (f n)) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume; ∀ (B : ℕ) (c : ℝ), 4 ≤ B → 0 < c → (∀ n : ℕ, 4 ≤ n → n ≤ B → Even n → 0 < Finset.sum (Finset.range (n + 1)) (fun p => w p * w (n - p))) → (∀ n : ℕ, B < n → Even n → c * (n : ℝ) ≤ (major n).re) → (∀ n : ℕ, B < n → Even n → -(c / 2 * (n : ℝ)) ≤ (minor n).re) → ∀ n : ℕ, 4 ≤ n → Even n → let w : ℕ → ℝ := fun k => if Nat.Prime k then Real.log (k : ℝ) else 0; 0 < Finset.sum (Finset.range (n + 1)) (fun p => w p * w (n - p))

plain_statement.en: Finite positivity through B and signed major- and minor-arc floors above B imply positive prime-log convolution at every even n ≥ 4.
plain_statement.zh: 若已验证截至 B 的卷积正性，且在 B 以上有带符号的主弧、次弧下界，则对每个 n ≥ 4 的偶数，素数对数权卷积均为正。

brief.en: The two masked integrals recover the exact prime convolution by Fourier orthogonality. Above B their real parts sum to at least cn/2, and the finite premise includes B.
brief.zh: 由傅里叶正交性，两个带掩膜的积分相加恰好还原素数权卷积。在 B 以上二者实部之和至少为 cn/2，端点 B 则由有限范围的假设覆盖。

gaps.statement: let w (k : ℕ) := if Nat.Prime k then Real.log (k : ℝ) else 0; let E (x : ℝ) := Complex.exp (((2 * Real.pi * x : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I); let S (Y : ℕ) (t : ℝ) := ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (Y+1), (w k : ℂ) * E ((k : ℝ)*t); let D (X : ℕ) := (Finset.Ico X (2*X)).filter (fun n => 4 ≤ n ∧ Even n); let G (n : ℕ) := ∃ p q : ℕ, Nat.Prime p ∧ Nat.Prime q ∧ p + q = n; let bad (X : ℕ) := @Finset.filter ℕ (fun n => ¬ G n) (Classical.decPred _) (D X); ∀ (X : ℕ) (A : Set ℝ) (c U : ℝ), MeasurableSet A → 0 < c → 0 ≤ U → (∀ n ∈ D X, c * (X : ℝ) ≤ (intervalIntegral (A.indicator (fun t => (S (2*X) t)^2 * E (-(n : ℝ)*t))) (0 : ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume).re) → (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, t ∉ A → ‖S (2*X) t‖ ≤ U) → ((bad X).card : ℝ) * (c * (X : ℝ))^2 ≤ U^2 * ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (2*X+1), (w k)^2

plain_statement.en: In [X,2X), the number of even Goldbach exceptions from 4 onward, multiplied by (cX)², is at most U² times the prime-log squared weight sum through 2X, assuming a major-coefficient floor cX and a minor-arc supremum U.
plain_statement.zh: 在主弧系数下界为 cX、次弧指数和上界为 U 的假设下，[X,2X) 中不小于 4 的哥德巴赫例外偶数个数乘以 (cX)²，不超过 U² 乘以截至 2X 的素数对数权平方和。

brief.en: At a missing prime pair the full Fourier coefficient vanishes, so the two masked coefficients are negatives of one another. Each exception contributes at least (cX)² to the minor-arc second moment at the common cutoff 2X.
brief.zh: 若某个偶数没有素数对表示，则其完整傅里叶系数为零，主弧与次弧系数互为相反数。因此，在统一截断 2X 下，每个例外对次弧系数平方和至少贡献 (cX)²。

gaps.statement: let E (x : ℝ) := Complex.exp (((2 * Real.pi * x : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I); let S (X : ℕ) (u : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ℝ) := ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (X+1), (u k : ℂ) * E ((k : ℝ)*t); ∀ (X M : ℕ) (u : ℕ → ℝ) (A : Set ℝ), MeasurableSet A → (∑ m ∈ Finset.range M, ‖intervalIntegral (A.indicator (fun t => (S X u t)^2 * E (-(m : ℝ)*t))) (0 : ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume‖^2) ≤ intervalIntegral (A.indicator (fun t => ‖S X u t‖^4)) (0 : ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume

plain_statement.en: For the square of a trigonometric sum restricted to any measurable set A, the sum of the first M squared Fourier coefficient norms is at most the integral of |S|⁴ on A within [0,1].
plain_statement.zh: 将三角和的平方限制在任意可测集 A 上，其前 M 个傅里叶系数的模平方和不超过 |S|⁴ 在 A 与 [0,1] 交集上的积分。

brief.en: Apply interval Parseval to the square multiplied by the indicator of A. The chosen natural frequencies embed injectively into the integers, so their nonnegative terms form a finite subsum.
brief.zh: 对乘以 A 的指示函数的三角和平方应用区间帕塞瓦尔恒等式。所选自然数频率单射到整数频率中，相应的非负项构成有限子和。

gaps.statement: let E (x : ℝ) := Complex.exp (((2 * Real.pi * x : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I); let S (X : ℕ) (u : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ℝ) := ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (X+1), (u k : ℂ) * E ((k : ℝ)*t); ∀ (X M : ℕ) (u : ℕ → ℝ) (A : Set ℝ) (U : ℝ), MeasurableSet A → 0 ≤ U → (∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, t ∉ A → ‖S X u t‖ ≤ U) → (∑ m ∈ Finset.range M, ‖intervalIntegral (Aᶜ.indicator (fun t => (S X u t)^2 * E (-(m : ℝ)*t))) (0 : ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume‖^2) ≤ U^2 * ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (X+1), (u k)^2

plain_statement.en: If |S| ≤ U off A in [0,1], the squared norms of the first M minor-arc Fourier coefficients of S² sum to at most U² times the squared coefficient norm of S.
plain_statement.zh: 若 [0,1] 中 A 以外的点满足 |S| ≤ U，则 S² 的前 M 个次弧系数的模平方和不超过 U² 乘以 S 的系数模平方和。

brief.en: Use the masked Bessel bound on the complement, dominate |S|⁴ there by U²|S|², and evaluate the full-period second moment exactly.
brief.zh: 在补集上应用贝塞尔不等式，再以 U²|S|² 控制 |S|⁴，最后精确计算整周期二阶矩。

gaps.statement: let bad := fun n : ℕ => 4 ≤ n ∧ Even n ∧ ¬ ∃ p q : ℕ, Nat.Prime p ∧ Nat.Prime q ∧ p+q=n; ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ X₀ : ℕ, ∀ X : ℕ, X₀ ≤ X → ((@Finset.filter ℕ bad (Classical.decPred bad) (Finset.Ioc X (2*X))).card : ℝ) ≤ ε * Real.sqrt (X : ℝ)

plain_statement.zh: 待证：在每个充分大的倍增区间 (X,2X] 中，强哥猜例外偶数的个数为 o(√X)。
plain_statement.en: Show that the number of exceptional even Goldbach targets in (X,2X] is o(√X), uniformly for all sufficiently large X.

brief.zh: 从 #3806 所述均方上界丢失符号的问题出发，只在真实例外集上估计负傅里叶系数。每个漏点有大小约 X 的主弧亏损时，例外支撑上的平方和若为 o(X^(5/2)) 即足够；主弧下界也须证明。以二进区间求和可得全局 o(√X)，推出本路线的 4/7 目标。对标 Li–Liu v1 定理 2 的和问题部分，去掉对数损失并要求任意小常数。
brief.en: Exploit the sign on the actual exceptional support. Given a uniform positive major-arc floor of order X, an o(X^(5/2)) squared deficit on those targets suffices. Prove the floor as well. Dyadic summation recovers global o(√X) and hence the four-sevenths target. Compare the sum component of Li–Liu v1, Theorem 2.

gaps.statement: let w := fun k : ℕ => if Nat.Prime k then Real.log (k:ℝ) else 0; let E := fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (((2*Real.pi*x:ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.I); let S := fun (n : ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ℝ) => Finset.sum (Finset.range (n+1)) (fun k => (w k:ℂ)*E ((k:ℝ)*t)); let Q := fun n : ℕ => (Nat.log 2 (n+2))^2; let arcs := fun n : ℕ => {t : ℝ | ∃ q a : ℕ, 1≤q ∧ q≤Q n ∧ a≤q ∧ Nat.Coprime a q ∧ |t-(a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ)| ≤ (Q n:ℝ)/((q:ℝ)*(n:ℝ))}; let f := fun (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) => (S n w t)^2*E (-(n:ℝ)*t); let major := fun n : ℕ => intervalIntegral (fun t => (arcs n).indicator (f n) t) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume; let minor := fun n : ℕ => (intervalIntegral (fun t => (arcs n)ᶜ.indicator (f n) t) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume).re; let bad := fun n : ℕ => 4 ≤ n ∧ Even n ∧ ¬ ∃ p q : ℕ, Nat.Prime p ∧ Nat.Prime q ∧ p+q=n; (∃ (c : ℝ) (N : ℕ), 0<c ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, N≤n → Even n → c*(n:ℝ) ≤ (major n).re) → (∀ e : ℝ, 0 < e → ∃ (C : ℝ) (N : ℕ), 0 < C ∧ ∀ X : ℕ, N ≤ X → (Finset.sum ((Finset.Icc X (2*X)).filter Even) (fun n => (max 0 (-minor n))^2)) ≤ C * (X:ℝ) ^ (18/7 + e)) → (∀ e : ℝ, 0 < e → ∃ (C : ℝ) (N : ℕ), 0 < C ∧ ∀ X : ℕ, N ≤ X → ((@Finset.filter ℕ bad (Classical.decPred bad) (Finset.Icc X (2*X))).card : ℝ) ≤ C * (X:ℝ) ^ (4/7 + e))

plain_statement.zh: 从主弧线性下界和次弧负部二阶矩推出二进区间例外计数。
plain_statement.en: Derive the dyadic exceptional-set count from a positive major-arc floor and negative minor-arc energy.

brief.zh: 每个例外的全积分为零，因此负贡献至少为 cX。平方计数将指数 18/7+ε 降到 4/7+ε。
brief.en: Each exception has zero total integral, so its negative minor contribution is at least cX. Dividing the squared budget by c²X² uses the energy exponent 18/7 + ε.

gaps.statement: let w := fun k : ℕ => if Nat.Prime k then Real.log (k:ℝ) else 0; let E := fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (((2*Real.pi*x:ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.I); let S := fun (n : ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ℝ) => Finset.sum (Finset.range (n+1)) (fun k => (w k:ℂ)*E ((k:ℝ)*t)); let Q := fun n : ℕ => (Nat.log 2 (n+2))^2; let arcs := fun n : ℕ => {t : ℝ | ∃ q a : ℕ, 1≤q ∧ q≤Q n ∧ a≤q ∧ Nat.Coprime a q ∧ |t-(a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ)| ≤ (Q n:ℝ)/((q:ℝ)*(n:ℝ))}; let f := fun (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) => (S n w t)^2*E (-(n:ℝ)*t); let major := fun n : ℕ => intervalIntegral (fun t => (arcs n).indicator (f n) t) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume; let minor := fun n : ℕ => (intervalIntegral (fun t => (arcs n)ᶜ.indicator (f n) t) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume).re; ∀ e : ℝ, 0 < e → ∃ (C : ℝ) (N : ℕ), 0 < C ∧ ∀ X : ℕ, N ≤ X → (Finset.sum ((Finset.Icc X (2*X)).filter Even) (fun n => (max 0 (-minor n))^2)) ≤ C * (X:ℝ) ^ (18/7 + e)

plain_statement.zh: 在固定二进区间上证明次弧负贡献的平方和为 O(X^(18/7+ε))。
plain_statement.en: Bound the squared negative minor-arc contributions on a dyadic interval by O(X^(18/7+ε)).

brief.zh: 只估计负部，允许正贡献。原主弧边界随 n 改变，不能直接对变动的掩码使用固定区间 Parseval。
brief.en: Exploit the negative-part restriction. The arc mask moves with n, so fixed-mask Parseval alone does not give the claim.

gaps.statement: let bad := fun n : ℕ => 4 ≤ n ∧ Even n ∧ ¬ ∃ p q : ℕ, Nat.Prime p ∧ Nat.Prime q ∧ p+q=n; ∀ e : ℝ, 0 < e → ∃ (C : ℝ) (N : ℕ), 0 < C ∧ ∀ X : ℕ, N ≤ X → ((@Finset.filter ℕ bad (Classical.decPred bad) (Finset.Icc 4 X)).card : ℝ) ≤ C * (X:ℝ) ^ (4/7 + e)

plain_statement.zh: 无条件证明 E(X) ≪ε X^(4/7+ε)。
plain_statement.en: Prove E(X) ≪ε X^(4/7+ε) unconditionally.

brief.zh: 对所有偶数 4≤n≤X 计数。公开基准为 Pintz–Althöfer v1 的 7/12；本题证明 4/7，节省 1/84，且不假设统一零点自由半平面。另一路径是直接控制例外集。
brief.en: Count all even integers in [4,X] that are not sums of two primes. Save 1/84 in the exponent against Pintz–Althöfer v1, with no zero-free hypothesis. Direct exceptional-set arguments are welcome.

gaps.statement: let good := fun n : ℕ => ∃ p q : ℕ, Nat.Prime p ∧ Odd p ∧ Nat.Prime q ∧ Odd q ∧ p + q = n; ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ x : ℝ, 2 ≤ x → let h := (Real.log x)^2; let W := Finset.Ioc ⌊x⌋₊ ⌊x + 123*h⌋₊; 1 + ⌊c*h⌋₊ ≤ (@Finset.filter ℕ good (Classical.decPred good) W).card

plain_statement.zh: 待证：存在绝对常数 c>0，对每个实数 x≥2，区间 (x,x+123(log x)²] 至少含 1+⌊c(log x)²⌋ 个不同的两奇素数和。命题不假定黎曼猜想。
plain_statement.en: Unconditionally find an absolute c>0 such that every real x≥2 has at least 1+floor(c(log x)²) distinct sums of two odd primes in (x,x+123(log x)²].

brief.zh: 按不同目标数计数，每个偶数只计一次。先对区间内素数对表示次数求一阶、二阶矩，用 Cauchy–Schwarz 控制支撑大小；两条矩估计都须对每个起点成立。另一入口是估计无素数短区间和反射后的同时空缺。对照 2026 年论文定理 1：保留相同实数起点和端点，去掉 RH，且从保证一个命中提升为正比例命中。仍可能漏掉孤立偶数，不能直接推出逐偶数表示。
brief.en: Count distinct sums, not pairs. Seek a uniform lower first moment and upper second moment for representation counts in the same window, then apply Cauchy–Schwarz to their support. Alternatively study simultaneous holes in the short prime intervals and their reflections. Theorem 1 gives one hit under RH with the same endpoints. Positive density at every starting point still permits isolated exceptions.

gaps.statement:
by
  classical
  let missed := fun (n a b : ℕ) => Nat.Coprime n (a*b) ∧ n % 2 = (a+b) % 2 ∧ ¬ ∃ p q : ℕ, Nat.Prime p ∧ Nat.Prime q ∧ a*p+b*q=n ∧ |((a*p : ℕ) : ℝ) - (n : ℝ)/2| ≤ Real.sqrt n ∧ |((b*q : ℕ) : ℝ) - (n : ℝ)/2| ≤ Real.sqrt n
  exact ∀ c E : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∃ N₀ : ℕ, ∀ N : ℕ, N₀ ≤ N → 2 ≤ N → let B := ⌊(Real.log (N : ℝ))^c⌋₊; (((Finset.Icc N (2*N)).filter (fun n => ∃ a ∈ Finset.Icc 1 B, ∃ b ∈ Finset.Icc 1 B, Nat.Coprime a b ∧ missed n a b)).card : ℝ) ≤ C*(N : ℝ)/(Real.log (N : ℝ))^E

plain_statement.zh: 在 [N,2N] 中，除去 O(N/logᴱ N) 个共同例外，对所有不超过 logᶜ N 的互素正系数 a,b 和满足局部条件的 n，找到素数 p,q，使 ap+bq=n 且两项距离 n/2 均不超过 √n。
plain_statement.en: Outside one set of O(N/logᴱ N) exceptions in [N,2N], simultaneously solve ap+bq=n for every admissible coprime pair of positive coefficients up to logᶜ N, with each summand within √n of n/2.

brief.zh: 对标 Coppola–Laporta 定理 2，保留互素、奇偶和对数幂例外集条件，将 n^(7/12+ε) 窗口缩至 √n。统一多个系数仅需在已有任意对数节省时取并集，核心难点是缩窗。可先在平方根尺度上估计移动中心的次弧均方，随后用主弧正下界控制例外数。取 a=b=1 就给出几乎所有偶数的近等哥德巴赫表示，逐偶数结论仍需排除剩余例外。
brief.en: Compare Coppola–Laporta, Theorem 2. Shrink the half-width from n^(7/12+ε) to √n with the same local restrictions and arbitrary log-power saving. A polylogarithmic union of exceptions costs only log powers; the window is the substantive gain. Seek a moving-centre minor-arc second moment and major-arc lower bound. Taking a=b=1 gives balanced representations for almost all even targets; removing the remaining exceptions is a separate step.

gaps.statement: ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N, Even n → ∃ e p q : ℕ, 1 ≤ e ∧ (2^e)^2 ≤ n ∧ Nat.Prime p ∧ Nat.Prime q ∧ n = p+q+2^e ∧ p+q ≤ 3*p ∧ 3*p ≤ 2*(p+q)

plain_statement.zh: 猜想：一次小移位可命中中心素数对
plain_statement.en: Conjecture: one small binary shift hits a central prime pair

brief.zh: 可选约 log n 个非零移位，要求其中一次在中心窗命中。先给这些移位的空窗数量做上界。全局例外个数本身无法保证指定 n 命中。
brief.en: Bound the number of missed central windows among the nonzero shifts at one n. A global exceptional count alone does not control this sparse sample.

gaps.statement: let J := fun (a b m : ℕ) => ((Finset.Icc a b).filter (fun e => Nat.Prime (m-2^e))).card; ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∃ X₀ : ℕ, ∀ X ≥ X₀, let L := Nat.log 2 X / 2; c*(X:ℝ) ≤ ∑ m ∈ Finset.Ico X (2*X), (J 1 (L/2) m:ℝ)*(J (L/2+1) L m:ℝ)

plain_statement.zh: 猜想：低、高指数带在素数平移中有正的混合质量
plain_statement.en: Conjecture: separated exponent bands have positive mixed prime-translate mass

brief.zh: 展开成素数差等于 2^f−2^e 的相关和。两个指数带互斥，消除了同一表示的对角项。需要下界，二阶矩上界不足以推出。
brief.en: Expand into prime pairs at gaps 2^f−2^e. Disjoint bands remove diagonal representations. An upper second moment alone gives no positive lower bound.

gaps.statement: let w := fun p : ℕ => if Nat.Prime p then Real.log (p:ℝ) else 0; let R := fun m : ℕ => ∑ p ∈ (Finset.range (m+1)).filter (fun p => m ≤ 3*p ∧ 3*p ≤ 2*m), w p*w (m-p); ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∃ K : ℕ, ∀ k ≥ K, let I := Finset.Icc (k/4+1) (k/2); c*(I.card:ℝ)*((2:ℝ)^k) ≤ ∑ e ∈ I, R (2^k-2^e)

plain_statement.zh: 猜想：二次幂目标的中段移位有线性平均质量
plain_statement.en: Conjecture: a middle band of binary shifts at dyadic targets has linear mean mass

brief.zh: 只取 n=2^k，考察 n^(1/4) 到 n^(1/2) 附近的移位。先分析 2^k−2^e 的局部因子，再比较正主项与平均误差。此窗完全剔除了零移位。
brief.en: At dyadic n inspect the local factors of 2^k−2^e, then compare the main term and the mean error on this band. It omits the unshifted coefficient.

gaps.statement: let G := fun m : ℕ => ((Finset.range (m+1)).filter (fun p => Nat.Prime p ∧ Nat.Prime (m-p))).card; ∃ X₀ : ℕ, ∀ X ≥ X₀, let L := Nat.log 2 X / 2; let E := (Finset.Ico X (2*X)).filter (fun n => Even n ∧ 0 < ((Finset.Icc 1 L).filter (fun e => G (n-2^e)=0)).card); E.card^5 ≤ X^4

plain_statement.zh: 推论候选：几乎所有偶目标的全部小二次幂移位均有表示
plain_statement.en: Candidate corollary: all small binary shifts work at almost every even target

brief.zh: 将每个失败的 (n,e) 映到 Goldbach 例外 n−2^e。每个例外至多被计 L 次，用 Pintz 的例外集界吸收对数损失。仍允许个别 n 失败。
brief.en: Map each failing (n,e) to an exceptional even integer. Each has at most L preimages; absorb the logarithm with the published exceptional-set bound. Individual n may fail.

gaps.statement: ∀ n L : ℕ, ((Finset.Icc 1 L).filter (fun e => n = 2^e + 2^(Nat.log 2 (n-2^e)))).card ≤ 2

plain_statement.zh: 方法反例：每个目标至多两个移位落入二次幂例外集
plain_statement.en: Obstruction: at most two binary shifts hit a dyadic exceptional set at any target

brief.zh: 取二次幂为人工例外集。一个 n 至多有一种无序双幂分拆，因此最多两个坏指数；中心仍可属于无限例外集。说明即使几乎所有移位成功也不能自动移回中心。
brief.en: Use powers of two as synthetic exceptions. Binary expansion gives at most one unordered two-power decomposition, hence at most two bad exponents. Infinitely many centers remain exceptional.

gaps.statement: let G := fun m : ℕ => ((Finset.range (m+1)).filter (fun p => Nat.Prime p ∧ Nat.Prime (m-p))).card; ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N, Even n → ∃ e : ℕ, 2 ≤ e ∧ (2^e)^2 ≤ n ∧ 0 < G (n-2^e) ∧ 0 < G (n+2-2^e)

plain_statement.zh: 猜想：相邻偶目标能共用一个非零移位
plain_statement.en: Conjecture: adjacent even targets admit a common nonzero shift

brief.zh: 将两个目标的失败指数集取并，尝试证明不能覆盖全部候选指数。两边允许各自选素数。共同指数比两个各自存在的指数更难。
brief.en: Compare the two sets of failing exponents and try to leave one uncovered. The prime pairs may differ; separate witnesses do not give a common exponent.

gaps.statement: let J := fun (a b m : ℕ) => ((Finset.Icc a b).filter (fun e => Nat.Prime (m-2^e))).card; ∃ C X₀ : ℕ, ∀ X ≥ X₀, ∀ H : ℕ, X^3 ≤ H^4 → H ≤ X → let L := Nat.log 2 X / 2; (∑ m ∈ Finset.Ico X (X+H), (J 1 L m)^2) ≤ C*H

plain_statement.zh: 估计候选：短窗口内素数加二次幂的碰撞二阶矩
plain_statement.en: Candidate estimate: short-window second moment for prime-plus-power collisions

brief.zh: 展开平方。对角线用单素数上界，非对角用间距 |2^e−2^f| 的双素数上界筛；要统一处理每个长度至少 X^(3/4) 的窗口。
brief.en: Separate the diagonal prime count from an upper-bound sieve for prime pairs at gaps |2^e−2^f|. The constant must hold in every stated short window.

gaps.statement:
by
  classical
  exact let G := fun m : ℕ => ((Finset.Icc 2 m).filter (fun p => Nat.Prime p ∧ Nat.Prime (m-p))).card; ∃ c C : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ 0 < C ∧ ∃ T : ℕ, ∀ X ≥ T, let L := Nat.log 2 X / 2; let E := (Finset.Ico X (2*X)).filter (fun n => Even n ∧ ∃ e ∈ Finset.Icc 1 L, (G (n-2^e):ℝ) < c*(X:ℝ)/(Real.log (X:ℝ))^2); (E.card:ℝ) ≤ C*(X:ℝ)^((3:ℝ)/4)

plain_statement.zh: 要求每个小二幂移位同时拥有 ≫X/log²X 个二素数表示，且例外数至多 O(X^(3/4))。
plain_statement.en: Require many Goldbach representations at every small binary shift with at most O(X^(3/4)) exceptions.

brief.zh: #4220 的合入证明只需所有移位都有一个见证，允许 X^(4/5) 个坏中心。新题既增加重数又缩小坏集；须检验近 1 零点会不会使归一化主项变小。对单一移位证明异常估计时要为随后 O(log X) 个平移的并集留余量。
brief.en: PR #4220 proves positivity at every small shift outside X^(4/5) centers. Improve both the representation floor and the exceptional exponent. Quantify the near-one-zero contribution and reserve enough saving to sum the individual exceptional sets.

gaps.statement: ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N, Even n → ∃ (p q : ℕ) (e : Fin 13 → ℕ), Nat.Prime p ∧ Nat.Prime q ∧ n = p+q+∑ j, 2^(e j+1)

plain_statement.zh: 文献基线：两个素数加恰好十三个二次幂
plain_statement.en: Literature baseline: two primes plus exactly thirteen powers of two

brief.zh: 形式化 Heath-Brown–Puchta 定理 1。保留正指数，允许重复，核对圆法计数为正如何给出有序指数见证。仍需消去全部附加项。
brief.en: Formalize Theorem 1 with positive exponents and repetitions allowed. Extract an exponent tuple from the positive circle-method count; the zero-shift target remains.

gaps.statement:
by
  classical
  let ok := fun p : ℕ => 3 < p ∧ Nat.Prime p ∧ ¬ 9 ∣ p+2 ∧ ((p+2)/(if 3 ∣ p+2 then 3 else 1)).primeFactorsList.length ≤ 2
  exact ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ X : ℕ, 2 ≤ X → (((Finset.Icc 4 X).filter (fun m => Even m ∧ ¬ ∃ p q : ℕ, ok p ∧ ok q ∧ p+q=m)).card : ℝ) ≤ C*(X : ℝ)^(1-(1/10000 : ℝ))

plain_statement.zh: 对所有偶数类同时研究两素数表示。对每个加数 p>3，仅当 p+2 含有因子 3 时剥去一个 3，禁止 9 整除，剩余部分至多有两个素因子（计重数）。要求 X 以内例外总数为 O(X^(1−1/10000))。
plain_statement.en: Cover all even classes by two primes above three. For each shifted prime p+2, strip exactly one forced factor of three when present, exclude divisibility by nine, and demand at most two remaining prime factors with multiplicity. Seek O(X^(1−1/10000)) exceptions.

brief.zh: Grimmelt–Teräväinen 定理 1.1 在 m≡4 (mod 6) 上给出某个正幂节省。对该类，p,q>3 强迫两者都 ≡2 (mod 3)，因此新命题在旧类保留原有陈素数要求，并指定一个可检验指数。在其余偶数类允许剥掉受同余强迫的 3，无需把 p+2=3r 中的 r 强行压成素数。先按模 9 固定可行的加数类，再对所得线性形式检验筛下界与例外零点损失。旧论文未给出能直接比较的数值 δ，故不宣称 1/10000 已超过其最佳指数。
brief.en: Theorem 1.1 of Grimmelt–Teräväinen gives a power saving on m≡4 mod 6. For that class both summands above three must be 2 mod 3, recovering the ordinary Chen requirements. The other classes need the forced local factor. Work in fixed classes mod nine and check that the rescaled linear forms admit a lower sieve with a compatible exceptional-character error. The original unspecified exponent is not numerically compared with 1/10000.

gaps.statement:
by
  classical
  let chen := fun p : ℕ => Nat.Prime p ∧ (p+2).primeFactorsList.length ≤ 2
  exact ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ δ < 1 ∧ ∃ T : ℕ, ∀ X : ℕ, T ≤ X → ∀ d a b : ℕ, 1 ≤ d → d.Coprime 6 → (d:ℝ) ≤ (Real.log (X:ℝ))^k → a < d → b < d → Nat.Coprime (a*(a+2)*b*(b+2)) d →
    let bad := fun n : ℕ => n%6=4 ∧ n%d=(a+b)%d ∧ ¬ ∃ p q : ℕ, chen p ∧ chen q ∧ p+q=n ∧ p%d=a ∧ q%d=b
    (((Finset.Icc X (2*X)).filter bad).card:ℝ) ≤ ((X:ℝ)/(d:ℝ))^(1-δ)

plain_statement.zh: 在对数幂范围的模数上预先指定两个陈素数的剩余类，给出一致的例外界。
plain_statement.en: Uniform exceptional bound with both Chen-prime residue classes prescribed at polylogarithmic moduli.

brief.zh: d=1 给出定理 1.1 的二倍区间版本。推广要求对每个局部相容的模数和两剩余类同时控制阈值与指数；异常目标可依赖这三个参数。#4272 在固定模数上完成了不同移位形式的归约，可借鉴其处理局部条件的方法。
brief.en: At d=1 this is a dyadic version of Theorem 1.1. Keep the onset and exponent uniform in the chosen modulus and residue pair. Compare the fixed-progression reduction #4272; its algebra alone does not give uniform analytic errors.

gaps.statement:
by
  classical
  let chen := fun p : ℕ => Nat.Prime p ∧ (p+2).primeFactorsList.length ≤ 2
  let good := fun n : ℕ => ∃ p q : ℕ, chen p ∧ chen q ∧ p+q=n
  exact ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ δ < 1 ∧ ∃ T : ℕ, ∀ X : ℕ, T ≤ X → ∀ H : ℕ, X ≤ H^2 → H ≤ X →
    (((Finset.Icc X (X+H)).filter (fun n => n%6=4 ∧ ¬good n)).card:ℝ) ≤ (H:ℝ)^(1-δ)

plain_statement.zh: 在每个长度至少 √X 的目标短窗内证明双陈素数表示的幂节省例外界。
plain_statement.en: Power-saving exceptional sets for two Chen primes in every target interval of length at least √X.

brief.zh: 原论文定理 1.1 给累计例外界，容许例外集中在短窗。本题要求对每个起点 X 成立，且损失以窗口长度 H 计算。加数仍可自由变化；这与现有要求 p、q 彼此接近的任务不同。
brief.en: Theorem 1.1 permits clustering of exceptions. Localize the exceptional-set argument in the target and preserve a saving measured in H. The summands remain unrestricted in distance.

gaps.statement:
by
  classical
  let chen := fun p : ℕ => Nat.Prime p ∧ (p+2).primeFactorsList.length ≤ 2
  let good := fun n : ℕ => ∃ p q : ℕ, chen p ∧ chen q ∧ p+q=n
  exact ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ δ < 1 ∧ ∃ T : ℕ, ∀ X : ℕ, T ≤ X → (((Finset.Icc 1 X).filter (fun t => ¬good (6*t^2+4))).card:ℝ) ≤ (X:ℝ)^(1-δ)

plain_statement.zh: 在稀疏目标 6t²+4 上证明双陈素数表示，仅允许对参数 t 有幂节省的例外。
plain_statement.en: Power-saving exceptions in the parameter for two Chen primes on quadratic targets 6t²+4.

brief.zh: 该序列落在原论文的局部允许类，但到高度 Y 仅约 √Y 项，原密度结论不能直接限制它。可把论文的异常集对偶和换成二次相位和，检查大弧下界能否覆盖该稀疏采样的次弧误差。
brief.en: These targets satisfy the mod-six condition but have square-root density in height. Replace the exceptional-set dual sum by a quadratic-phase sum; preserve the major-arc lower bound while controlling the sparse sampling error.

gaps.statement:
by
  classical
  let chen := fun p : ℕ => Nat.Prime p ∧ (p+2).primeFactorsList.length ≤ 2
  let split := fun p : ℕ => ∃ a b : ℕ, Nat.Prime a ∧ Nat.Prime b ∧ a*b=p+2 ∧ a^5 ≤ p+2 ∧ p+2 ≤ a^6
  exact ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ δ < 1 ∧ ∃ T : ℕ, ∀ X : ℕ, T ≤ X → (((Finset.Icc X (2*X)).filter (fun n => n%6=4 ∧ ¬ ∃ p q : ℕ, Nat.Prime p ∧ Nat.Prime q ∧ p+q=n ∧ split p ∧ split q)).card:ℝ) ≤ (X:ℝ)^(1-δ)

plain_statement.zh: 要求 p+2 和 q+2 各恰有两个素因子，且各有一个落在自身的 1/6 至 1/5 次幂之间。
plain_statement.en: Force a prime divisor in the exponent window [1/6,1/5] for each of two shifted semiprimes.

brief.zh: 原定理允许移位数为素数，也允许两个因子的大小不受限。本题要求两个移位数各落在明确的双线性因子区间。固定第一因子后需在余因子为素数的子族中获得下界，直接套用陈筛的上界不足以保证该区间存在表示。
brief.en: Theorem 1.1 allows prime shifts and imposes no factor-size window. Here both shifts must be semiprimes of a prescribed bilinear shape. Seek a lower bound inside the factor window, retaining primality of both complementary factors.

gaps.statement:
by
  classical
  exact ∀ P : Polynomial ℤ, P.natDegree=3 → 0<P.leadingCoeff → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0<ε → ∃ C : ℝ, 0<C ∧ ∀ N : ℕ, 2≤N → let bad := fun n : ℕ => let m := 2*P.eval (n:ℤ); ¬ ∃ p q : ℕ, Nat.Prime p ∧ Nat.Prime q ∧ (p:ℤ)+(q:ℤ)=m ∧ |(p:ℤ)-(q:ℤ)|^3 ≤ m^2; (((Finset.Icc 1 N).filter bad).card:ℝ) ≤ C*(N:ℝ)^((5:ℝ)/8+ε)

plain_statement.zh: 对两倍三次多项式值，在保持 5/8 例外指数的同时将素数对限制到 |p−q|≤m^(2/3)。
plain_statement.en: Keep the cubic 5/8 exceptional exponent with both primes confined near half the target.

brief.zh: 文献定理 1 的三次结论允许素数任意分布。此题规定中心窗口，忽略间距可恢复旧界。需要重新分析随目标移动的短素数和，整段的加权主弧下界不会自动给出该窗内贡献。非正目标也计作坏指标。
brief.en: Theorem 1 permits unrestricted summands. Recover its cubic conclusion by dropping the central-window condition. The moving short prime sum needs a new lower estimate; a full-interval major-arc floor does not localize itself.

gaps.statement:
by
  classical
  exact ∀ P : Polynomial ℤ, P.natDegree=3 → ∀ ε : ℝ, 0<ε → ∃ C : ℝ, 0<C ∧ ∀ M : ℕ, 2≤M → ∀ A : Finset ℕ, A ⊆ Finset.Icc 1 M → ∀ h : ℤ, let wt := fun (x : Fin 3 → (↥A)) => ∑ i, P.eval ((x i : ℕ):ℤ); let lin := fun (x : Fin 3 → (↥A)) => ∑ i, ((x i : ℕ):ℤ); let triples := (Finset.univ : Finset ((Fin 3 → (↥A)) × (Fin 3 → (↥A)))); ((triples.filter (fun z => wt z.1=wt z.2 ∧ lin z.1-lin z.2=h)).card:ℝ) ≤ C*(M:ℝ)^ε*(A.card:ℝ)^3

plain_statement.zh: 固定三元组指标和之差 h，证明三次多项式的碰撞数在每个切片都至多 M^ε|A|³，常数对 h 一致。
plain_statement.en: Bound cubic triple collisions at every prescribed linear defect uniformly in that defect.

brief.zh: #4325 已证精确六阶矩恒等式。固定左边三元组后，右边的一次和与多项式和均已知。平移和缩放变量去掉二次项，利用 S³−Σxᵢ³=3(x₁+x₂)(x₂+x₃)(x₃+x₁) 控制非零乘积的约数；零乘积需单独处理。各 h 的界相加仍有损失。
brief.en: With the first triple fixed, the other triple has prescribed linear and cubic data. Depress the cubic, factor the difference between the cube of the sum and the sum of cubes, and isolate degeneracy before using divisor bounds. Summing the slices is a separate challenge.

gaps.statement:
by
  classical
  exact ∀ P : Polynomial ℤ, P.natDegree=3 → ∃ C : ℕ, 0<C ∧ ∀ X H : ℕ, 1≤H → C*(H+1)^3 ≤ X → ∀ a b : Fin 3 → ℕ, (∀ i, a i ∈ Finset.Icc X (X+H) ∧ b i ∈ Finset.Icc X (X+H)) → (∑ i, P.eval ((a i):ℤ)) = (∑ i, P.eval ((b i):ℤ)) → ∃ σ : Equiv.Perm (Fin 3), ∀ i, a i=b (σ i)

plain_statement.zh: 在足够远的立方根长度指标窗口中证明三项三次多项式和完全刚性，仅有重排碰撞。
plain_statement.en: Prove exact rigidity of triple sums of cubic values on distant cube-root-length index windows.

brief.zh: 把变量写成 X+u；比较 X²、X 和常数三层，利用整数间距逐层强迫前三个幂和相等，再恢复带重数的三元组。若成功，#4325 的恒等式会给该窗口的精确对角矩，难点转为跨窗口耦合。
brief.en: Translate all variables by X. Separate the integer first, second and third power sums by coefficient size, then recover the multiset with multiplicity. In these windows #4325 turns rigidity into an exact diagonal moment.

gaps.statement: ∀ b : ℕ, 2 ≤ b → ∀ D : Finset ℕ, D ⊆ Finset.range b → 2 ≤ D.card → ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∃ X₀ : ℕ, ∀ X : ℕ, X₀ ≤ X → let A := (Finset.Icc 1 X).filter (fun n => (b.digits n).all (fun d => decide (d ∈ D))); let bad := fun n : ℕ => Even n ∧ ¬ ∃ p q : ℕ, Nat.Prime p ∧ Nat.Prime q ∧ p+q=n; ((@Finset.filter ℕ bad (Classical.decPred bad) A).card : ℝ) ≤ C * Real.sqrt (A.card : ℝ)

plain_statement.zh: 对每个固定进制和至少含两个数字的字母表 D，证明缺少双素数表示的允许偶数，至多为所有允许正整数个数的平方根乘以常数。
plain_statement.en: Bound exceptional even targets among integers supported on a fixed digit alphabet by a constant times the square root of the alphabet-restricted population.

brief.zh: Cumberbatch 的定理给出按允许数字集合大小计算的幂节省。本题固定指数 1/2，对稀疏字母表也按实际大小归一化。研究数字 Fourier 乘积对主弧有理点的聚集，再控制它与哥猜例外指示的相关。分母按所有允许正整数计数；标准进制表示不补前导零。
brief.en: Cumberbatch obtains a saving in the intrinsic population. Target exponent 1/2 even for thin alphabets. Use the digit Fourier product to locate concentrations at rational arcs and estimate their interaction with Goldbach exceptions. The population includes all allowed positive integers in their standard representation, without padded leading zeroes.

gaps.statement:
∃ θ : ℝ, 0 ≤ θ ∧ θ < 1 ∧ ∀ (K : ℕ) (H T : ℝ), ∃ q₀ : ℕ,
      ∀ (q : ℕ), q₀ ≤ q → ∀ [NeZero q] (S : Finset (DirichletCharacter ℂ q × ℂ)),
        (∀ p ∈ S, p.1 ≠ 1 ∧ (1/2 : ℝ) < p.2.re ∧ |p.2.im| ≤ T ∧
          p.1.LFunction p.2 = 0 ∧ (1 - p.2.re) * Real.log (q : ℝ) ≤ H) →
        let a (p : DirichletCharacter ℂ q × ℂ) : ℝ :=

Almost-everywhere translation does not select zero. Seek cancellation against the sixth-power phase at the remaining exceptional indices.

plain_statement.zh: 固定原始特征 α 与正偶数 m。让另一原始特征 β 跨越所有正导子，对任意有限搭档集合 F，证明扭曲奇异级数绝对值的三次方之和至多为普通奇异级数绝对值三次方的 3 倍。
plain_statement.en: Fix a primitive character and a positive even target. Over any finite collection of primitive partners of arbitrary positive conductors, bound the sum of cubes of twisted singular-series magnitudes by three times the cube of the ordinary magnitude.

brief.zh: Qmhou 在 #4164 证明超过普通值 1/√2 的搭档至多 24 个。新界若成立，在相同阈值下严格大于阈值的项每个贡献超过普通值三次方的 1/(2√2)，故至多 8 个；同一估计还能控制任意正阈值。可先把有限搭档升至共同模数并检验本原来源的单射。在 p 不整除 m 的奇素数幂上研究归一化 Jacobi 和一行的三次矩是否至多 1+1/(p−2)²；对 p 整除 m 时用正交性及逐项上界。数值样本不能代替素数幂统一证明。最后还须证明局部乘积确实控制全局级数。
brief.en: PR #4164 bounds the number above 1/√2 by 24. The cubic bound implies at most 8 at that threshold, and gives a tail bound at every threshold. Lift a finite family to one level, preserving injectivity. For odd p not dividing m try the local factor 1+1/(p−2)²; for p dividing m try orthogonality and pointwise contraction. Prove the prime-power estimates uniformly and justify passage to the global series.
