plain_statement.zh: 由模型重合和素数超差推出区域预算
plain_statement.en: Recover the regional budget from overlap and prime excess

brief.zh: 真实能量逐点至多为模型加超差正部，区域包含于扩大窗口。合并两个 n/4608 预算。
brief.en: Pointwise density is bounded by the model plus positive excess. The region lies inside the enlarged windows; add the two n/4608 budgets.

gaps.statement: let w := fun k : ℕ => if Nat.Prime k then Real.log (k:ℝ) else 0; let E := fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (((2*Real.pi*x:ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.I); let S := fun (n : ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ℝ) => Finset.sum (Finset.range (n+1)) (fun k => (w k:ℂ)*E ((k:ℝ)*t)); let Q := fun n : ℕ => (Nat.log 2 (n+2))^2; let arcs := fun n : ℕ => {t : ℝ | ∃ q a : ℕ, 1≤q ∧ q≤Q n ∧ a≤q ∧ Nat.Coprime a q ∧ |t-(a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ)| ≤ (Q n:ℝ)/((q:ℝ)*(n:ℝ))}; let low := fun (n k : ℕ) => if k^3≤n then w k else 0; let high := fun (n k : ℕ) => w k-low n k; let L := fun n : ℕ => max 1 (Nat.log 2 n / 2); let K := fun (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) => (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (L n), Real.cos (2*Real.pi*(2:ℝ)^(j+1)*t))/(L n:ℝ); let B := fun n : ℕ => {t : ℝ | t ∉ arcs n ∧ (1:ℝ)/2 < K n t}; let W := fun (n : ℕ) (p : ℕ → Prop) => {t : ℝ | ∃ q a : ℕ, 1 ≤ q ∧ q ≤ (Q n)^2 ∧ a ≤ q ∧ Nat.Coprime a q ∧ p q ∧ |t-(a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ)| ≤ ((Q n:ℝ)^2)/((q:ℝ)*(n:ℝ))}; let o := fun n q : ℕ => Odd q ∧ ∃ j : ℕ, 1 ≤ j ∧ j ≤ (Nat.log 2 (Q n)+1)^2 ∧ q ∣ 2^j-1; let F := fun (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) => ‖S n (high n) t‖^2; let m := fun (s : Set ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) => intervalIntegral (s.indicator f) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume; ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N, Even n → m ((B n ∩ (W n (fun _ => True))) ∩ W n (o n)) (F n) ≤ (n:ℝ)/2304

plain_statement.zh: 短二进制周期有理窗口内的素数能量
plain_statement.en: Prime energy around short binary-period rationals

brief.zh: 在扩大的窗口中只看邻近奇分母 q 且 q 整除某个 2ʲ−1（j≤(log₂Q+1)²）的点。可按周期分组，研究共振峰聚集。
brief.en: Group eligible odd denominators by short multiplicative order of 2 and study resonant peak clustering.

gaps.statement: let Q := fun n : ℕ => (Nat.log 2 (n+2))^2; let o := fun n q : ℕ => q % 2 = 1 ∧ ((Finset.Icc 1 ((Nat.log 2 (Q n)+1)^2)).filter (fun j => q ∣ 2^j-1)).Nonempty; let smooth := fun n q : ℕ => ∀ p ∈ q.primeFactors, p ≤ (1+Nat.log 2 (Q n))^8; ∀ ε : ℝ, 0<ε → ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N, (∑ q ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 ((Q n)^2)).filter (fun q => o n q ∧ ¬smooth n q), min (1:ℝ) ((q:ℝ)/(Q n:ℝ))/(Nat.totient q:ℝ)) ≤ ε

plain_statement.zh: 短周期且含大素因子的分母总权趋零
plain_statement.en: Vanishing weight of short-period moduli with a large prime factor

brief.zh: 每个大素因子 p 必整除某个 2ʲ−1。对 j≤H 的所有候选大素数按重数求和，1/(p−1) 的总价至多 H²/Y。用 φ 的超乘性向余因子收费，再以 (⌊log₂ X⌋+2)² 控制余因子倒欧拉函数和。
brief.en: Every large prime factor divides some 2ʲ−1. Summing even with period multiplicities costs ≤H²/Y in reciprocal (p−1) weight. Charge the cofactor by supermultiplicativity of φ and use the bound (floor(log₂ X)+2)² for its reciprocal-totient sum.

gaps.statement: let w := fun k : ℕ => if Nat.Prime k then Real.log (k:ℝ) else 0; let E := fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (((2*Real.pi*x:ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.I); let S := fun (n : ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ℝ) => Finset.sum (Finset.range (n+1)) (fun k => (w k:ℂ)*E ((k:ℝ)*t)); let Q := fun n : ℕ => (Nat.log 2 (n+2))^2; let arcs := fun n : ℕ => {t : ℝ | ∃ q a : ℕ, 1≤q ∧ q≤Q n ∧ a≤q ∧ Nat.Coprime a q ∧ |t-(a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ)| ≤ (Q n:ℝ)/((q:ℝ)*(n:ℝ))}; let low := fun (n k : ℕ) => if k^3≤n then w k else 0; let high := fun (n k : ℕ) => w k-low n k; let I := fun (n:ℕ) (a b:ℕ→ℝ) => intervalIntegral (fun t => (arcs n)ᶜ.indicator (fun u => S n a u*S n b u*E (-(n:ℝ)*u)) t) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume; let L := fun n : ℕ => max 1 (Nat.log 2 n / 2); let K := fun (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) => (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (L n), Real.cos (2*Real.pi*(2:ℝ)^(j+1)*t))/(L n:ℝ); let B := fun n : ℕ => {t : ℝ | t ∉ arcs n ∧ (1:ℝ)/2 < K n t}; let U := fun (n : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℝ) => intervalIntegral ((B n).indicator (fun t => ‖S n a t‖^2)) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume; let V := fun (n h : ℕ) => intervalIntegral ((B n).indicator (fun t => Real.cos (2*Real.pi*(h:ℝ)*t))) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume; let A := fun (n h : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℝ) => ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n+1-h), a k * a (k+h); let model := fun k : ℕ => if Nat.Coprime k 30 then (30:ℝ)/8 else 0; let short := fun (n : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℝ) => A n 0 a * V n 0 + 2*(∑ h ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (min n ((L n)^2)), A n h a * V n h); let long := fun (n : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℝ) => 2*(∑ h ∈ Finset.Icc ((L n)^2+1) n, A n h a * V n h); ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N, Even n → |short n (high n) - short n model| ≤ (n:ℝ)/2304

plain_statement.zh: 真素数与周期模型的短间距误差
plain_statement.en: Short-lag discrepancy between primes and the periodic model

brief.zh: 分别使用有界权估计，以面积的对数衰减吸收 L² 和 log² n。两种权不需要逐点接近。
brief.en: Bound the two short-lag pieces separately. Logarithmic area decay absorbs the number of lags and squared prime weights.

gaps.statement: let Q := fun n : ℕ => (Nat.log 2 (n+2))^2; let smooth := fun n q : ℕ => ∀ p ∈ q.primeFactors, p ≤ (1+Nat.log 2 (Q n))^8; ∀ ε : ℝ, 0<ε → ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N, (∑ q ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 ((Q n)^2)).filter (fun q => smooth n q), min (1:ℝ) ((q:ℝ)/(Q n:ℝ))/(Nat.totient q:ℝ)) ≤ ε

plain_statement.zh: 所有小素因子分母的加权总量趋零
plain_statement.en: Vanishing weight of smooth denominators

brief.zh: 算术猜想，允许全部 (1+log₂ Q)⁸ 光滑分母。先用 q/Q 控制小分母，再尝试用 Rankin 界估计较大光滑数及其 1/φ(q) 权重。
brief.en: Allow every denominator whose prime factors are at most (1+log₂ Q)⁸. Use q/Q for small q and try a Rankin bound for the weighted smooth-number tail.

plain_statement.zh: 任意位置的稀疏间距集只贡献 o(n)
plain_statement.en: Arbitrarily located sparse lag sets contribute sublinearly

brief.zh: 间距集与权可以随 n 改变。用指数面积界证明 |F|² 乘以异常集面积至多为一，再以四次对数的面积衰减吸收平方后的权。可剔除分散的例外间距，仍需估计剩下的稠密偶间距。
brief.en: The set and weights may depend on n. The exponential area bound pays for the squared cardinality. Logarithmic area decay absorbs the remaining squared weight. This controls scattered exceptions while leaving the dense even-lag sum open.

let W := fun (n : ℕ) (p : ℕ → Prop) => {t : ℝ | ∃ q a : ℕ, 1 ≤ q ∧ q ≤ (Q n)^2 ∧ a ≤ q ∧ Nat.Coprime a q ∧ p q ∧ |t-(a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ)| ≤ ((Q n:ℝ)^2)/((q:ℝ)*(n:ℝ))}; let F := fun (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) => ‖S n (high n) t‖^2; let T := fun n : ℕ => (n:ℝ)*(1+Real.log (n:ℝ))^4; let m := fun (s : Set ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ) => intervalIntegral (s.indicator f) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume; ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N, Even n → ∀ j : ℕ, L n / 16 ≤ j → j < Nat.log 2 n + 3 → let y := (2:ℝ)^j*T n; plain_statement.zh: 从有限个高峰层推出深次弧预算
plain_statement.en: Deduce the deep-minor spike budget from the surviving height bins

brief.zh: 每层上端纳入本层，下端归入前层。有限望远镜求和后给高层与低层各留 n/4608。高层总数最多 ⌊log₂ n⌋+3，系数 100000 足以守住预算。
brief.en: Use open lower and closed upper bin boundaries. Telescope the finite sum and allocate n/4608 to each of the low and high ranges. There are at most floor(log₂ n)+3 bins, within the numerical allowance.

gaps.statement: ∀ X : ℕ, (∑ q ∈ Finset.Icc 1 X, (q : ℝ) / (q.totient : ℝ)^2) ≤ Real.exp (Real.pi^2) * (1 + Real.log (X : ℝ))

plain_statement.zh: 控制共振分母权重 q/φ(q)² 的累积量，对所有截断点给出显式对数上界。
plain_statement.en: Bound the cumulative resonance weight q/φ(q)² logarithmically with an explicit constant at every cutoff.

brief.zh: 利用欧拉乘积将 (q/φ(q))² 逐因子放大为 1+6/p，按素因子子集展开。子集乘积 D 的倍数对调和和的贡献至多为 Hₓ/D，因此剩余乘积被 exp(6Σₚ1/p²) 控制。与单分母的共振分子比例界相乘，得到长周期奇因子分母族的加权总量。常数取便于核验的非最优值。
brief.en: Majorize each Euler factor of (q/φ(q))² by 1+6/p and expand over subsets of prime factors. Multiples of the subset product D carry at most Hₓ/D harmonic mass. The resulting product is bounded by exp(6Σₚ1/p²). Multiplication by a per-denominator resonance fraction bounds the weighted long-factor population; the explicit constant is not optimized.

gaps.statement: let T := fun (m : ℕ) (t : ℝ) => ∑ j ∈ Finset.range m, Real.cos (2*Real.pi*(2:ℝ)^(j+1)*t); ∀ m : ℕ, 0 < m → intervalIntegral (fun t => if (m:ℝ)/2 < T m t then (1:ℝ) else 0) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume ≤ Real.exp (-(m:ℝ)/8)

plain_statement.zh: 超过一半高度的频率集合的显式面积界
plain_statement.en: Explicit area bound above half the packet height

brief.zh: 对实部的单侧尾取指数参数 1/2，证明 cosh(s)≤exp(s²/2)。这个阈值用于实际截断。
brief.en: Apply exponential Markov with s=1/2 and prove cosh(s)≤exp(s²/2). The real one-sided threshold is the one used by the capped packet.

let D := fun (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) => ((n:ℝ)+1)^2/(1+((n:ℝ)+1)^2*‖E (30*t)-1‖^2); ∀ (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ), ‖S n model t‖^2 ≤ 3616*D n t) → (let E := fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (((2*Real.pi*x:ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.I); let Q := fun n : ℕ => (Nat.log 2 (n+2))^2; let arcs := fun n : ℕ => {t : ℝ | ∃ q a : ℕ, 1≤q ∧ q≤Q n ∧ a≤q ∧ Nat.Coprime a q ∧ |t-(a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ)| ≤ (Q n:ℝ)/((q:ℝ)*(n:ℝ))}; let D := fun (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) => ((n:ℝ)+1)^2/(1+((n:ℝ)+1)^2*‖E (30*t)-1‖^2); let S := fun (n : ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ℝ) => Finset.sum (Finset.range (n+1)) (fun k => (w k:ℂ)*E ((k:ℝ)*t)); let Q := fun n : ℕ => (Nat.log 2 (n+2))^2; let arcs := fun n : ℕ => {t : ℝ | ∃ q a : ℕ, 1≤q ∧ q≤Q n ∧ a≤q ∧ Nat.Coprime a q ∧ |t-(a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ)| ≤ (Q n:ℝ)/((q:ℝ)*(n:ℝ))}; let low := fun (n k : ℕ) => if k^3≤n then w k else 0; let high := fun (n k : ℕ) => w k-low n k; let I := fun (n:ℕ) (a b:ℕ→ℝ) => intervalIntegral (fun t => (arcs n)ᶜ.indicator (fun u => S n a u*S n b u*E (-(n:ℝ)*u)) t) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume; let L := fun n : ℕ => max 1 (Nat.log 2 n / 2); let K := fun (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) => (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (L n), Real.cos (2*Real.pi*(2:ℝ)^(j+1)*t))/(L n:ℝ); let B := fun n : ℕ => {t : ℝ | t ∉ arcs n ∧ (1:ℝ)/2 < K n t}; let U := fun (n : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℝ) => intervalIntegral ((B n).indicator (fun t => ‖S n a t‖^2)) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume; let V := fun (n h : ℕ) => intervalIntegral ((B n).indicator (fun t => Real.cos (2*Real.pi*(h:ℝ)*t))) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume; let A := fun (n h : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℝ) => ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n+1-h), a k * a (k+h); let model := fun k : ℕ => if Nat.Coprime k 30 then (30:ℝ)/8 else 0; let short := fun (n : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℝ) => A n 0 a * V n 0 + 2*(∑ h ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (min n ((L n)^2)), A n h a * V n h); let long := fun (n : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℝ) => 2*(∑ h ∈ Finset.Icc ((L n)^2+1) n, A n h a * V n h); ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N, intervalIntegral ((arcs n)ᶜ.indicator (fun t => ‖S n model t‖^2)) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume ≤ ε*(n:ℝ))

plain_statement.zh: 由网格尾部恢复周期模型的次弧估计
plain_statement.en: Transfer the grid estimate back to model leakage

brief.zh: 对同一个次弧作单调积分，网格预算取 ε/3616。
brief.en: Integrate the pointwise majorant on the same arcs with grid budget ε/3616.

plain_statement.zh: 把模 30 模型频谱写成八个几何级数
plain_statement.en: Resolve the modulus-30 model into geometric sums

brief.zh: 按 k mod 30 唯一分组。对 n<30 保留 r≤n，保证自然数截断不多算一项。可直接估计频谱在小分母有理点以外的尾部。
brief.en: Group indices by residue, retaining r≤n even for small n. This gives an explicit spectrum away from the model resonances.

plain_statement.zh: 模 30 有理网格在冻结次弧上的积分尾部
plain_statement.en: Integrate the smooth rational-grid tail on the frozen minor arcs

brief.zh: 只含显式余弦相位和实际弧宽。充分大 n 时，每个 a/30 约分后分母至多 30，主弧包含宽度至少 Q/(30n) 的邻域。可按最近网格点分区，利用正弦下界并积分距离的倒数平方。
brief.en: The task contains no prime weights. For large n each reduced a/30 has a major-arc neighborhood of radius at least Q/(30n). Partition by the nearest grid point and integrate an inverse-square distance estimate.

plain_statement.zh: 异常集上模 30 模型的能量预算
plain_statement.en: Masked energy budget for the modulus-30 model

brief.zh: 也可直接在异常集上积分；全部次弧的 o(n) 界足以提供这个具体常数。
brief.en: Use nonnegativity and containment in the minor arcs with epsilon=1/2304, or estimate the restricted model integral directly.

plain_statement.zh: 模 30 模型落在全部次弧的能量为 o(n)
plain_statement.en: Sublinear minor-arc energy leakage of the modulus-30 model

brief.zh: 模型频率集中在 a/30。约分后分母至多 30，充分大 n 的主弧覆盖每个峰的邻域。对几何级数尾的距离倒数平方积分。
brief.en: The finitely many peaks a/30 have reduced denominator at most 30. Integrate the inverse-square distance bound outside their major-arc neighborhoods.

gaps.statement: let E := fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (((2*Real.pi*x:ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.I); let S := fun (n : ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ℝ) => Finset.sum (Finset.range (n+1)) (fun k => (w k:ℂ)*E ((k:ℝ)*t)); let model := fun k : ℕ => if Nat.Coprime k 30 then (30:ℝ)/8 else 0; let D := fun (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) => ((n:ℝ)+1)^2/(1+((n:ℝ)+1)^2*‖E (30*t)-1‖^2); ∀ (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ), ‖S n model t‖^2 ≤ 3616*D n t

plain_statement.zh: 用光滑的模 30 周期函数控制模型频谱平方
plain_statement.en: Dominate the model spectrum by a smooth period-1/30 envelope

brief.zh: 八个几何和分别乘上相位差后至多为 2。用全局平凡上界覆盖精确共振点，得到处处有限的显式函数。
brief.en: Multiply each geometric sum by its phase difference, then combine the resulting cap with the global size bound. The envelope is finite at the exact resonances.

plain_statement.zh: 一致控制所有 0<h<N 的素数差对计数，把显式筛上界中的常数从 6.7814 降至 5.66，保留局部奇异因子和任意 ε 损失。
plain_statement.en: Improve the uniform prime-difference sieve constant to 5.66 for every 0<h<N, preserving the local factors and an arbitrary epsilon loss.

brief.zh: 对标命题 2 的 R(N,h)，按较小素数 p 计数，p+h 也须不超过 N。尝试在可分解筛权中分离大素因子，再对移动剩余类 −h 保持一致估计。5.66 严格小于表 1 无条件六项的 5.672 门槛；只控制固定 h 或对 h 平均都不够。
brief.en: Use Proposition 2 with the smaller prime as the parameter. Separate the large prime factors of the sieve moduli and retain uniformity in the moving residue −h. Table 1 puts the unconditional six-power threshold at 5.672. A fixed-shift estimate cannot be substituted.

gaps.statement: let E := fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (((2*Real.pi*x:ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.I); let S := fun (n : ℕ) (w : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ℝ) => Finset.sum (Finset.range (n+1)) (fun k => (w k:ℂ)*E ((k:ℝ)*t)); let Q := fun n : ℕ => (Nat.log 2 (n+2))^2; let arcs := fun n : ℕ => {t : ℝ | ∃ q a : ℕ, 1≤q ∧ q≤Q n ∧ a≤q ∧ Nat.Coprime a q ∧ |t-(a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ)| ≤ (Q n:ℝ)/((q:ℝ)*(n:ℝ))}; let I := fun (n:ℕ) (a b:ℕ→ℝ) => intervalIntegral (fun t => (arcs n)ᶜ.indicator (fun u => S n a u*S n b u*E (-(n:ℝ)*u)) t) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume; let Λ := ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt; let μ := fun d : ℕ => ((ArithmeticFunction.moebius d : ℤ) : ℝ); let U := fun n : ℕ => ⌊(n : ℝ) ^ (1 / 6 : ℝ)⌋₊; let u := fun (n m : ℕ) => if m ^ 3 ≤ n then 0 else (∑ d ∈ (Nat.divisors m).filter (fun d => d ≤ U n), μ d * Real.log ((m / d : ℕ) : ℝ)) - (∑ d ∈ (Nat.divisors m).filter (fun d => d ≤ U n), μ d * ∑ l ∈ (Nat.divisors (m / d)).filter (fun l => l ≤ U n), Λ l); let v := fun (n m : ℕ) => if m ^ 3 ≤ n then 0 else ∑ a ∈ (Nat.divisors m).filter (fun a => U n < m / a), (∑ d ∈ (Nat.divisors a).filter (fun d => U n < d), μ d) * Λ (m / a); let highLambda := fun (n k : ℕ) => if k ^ 3 ≤ n then 0 else Λ k; (∀ n m : ℕ, highLambda n m = u n m + v n m) ∧ (∀ n : ℕ, I n (highLambda n) (highLambda n) = I n (u n) (u n) + 2 * I n (u n) (v n) + I n (v n) (v n))

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 高段次弧 · MA-7010 · 立方根高段上的 Vaughan 精确分拆
plain_statement.en: New route · High-segment minor arcs · MA-7010 · Exact Vaughan split on the cube-root high segment

brief.zh: 取截断 U=⌊n^(1/6)⌋，在 m³>n 上因 m>U 使 Λ_{≤U}(m)=0，由 Vaughan 卷积恒等式精确分解高段 von Mangoldt 权为 u+v，并拆分旧次弧积分 I(h_Λ,h_Λ)。
brief.en: With cutoff U=⌊n^(1/6)⌋, every m with m³>n satisfies m>U so Λ_{≤U}(m)=0, giving the exact Vaughan decomposition highLambda=u+v and bilinear expansion of I(highLambda,highLambda) on (arcs n)ᶜ.

plain_statement.zh: 在原有的大弧截断、二进掩膜与模 30 模型下，证明模型修正项 Q 的绝对值对所有充分大偶数至多为 Cn/log² n。
plain_statement.en: Bound the absolute wheel-model correction Q by Cn/log² n for every sufficiently large even n, keeping the original arcs, mask and modulus-30 model.

brief.zh: WaterKing201030 在 #4136 给出线性下界，证伪原先要求 Q ≤ −n/312 的路线。本题若成立，可将模型修正吸收到任意固定的线性误差预算中。先用 #4128 的周期自相关隔离端点误差，再用 #4127 的掩膜估计控制短位移。将剩余周期项展开成模 30 的频率，估计各平移 Fejér 核在大弧以外的质量。尚需另外控制真正的素数相关项。
brief.en: PR #4136 refuted the old negative-linear target. Use the periodic autocorrelation in #4128 and mask bounds in #4127. Expand the triangular periodic term into shifted Fejér kernels and bound their tails outside the major arcs. This would absorb the model correction into any fixed linear budget. The prime correlation remains open.

gaps.statement: ∀ (H : ℕ) (a b : Fin H → ℝ), (∑ s, ∑ t, (a s-a t)*(b s-b t)) = 2*((H:ℝ)*(∑ s, a s*b s)-(∑ s, a s)*(∑ t, b t))

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 奇特征干涉 · OC-0102 · 单块上的带符号差分恒等式
plain_statement.en: New route · Odd-character interference · OC-0102 · Signed mixed differences on one cell

brief.zh: 将已有平方差恒等式极化，或展开双和。计入两份交叉项。
brief.en: Polarize the squared-distance identity or expand the double sum. Count both cross terms.

gaps.statement: (let w := fun p : ℕ => if Nat.Prime p then Real.log (p : ℝ) else 0; ∃ K : ℕ, ∀ k ≥ K, let n : ℕ := 2^k; let H : ℕ := 2^(k-k/4); ∀ x : ℕ, n ≤ 3*x → 3*x ≤ 2*n → (H:ℝ)/2 ≤ ∑ t ∈ Finset.range H, w (x+t)) → (let w := fun p : ℕ => if Nat.Prime p then Real.log (p : ℝ) else 0; ∀ k : ℕ, 12 ≤ k → let n : ℕ := 2^k; let H : ℕ := 2^(k-k/4); let B : ℕ := 2^(k/4-3); let p := fun j t : ℕ => n/2+j*H+t; let a := fun j t : ℕ => w (p j t); let b := fun j t : ℕ => w (n-p j t); (∀ x : ℕ, n ≤ 3*x → 3*x ≤ 2*n → (H:ℝ)/2 ≤ ∑ t ∈ Finset.range H, w (x+t)) → (n:ℝ)/32 + (∑ j ∈ Finset.range B, (∑ s ∈ Finset.range H, ∑ t ∈ Finset.range H, (a j s-a j t)*(b j s-b j t)) / (2*(H:ℝ))) ≤ (∑ p ∈ (Finset.range (n+1)).filter (fun p => n ≤ 3*p ∧ 3*p ≤ 2*n), w p * w (n-p))) → (let w := fun p : ℕ => if Nat.Prime p then Real.log (p : ℝ) else 0; ∃ K : ℕ, ∀ k ≥ K, let n : ℕ := 2^k; let H : ℕ := 2^(k-k/4); let B : ℕ := 2^(k/4-3); let p := fun j t : ℕ => n/2+j*H+t; let a := fun j t : ℕ => w (p j t); let b := fun j t : ℕ => w (n-p j t); -(n:ℝ)/64 ≤ (∑ j ∈ Finset.range B, (∑ s ∈ Finset.range H, ∑ t ∈ Finset.range H, (a j s-a j t)*(b j s-b j t)) / (2*(H:ℝ)))) → (let w := fun k : ℕ => if Nat.Prime k then Real.log (k : ℝ) else 0; ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∃ k₀ : ℕ, ∀ k ≥ k₀, let n : ℕ := 2^k; c*(n : ℝ) ≤ ∑ p ∈ (Finset.range (n+1)).filter (fun p => n ≤ 3*p ∧ 3*p ≤ 2*n), w p * w (n-p))

brief.en: Group by the lag t−s and compare aligned and opposed prime-weight increments. Keep the signed sum and denominator 2H. The bound must hold at every sufficiently large k.

brief.en: Apply a uniform short-interval prime theorem at length of order n to the power 3/4. Transfer to the half-open interval and prime log weight with one threshold for all starts.

gaps.statement: let w := fun p : ℕ => if Nat.Prime p then Real.log (p : ℝ) else 0; ∀ k : ℕ, 12 ≤ k → let n : ℕ := 2^k; let H : ℕ := 2^(k-k/4); let B : ℕ := 2^(k/4-3); let p := fun j t : ℕ => n/2+j*H+t; let a := fun j t : ℕ => w (p j t); let b := fun j t : ℕ => w (n-p j t); (∀ x : ℕ, n ≤ 3*x → 3*x ≤ 2*n → (H:ℝ)/2 ≤ ∑ t ∈ Finset.range H, w (x+t)) → (n:ℝ)/32 + (∑ j ∈ Finset.range B, (∑ s ∈ Finset.range H, ∑ t ∈ Finset.range H, (a j s-a j t)*(b j s-b j t)) / (2*(H:ℝ))) ≤ (∑ p ∈ (Finset.range (n+1)).filter (fun p => n ≤ 3*p ∧ 3*p ≤ 2*n), w p * w (n-p))

brief.en: Partition [n/2,5n/8) into B cells of H points, with BH=n/8. Reverse each reflected cell starting at n−(n/2+jH+H−1). Each product of block sums divided by H is at least H/4. All omitted terms are nonnegative.

gaps.statement: ∀ W : ℕ, 0 < W → ∀ u : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ x, 0 ≤ u x) → (∀ x, u (x+W) = u x) → ∃ (f : ℕ → ℝ) (C : ℝ), 0 < C ∧ (∀ x, 0 ≤ f x ∧ f x ≤ 8 * u x) ∧ (∀ x H : ℕ, |(∑ j ∈ Finset.range H, f (x+j*W)) - (H:ℝ)*u x| ≤ C*u x) ∧ ∀ a b k : ℕ, a+b = 2^k → f a * f b = 0

plain_statement.en: New route · Odd-character interference · OC-0108 · Preserve any fixed periodic profile while killing all dyadic pairs

brief.zh: 用支撑内取 M/|S|、支撑外取零的掩码乘以 u。步长 W 在模 M 的每个整周期遍历全部余数；尾段掩码权与尾长都在 [0,M]，可取 C=M。u≡1 已能检验单侧短区间质量论证。
brief.en: Multiply u by M/|S| on the mask and zero elsewhere. The step W permutes the residues in each full period. Tail weight and tail length both lie in [0,M], so take C=M. The constant profile already tests a short-interval argument.

gaps.statement: ∀ W : ℕ, 0 < W → ∃ M : ℕ, 1 < M ∧ Nat.Coprime W M ∧ ∃ S : Finset ℕ, S ⊆ Finset.range M ∧ M ≤ 8 * S.card ∧ ∀ (a b k : ℕ), a ∈ S → b ∈ S → (a+b)%M ≠ (2^k)%M

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 奇特征干涉 · OC-0107 · 避开全部二次幂和的正密度周期支撑
plain_statement.en: New route · Odd-character interference · OC-0107 · A positive-density residue set whose sums avoid every power of two

brief.zh: 取素数 s>max(W,5)，令 L=2^(s−3)、M=8L−1、S=[3L,4L)。倍增轨道的余数至多 4L，两点之和落在 [6L,8L−2]。若奇素数 p 同时整除 W 与 M，则 2 的模 p 阶同时整除 s 和 p−1。
brief.en: Take prime s>max(W,5), L=2^(s−3), M=8L−1 and S=[3L,4L). The doubling orbit has residues at most 4L while sums lie in [6L,8L−2]. For any odd prime p dividing both W and M the order of 2 modulo p divides s and p−1.

gaps.statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (L : ℝ) (γ : ℕ → ℝ) (W₁ W₂ : ℕ → ℂ), let E : ℕ → ℂ := fun j => Complex.exp (((γ j * L : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I); let cross : (ℕ → ℂ) → ℝ := fun W => ∑ j ∈ Finset.range m, ∑ l ∈ (Finset.range m).erase j, (W j * starRingEnd ℂ (W l) * E j * starRingEnd ℂ (E l)).re; cross W₁ + cross W₂ = ‖∑ j ∈ Finset.range m, W₁ j * E j‖ ^ 2 + ‖∑ j ∈ Finset.range m, W₂ j * E j‖ ^ 2 - ∑ j ∈ Finset.range m, (‖W₁ j‖ ^ 2 + ‖W₂ j‖ ^ 2) ∧ -(∑ j ∈ Finset.range m, (‖W₁ j‖ ^ 2 + ‖W₂ j‖ ^ 2)) ≤ cross W₁ + cross W₂

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · OC-7012 · 新路线 · 奇特征干涉 · OC-0102 · 二秩可分离零点对核的非对角平方完备化与相位无关下界
plain_statement.en: OC-7012 · New route · Odd-character interference · OC-0102 · Off-diagonal square completion and phase-independent floor for rank-two separable zero-pair kernels

brief.zh: 对每个索引补回对角项并利用单位模指数的范数不变性化为完整平方范数，由此导出与 log N 无关的对角负下界。
brief.en: Restore the diagonal index for each weight vector and use unit-modulus phase invariance to complete both squares and deduce the log-N-independent lower bound.

gaps.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ), 1 < n → Squarefree n → let T := fun x : ℝ => n.divisors.sum (fun d => (ArithmeticFunction.moebius d : ℝ) * max (x - Real.log (d : ℝ)) 0); ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n = T t - (ArithmeticFunction.moebius n : ℝ) * T (Real.log (n : ℝ) - t)

plain_statement.zh: 对每个无平方因子的 n>1 和实数 t，若 T(t) 是对数截断的莫比乌斯除数和，则 Λ(n)=T(t)−μ(n)T(log n−t)。
plain_statement.en: For each squarefree integer n>1 and real t, the logarithmically truncated Möbius divisor sum T satisfies Λ(n)=T(t)−μ(n)T(log n−t).

brief.zh: 在阈值 t 处分拆莫比乌斯加权的对数和，并在长除数项中用 n/d 替换 d。在 t=(log n)/2 处，系数化为 1−μ(n)，给出筛权奇偶性的精确恒等式。
brief.en: Split the Möbius-weighted log sum at t and replace each long divisor d by n/d. Taking t=(log n)/2 gives the explicit parity factor 1−μ(n) in the truncated prime weight.

gaps.statement: let ok := fun (n : ℕ) (h k : ℤ) => ∀ l : ℕ, Nat.Prime l → ∃ a : ℤ, ¬ (l : ℤ) ∣ a*(a+h)*((n : ℤ)-a)*((n : ℤ)-a+k); let good := fun (n : ℕ) (h k : ℤ) => ∃ p q : ℕ, Nat.Prime p ∧ Nat.Prime q ∧ p+q=n ∧ 1 < (p : ℤ)+h ∧ 1 < (q : ℤ)+k ∧ ((p : ℤ)+h).toNat.primeFactorsList.length ≤ 2 ∧ ((q : ℤ)+k).toNat.primeFactorsList.length ≤ 2; ∀ H : ℕ, ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ δ < 1 ∧ ∃ X₀ : ℕ, ∀ X : ℕ, X₀ ≤ X → ∀ h k : ℤ, h ≠ 0 → k ≠ 0 → Even h → Even k → (h.natAbs : ℝ) ≤ (Real.log (X : ℝ))^H → (k.natAbs : ℝ) ≤ (Real.log (X : ℝ))^H → let bad := fun n : ℕ => Even n ∧ ok n h k ∧ ¬good n h k; ((@Finset.filter ℕ bad (Classical.decPred bad) (Finset.Icc 4 X)).card : ℝ) ≤ (X : ℝ)^(1-δ)

plain_statement.zh: 对两个独立的正负偶移位 h、k（绝对值至多为对数幂），在所有局部可容许偶数中证明一致的幂节省例外界，使 p+h 与 q+k 同为至多两个素因子的正数。
plain_statement.en: For two independent nonzero even shifts up to a log power, prove a uniform power-saving exceptional bound for locally admissible Goldbach targets with both shifted summands positive almost primes of order two.

brief.zh: 先对每个素模剔除四个禁剩余类；在 p 或 q 上分别使用相应的切换筛，再控制两个移动移位的共同误差。h=k=2、n≡4(mod 6) 时，2 和 3 各有允许类，较大素模至多排除四类，因此包含定理 1.1。异常集可随移位变，误差指数和起始点不能变。
brief.en: Allow the exceptional set to depend on the shifts, but keep the exponent and onset uniform. For h=k=2 and n=4 mod 6 the local test holds at 2 and 3 and removes at most four classes at larger primes. Mixed shifts introduce different local roots and sieve errors.

gaps.statement: let missed := fun q a b n : ℕ => Even n ∧ n % q = (a+b) % q ∧ ¬ ∃ p r : ℕ, Nat.Prime p ∧ Nat.Prime r ∧ p+r=n ∧ p%q=a ∧ r%q=b; ∀ B : ℕ, ∃ A : ℕ, ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ N₀ : ℕ, ∀ N R : ℕ, N₀ ≤ N → 3 ≤ R → (R : ℝ)*(Real.log (N : ℝ))^A ≤ Real.sqrt (N : ℝ) → ∃ T : Finset ℕ, T ⊆ Finset.Icc 3 R ∧ (T.card : ℝ)*(Real.log (N : ℝ))^B ≤ (R : ℝ) ∧ ∀ q ∈ Finset.Icc 3 R, q ∉ T → ∀ a b : ℕ, a < q → b < q → Nat.Coprime a q → Nat.Coprime b q → (((@Finset.filter ℕ (missed q a b) (Classical.decPred (missed q a b)) (Finset.Icc 2 N)).card : ℝ)*(q : ℝ)) ≤ ε*(N : ℝ)

plain_statement.zh: 在几乎所有不超过 √N/对数幂的模数 q 上，同时对每一对互素剩余类 a、b 证明：至 N 的可容许偶数中，没有指定两素数表示的仅为 o(N/q)。同一批例外模数适用于所有剩余类。
plain_statement.en: For almost all moduli up to sqrt N divided by a log power, prove o(N/q) exceptional even targets simultaneously for every pair of reduced summand classes. The same bad-modulus set must work for all residue pairs.

brief.zh: Salmensuu 定理 1.1 在平方根尺度还须排除某些第二剩余类；定理 1.2 在较小的素数模范围可固定两类。尝试估计每个模数内最坏剩余类对的误差，再对模数取矩。该任务让参与者可以事先指定双素数所在的同余类，仍允许少量模数和偶数例外。
brief.en: Theorem 1.1 leaves exceptional second residues at the square-root scale; Theorem 1.2 treats both prescribed classes on a smaller prime-modulus range. Seek a moment over moduli controlling their worst residue pair. This would allow a local congruence filter chosen in advance, while still permitting exceptional targets.

gaps.statement: let bad := fun n : ℕ => 6 ∣ n ∧ ¬ ∃ p q : ℕ, Nat.Prime p ∧ Nat.Prime q ∧ p+q=n ∧ (2*p*q+1).primeFactorsList.length ≤ 7; ∀ A : ℕ, ∃ X₀ : ℕ, ∀ X : ℕ, X₀ ≤ X → (((@Finset.filter ℕ bad (Classical.decPred bad) (Finset.Ioc (X/2) X)).card : ℝ)*(Real.log (X : ℝ))^A) ≤ (X : ℝ)

plain_statement.zh: 对几乎所有 6 的倍数，寻找素数对 p+q=n，使二次式 2pq+1 至多有七个素因子（计重），保留任意对数幂的例外节省。
plain_statement.en: For almost all multiples of six, represent n=p+q by primes with at most seven prime factors of 2pq+1, preserving arbitrary logarithmic savings in the exceptional set.

brief.zh: 对标定理 1.3 的十三个因子。固定 n 后筛二次式 2p(n−p)+1，按素模上的零点数与重根分别估计，不将它当线性多项式。保留 6|n 消除模 3 的固定因子问题。七因子目标需要新的筛估计；该约束检验双素数解在二次剩余类上的分布。
brief.en: Compare Theorem 1.3. Sieve the polynomial 2p(n−p)+1, keeping split roots and repeated roots separate at each prime. Retain the multiple-of-six condition. An upper bound for a linear shift alone cannot provide the required quadratic distribution.

gaps.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ N) (c : ℝ) (s : ℂ), 1 ≤ c → 1 < s.re → let w : ℕ → ℂ := fun n => if 1 ≤ n ∧ (n : ℝ) < c then ((Real.log c - Real.log (n : ℝ) : ℝ) : ℂ) else 0; let r : ℕ → ℂ := (Real.log c : ℂ) • LSeries.delta - LSeries.convolution (fun n : ℕ => (ArithmeticFunction.moebius n : ℂ)) w; LSeries (fun n : ℕ => χ (n : ZMod N) * r n) s = (Real.log c : ℂ) - LSeries (fun n : ℕ => χ (n : ZMod N) * w n) s / χ.LFunction s

plain_statement.en: For every Dirichlet character χ of positive modulus, let w be the logarithmic cutoff on 1≤n<c and r=(log c)δ−μ∗w. If c≥1 and Re(s)>1, the χ-twisted series of r equals log c minus the finite χ-twisted series of w divided by L(s,χ).

brief.zh: 对狄利克雷卷积作同一特征的扭曲，利用绝对收敛和扭曲莫比乌斯级数的倒数恒等式。该等式在实部大于一的区域成立，无需零点分布假设。
brief.en: Twist the Dirichlet convolution by the same character and use absolute convergence and the reciprocal identity for the twisted Möbius series. The half-plane Re(s)>1 suffices without a zero-location hypothesis.

gaps.statement: ∀ (N M : ℕ), let Adm := (Finset.range N).filter (fun p => Nat.Prime p ∧ M < N - p ∧ (Nat.Prime (N - p) ∨ ∃ r ∈ Finset.Icc 2 N, ∃ q ∈ Finset.Icc 2 N, Nat.Prime r ∧ Nat.Prime q ∧ r ^ 10 ≤ q ^ 9 ∧ N - p = r * q)); let D : ℤ := (Adm.card : ℤ); let J : ℤ := ∑ p ∈ Adm, (-1 : ℤ) ^ (N - p).primeFactorsList.length; let R : ℤ := ((Adm.filter (fun p => Nat.Prime (N - p))).card : ℤ); let Semi := (Finset.Icc 2 N).filter (fun r => Nat.Prime r); D - J = 2 * R ∧ J + R = ∑ r ∈ Semi, ((Adm.filter (fun p => ∃ q ∈ Finset.Icc 2 N, Nat.Prime q ∧ r < q ∧ r ^ 10 ≤ q ^ 9 ∧ N - p = r * q)).card : ℤ)

plain_statement.en: New route · Li-Liu 1+1.9 weighted sieve · SW-7002 · Parity detector for true prime pairs and disjoint semiprime branching

brief.en: For the Li–Liu 1+1.9 admissible prime set Adm and J = ∑ (-1)^Ω(N−p), prove D − J = 2R and partition J + R disjointly over the unique smaller prime factor r < q.

gaps.statement: let bad := fun n : ℕ => Even n ∧ ¬ ∃ p q : ℕ, Nat.Prime p ∧ Nat.Prime q ∧ p+q=n ∧ q < p ∧ (p-q)^2 ≤ n ∧ (p-q+1).primeFactorsList.length ≤ 3; ∀ A : ℕ, ∃ X₀ : ℕ, ∀ X : ℕ, X₀ ≤ X → (((@Finset.filter ℕ bad (Classical.decPred bad) (Finset.Ioc (X/2) X)).card : ℝ)*(Real.log (X : ℝ))^A) ≤ (X : ℝ)

plain_statement.zh: 除去任意对数幂节省的例外，每个偶数 n 都可写成 p+q，其中 0<p−q≤√n，且 p−q+1 至多有三个素因子（计重）。
plain_statement.en: For all but O_A(X/log^A X) even targets in (X/2,X], find primes with 0<p−q≤sqrt(n) and at most three prime factors of p−q+1, counted with multiplicity.

brief.zh: 对照 Akeno 定理 1.2，在同一例外集尺度上，把四个因子降到三个，并约束在中点附近。尝试在短对称窗上估计原筛与切换筛的分布误差；全长版本的 0.267 门槛不能直接搬到这个窗口。q
brief.en: Compare Theorem 1.2. Localize both summands near n/2 and study the switched and original sieve in the same short window. The full-range switched-sieve criterion does not supply this localization. Strict ordering excludes a zero-gap shortcut.

gaps.statement: let bt := fun (u v : ℝ) (p : ℕ) => ∃ j : ℤ, ⌊u*(j : ℝ)+v⌋ = (p : ℤ); ∀ α : ℝ, 1 < α → α < 2 → Irrational α → (∃ c τ : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ 0 < τ ∧ ∀ q : ℕ, 0 < q → ∀ a : ℤ, c/(q : ℝ)^τ ≤ |α-(a : ℝ)/(q : ℝ)|) → ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∃ X₀ : ℕ, ∀ X : ℕ, X₀ ≤ X → let bad := fun n : ℕ => Even n ∧ ∃ β : ℝ, ¬ ∃ p q : ℕ, Nat.Prime p ∧ Nat.Prime q ∧ p+q=n ∧ bt α β p ∧ bt α β q; ((@Finset.filter ℕ bad (Classical.decPred bad) (Finset.Icc 4 X)).card : ℝ) ≤ C*Real.sqrt (X : ℝ)

plain_statement.zh: 固定 1<α<2 的有限型无理斜率，寻找大小仅 Oα(√X) 的共同例外集；对集外每个偶数及每个实平移 β，都有两个同一 Beatty 序列中素数的表示。
plain_statement.en: For every finite-type irrational slope between one and two, bound by Oα(sqrt X) a single exceptional set working for every translate of the Beatty sequence.

brief.zh: 与 Banks–Güloğlu–Nevans 对固定序列的几乎处处存在性相比，误差目标是平方根且平移置于选定目标之后。利用 α<2 给出的两段相位交叠余量，用有限网格覆盖平移，真正的困难是得到幂级例外界。不能由两段各自的素数密度推出同时命中。
brief.en: Exploit the positive overlap margin for slope below two to discretize translates. The difficult step is a square-root exceptional bound for simultaneous phase hits. Separate marginal densities do not control the joint count.

gaps.statement: let H := fun n : ℕ => ((Finset.range (n+1)).filter (fun p => p.Prime ∧ p ≤ n ∧ (n-p).Prime ∧ n ≤ 3*p ∧ 3*p ≤ 2*n)).card; let E := fun X : ℕ => (Finset.Icc X (2*X)).filter (fun n => Even n); ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ ∃ X₀ : ℕ, ∀ X ≥ X₀, δ*(X:ℝ) ≤ (((E X).filter (fun n => 0 < H n ∧ 0 < H (n+2) ∧ 0 < H (n+4))).card:ℝ)

plain_statement.zh: 猜想：正比例的连续三靶都具有中央表示
plain_statement.en: Conjecture: a positive proportion of adjacent triples all have central hits

brief.zh: 可用漏点密度和三个平移集合的并集界。也可直接尝试估计三个终点的联合分布。
brief.en: Use an exceptional-set estimate and a union bound over three shifts, or attack the joint distribution directly.

gaps.statement: let H := fun n : ℕ => ((Finset.range (n+1)).filter (fun p => p.Prime ∧ p ≤ n ∧ (n-p).Prime ∧ n ≤ 3*p ∧ 3*p ≤ 2*n)).card; ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ X₀ : ℕ, ∀ X ≥ X₀, (((Finset.Icc X (2*X)).filter (fun n => Even n ∧ H n=0 ∧ H (n+2)=0)).card:ℝ) ≤ ε*(X:ℝ)

plain_statement.zh: 相邻两个偶数都缺中央表示的起点密度趋零
plain_statement.en: Vanishing density of adjacent central misses

brief.zh: 允许任意单点漏失。尝试对相邻两个卷积的共同下尾建立估计，并标明对照的已知中央区间例外集结果。
brief.en: Bound the common lower tail of the two adjacent convolution values. Compare explicitly with existing exceptional-set results before claiming an improvement.

gaps.statement: let H := fun n : ℕ => ((Finset.range (n+1)).filter (fun p => p.Prime ∧ p ≤ n ∧ (n-p).Prime ∧ n ≤ 3*p ∧ 3*p ≤ 2*n)).card; ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∃ X₀ : ℕ, ∀ X ≥ X₀, c*(X:ℝ)^2/((Real.log (X:ℝ))^2) ≤ ∑ n ∈ (Finset.Icc X (2*X)).filter (fun n => Even n), (min (H n) (H (n+2)):ℝ)

plain_statement.zh: 相邻靶区共享的表示重数下界
plain_statement.en: Lower-bound multiplicity shared by adjacent targets

brief.zh: 对每对相邻偶数取较小的中央层数再求和。可尝试用两个卷积的共同下尾，或者用总量扣掉相邻振荡。
brief.en: Sum the smaller central multiplicity on each adjacent pair. Estimate the common lower tail or subtract the adjacent variation from total mass.

gaps.statement: ¬ (let H := fun n : ℕ => ((Finset.range (n+1)).filter (fun p => p.Prime ∧ p ≤ n ∧ (n-p).Prime ∧ n ≤ 3*p ∧ 3*p ≤ 2*n)).card; let E := fun X : ℕ => (Finset.Icc X (2*X)).filter (fun n => Even n); let M := fun X : ℕ => (X:ℝ)/(Real.log (X:ℝ))^2; let R := fun n : ℕ => ((H n + H (n+2)):ℝ); ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ X₀ : ℕ, ∀ X ≥ X₀, ∃ b : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ n ∈ E X, M X ≤ b n) ∧ (∑ n ∈ E X, (R n-b n)^2) ≤ ε*(X:ℝ)*(M X)^2)

plain_statement.zh: 证伪相邻偶数中央表示数的统一预测下限与均方误差条件
plain_statement.en: Refute the uniform predictor floor with vanishing mean-square error for adjacent central counts

brief.zh: 取 X≤n≤65X/64 且 n≡26 (mod 30)。两个目标各只允许三对有序既约余数。用固定模 30 的算术级数素数定理控制均值，再用柯西不等式给出对任意预测函数都成立的均方误差下界。
brief.en: Restrict to n ≡ 26 mod 30 in [X,65X/64]. Each target permits three ordered pairs of reduced residues. Use the prime number theorem modulo 30 to bound their average, then Cauchy–Schwarz to give a mean-square error floor uniform in the predictor.

gaps.statement: let H := fun n : ℕ => ((Finset.range (n+1)).filter (fun p => p.Prime ∧ p ≤ n ∧ (n-p).Prime ∧ n ≤ 3*p ∧ 3*p ≤ 2*n)).card; let E := fun X : ℕ => (Finset.Icc X (2*X)).filter (fun n => Even n); let M := fun X : ℕ => (X:ℝ)/(Real.log (X:ℝ))^2; let R := fun n : ℕ => ((H n + H (n+2)):ℝ); ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ X₀ : ℕ, ∀ X ≥ X₀, ∃ b : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ n ∈ E X, M X ≤ b n) ∧ (∑ n ∈ E X, (R n-b n)^2) ≤ ε*(X:ℝ)*(M X)^2

plain_statement.zh: 猜想：相邻中央命中的局部主项具有低均方误差
plain_statement.en: Conjecture: low mean-square error for adjacent central arrivals

brief.zh: 用局部因子构造预测。允许例外，控制误差平方总量；下游用已证的漏点能量引理。
brief.en: Build a local-factor predictor. Exceptions are allowed; bound the squared errors in aggregate.

gaps.statement: let H := fun n : ℕ => ((Finset.range (n+1)).filter (fun p => p.Prime ∧ p ≤ n ∧ (n-p).Prime ∧ n ≤ 3*p ∧ 3*p ≤ 2*n)).card; let E := fun X : ℕ => (Finset.Icc X (2*X)).filter (fun n => Even n); let M := fun X : ℕ => (X:ℝ)/(Real.log (X:ℝ))^2; let R := fun n : ℕ => ((H n + H (n+2)):ℝ); (∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ X₀ : ℕ, ∀ X ≥ X₀, ∃ b : ℕ → ℝ, (∀ n ∈ E X, M X ≤ b n) ∧ (∑ n ∈ E X, (R n-b n)^2) ≤ ε*(X:ℝ)*(M X)^2) → (∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ X₀ : ℕ, ∀ X ≥ X₀, (((Finset.Icc X (2*X)).filter (fun n => Even n ∧ H n=0 ∧ H (n+2)=0)).card:ℝ) ≤ ε*(X:ℝ))

plain_statement.zh: 用已证能量引理把局部预测转成双漏密度上界
plain_statement.en: Transfer a local prediction to a double-miss bound

brief.zh: 导入已证 DynExceptionEnergy，令 r(n)=H(n)+H(n+2)。从 X≥2 保证预算为正。预测假设由独立猜想提供。
brief.en: Import the verified DynExceptionEnergy, set r(n)=H(n)+H(n+2), and ensure positivity by taking X≥2. The prediction is a separate open input.

gaps.statement: ∀ (m a : ℕ), 0 < m → ((Finset.range m).filter (fun k => (a*k)%m=0)).card = Nat.gcd m a

plain_statement.zh: 定量计算圆周步长的返回重数
plain_statement.en: Count returns for a step on a finite circle

brief.zh: 先约掉最大公因数，返回时刻恰为约化周期的倍数。可用于给非原始循环赋权。
brief.en: Divide by the gcd and count multiples of the reduced period.

gaps.statement: ∃ A : Set ℝ, Dense A ∧ (0:ℝ) ∈ closure A ∧ (0:ℝ) ∉ A

plain_statement.zh: 证伪：稠密和闭包命中不能推出精确命中
plain_statement.en: Refute exact hitting from density and closure alone

brief.zh: 用穿孔实线作为反例。若模型只给闭包，需要独立的有限候选或离散分离条件。
brief.en: Use the punctured real line. A closure theorem needs a separate finite-candidate or discreteness argument.

gaps.statement: ∀ {X : Type} [TopologicalSpace X] (O U : Set X), Dense O → IsOpen U → U.Nonempty → (O ∩ U).Nonempty

plain_statement.zh: 把稠密轨道用于可命中的开靶区
plain_statement.en: Transfer dense-orbit information to an open target

brief.zh: 此工具要求靶区开且非空。应用时核对靶区是否真的具有正宽度及其误差如何回到整数。
brief.en: Check that the target is open and nonempty and account for the error when lifting to integers.

gaps.statement: ∀ m : ℕ, 2 ≤ m → ∃ a b : Fin m → ZMod m, Function.Bijective a ∧ Function.Bijective b ∧ ∀ t, a t ≠ b t

plain_statement.zh: 证伪：两个粒子各自遍历全圆仍可能永不相遇
plain_statement.en: Refute collision from two individually uniform marginals

brief.zh: 取同速转动并错开一个单位。每个位置的边际频率都相同，但同步轨道避开对角线。
brief.en: Use the same speed with a unit offset. Both marginals are uniform and the joint orbit misses the diagonal.

plain_statement.zh: 有安全边距时把近共振转为邻近整数和
plain_statement.en: Transfer near resonance to a nearby integer sum with a safety margin

brief.zh: 对共振整数 k 排除 k≤0 和 k≥2。误差预算保留在原整数尺度。
brief.en: Exclude k≤0 and k≥2 using the margins. Preserve the absolute error in integer units.

gaps.statement: let H := fun n : ℕ => ((Finset.range (n+1)).filter (fun p => p.Prime ∧ p ≤ n ∧ (n-p).Prime ∧ n ≤ 3*p ∧ 3*p ≤ 2*n)).card; ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ X₀ : ℕ, ∀ X ≥ X₀, ∀ y : ℕ, X ≤ y → y ≤ 2*X → ((((Finset.Icc y (y+Nat.sqrt X)).filter (fun n => Even n ∧ H n=0)).card):ℝ) ≤ ε*(Nat.sqrt X:ℝ)

plain_statement.zh: 猜想：平方根长度短窗中的中央漏点不会聚集
plain_statement.en: Conjecture: central misses do not cluster in square-root intervals

brief.zh: 对区间位置要求一致，但仍允许每个小窗有漏点。用局部均方估计结合已证 DynExceptionEnergy。
brief.en: Require uniformity over window positions while permitting misses. Combine local mean-square estimates with verified DynExceptionEnergy.

plain_statement.zh: 半单位误差预算下整数标签唯一
plain_statement.en: Recover the unique integer label with half-unit error margins

brief.zh: 用三角不等式把两个预算相加，整数间距至少一。可用于把连续相位估计变回精确结果。
brief.en: Add the two error budgets with the triangle inequality and use unit spacing of integers.

gaps.statement: ∀ m : ℕ, 2 ≤ m → (Nat.Prime m ↔ ∀ a : ZMod m, a ≠ 0 → Function.Surjective (fun k : ZMod m => a*k))

plain_statement.zh: 用圆周有限步长的传递性检测素性
plain_statement.en: Detect primes by transitivity of every nonzero circular step

brief.zh: 在 ZMod m 上，步长 a 的可达位置是 a 的倍数。合数时用真因子构造不能命中 1 的步长。
brief.en: The displacement set consists of multiples of a. In composite modulus a proper divisor cannot reach one.

gaps.statement: ∀ m : ℕ, 1 < m → ∃ a b : ℕ, a ≠ b ∧ a%m=b%m ∧ Nat.Prime a ∧ ¬ Nat.Prime b

plain_statement.zh: 证伪：固定模数的相位标签不足以辨认素数
plain_statement.en: Refute primality detection from a single fixed modular phase

brief.zh: 取 a=2，取 b=2(m+1)。这排除只看一个固定模数的编码。
brief.en: Take a=2 and b=2(m+1), excluding encodings based on a single fixed modulus.

gaps.statement: ∀ n p q : ℕ, 0 < n → n ≤ p+q → p+q < 2*n → (n ∣ p+q ↔ p+q=n)

plain_statement.zh: 在无混叠窗口中从碰撞恢复精确和
plain_statement.en: Recover an exact sum from a collision in an alias-free window

brief.zh: 把反向运动写成 p 与 −q 的相位差。窗口排除零倍和二倍目标。
brief.en: Opposite motion gives the phase difference p+q. The window excludes the zero and double multiples.

gaps.statement: let H := fun n : ℕ => ((Finset.range (n+1)).filter (fun p => p.Prime ∧ p ≤ n ∧ (n-p).Prime ∧ n ≤ 3*p ∧ 3*p ≤ 2*n)).card; let E := fun X : ℕ => (Finset.Icc X (2*X)).filter (fun n => Even n); let M := fun X : ℕ => (X:ℝ)/(Real.log (X:ℝ))^2; ∃ c δ : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ 0 < δ ∧ ∃ X₀ : ℕ, ∀ X ≥ X₀, ∀ D : Finset ℕ, (D.card:ℝ) ≤ c*(X:ℝ)/Real.log (X:ℝ) → δ*(X:ℝ) ≤ (((E X).filter (fun n => ∃ p ≤ n, p.Prime ∧ (n-p).Prime ∧ n ≤ 3*p ∧ 3*p ≤ 2*n ∧ n-p ∉ D)).card:ℝ)

plain_statement.zh: 猜想：中央命中对删除长步长稳定
plain_statement.en: Conjecture: central coverage survives long-step deletion

brief.zh: 用已证 DynDeletionLoss 的配对计数思路，先选有足够多中央见证的靶点。对手可在看过模型后再选删除集。
brief.en: Adapt the verified pair-charging argument of DynDeletionLoss after finding many endpoints with rich central fibers. The deletion may be adversarial.

gaps.statement: ∃ N₀ : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, N₀ ≤ n → Even n → ∃ p q : ℕ, p.Prime ∧ q.Prime ∧ 3*p ≤ 2*n ∧ 2*n ≤ 6*p ∧ |(p:ℤ)+(q:ℤ)-(n:ℤ)| ≤ 2

plain_statement.zh: 探索猜想：中心步长在三个相邻偶数中至少命中一个
plain_statement.en: Conjecture: a central step hits one of three consecutive even targets

brief.zh: 允许 n−2、n、n+2 三个目标。可尝试估计三点平滑卷积下界，或构造连续三处全漏的反例。第一步长限制在 [n/3,2n/3]。
brief.en: Allow n−2, n or n+2. Seek a uniform lower bound for a three-point smoothed convolution or a block of three misses. Restrict the first step to [n/3,2n/3].

gaps.statement: ∀ (C K : ℕ) (M s t : ℕ → ℝ) (y B : ℕ → ℝ) (A : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (U : ℝ), (∀ c ∈ Finset.range C, 0 ≤ M c) → (∀ c ∈ Finset.range C, (∑ k ∈ Finset.range K, y k * A k c) - s c ≤ t c) → (∀ k ∈ Finset.range K, B k ≤ y k * ∑ c ∈ Finset.range C, M c * A k c) → (∑ c ∈ Finset.range C, M c * s c ≤ U) → ∑ k ∈ Finset.range K, B k - U ≤ ∑ c ∈ Finset.range C, M c * t c

plain_statement.zh: 有限胞腔线性规划对偶见证与切换松弛下界
plain_statement.en: Finite cell linear-programming dual certificate with switched slack bound

brief.zh: 以非负胞腔质量乘逐胞腔对偶不等式后求和，交换有限双重和并代入各观测量下界与总切换松弛上界。
brief.en: Multiply the pointwise dual inequality by nonnegative cell masses, interchange the finite double sum, and substitute the observable lower bounds and total slack upper bound.

gaps.statement: let E := fun X : ℕ => (Finset.Icc X (2*X)).filter (fun n => Even n); let P := fun X : ℕ => (Finset.Icc (Nat.sqrt X) (2*Nat.sqrt X)).filter Nat.Prime; let H := fun (X n : ℕ) => ((P X).filter (fun p => p ≤ n ∧ Nat.Prime (n-p))).card; let W := fun X : ℕ => Nat.sqrt X * Nat.sqrt (Nat.sqrt X); let B := fun (X y : ℕ) => (E X).filter (fun n => y ≤ n ∧ n < y + W X); let M := fun X : ℕ => Real.sqrt (X:ℝ) / (Real.log (X:ℝ))^2; ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∃ X₀ : ℕ, ∀ X ≥ X₀, ∀ y : ℕ, X ≤ y → y + W X ≤ 2*X → (∑ n ∈ B X y, (H X n:ℝ)^2) ≤ C*(W X:ℝ)*(M X)^2

plain_statement.zh: 每个四分之三次幂短窗中的共同终点碰撞预算
plain_statement.en: Bound common-endpoint collisions in every three-quarter-power block

brief.zh: 展开平方并分开对角项。把两个平移素数的筛估计限制在长度 W 的移动区间，控制与起点无关的余项，再平均位移奇异因子。直接限制已证全区间上界会损失 X/W。 可按任务 imports 引用已证引理。
brief.en: Separate diagonal and off-diagonal pairs. Localize the shifted-prime sieve to length W with a remainder uniform in the origin, then average the shift factors. Restricting the global bound loses X/W. Verified lemmas are available through task imports.

gaps.statement: let E := fun X : ℕ => (Finset.Icc X (2*X)).filter (fun n => Even n); let P := fun X : ℕ => (Finset.Icc (Nat.sqrt X) (2*Nat.sqrt X)).filter Nat.Prime; let H := fun (X n : ℕ) => ((P X).filter (fun p => p ≤ n ∧ Nat.Prime (n-p))).card; let W := fun X : ℕ => Nat.sqrt X * Nat.sqrt (Nat.sqrt X); let B := fun (X y : ℕ) => (E X).filter (fun n => y ≤ n ∧ n < y + W X); let M := fun X : ℕ => Real.sqrt (X:ℝ) / (Real.log (X:ℝ))^2; ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∃ X₀ : ℕ, ∀ X ≥ X₀, ∀ y : ℕ, X ≤ y → y + W X ≤ 2*X → c*(W X:ℝ)*M X ≤ ∑ n ∈ B X y, (H X n:ℝ)

plain_statement.zh: 每个四分之三次幂短窗中的素数路径总量下界
plain_statement.en: Lower-bound prime arrivals in every three-quarter-power block

brief.zh: 把大素数限制在短窗中段，使每个允许的小素数与其相加仍在窗内。关键是对所有起点一致的短区间素数计数下界；全区间的一阶矩不能直接限制到子窗。 可按任务 imports 引用已证引理。
brief.en: Place the large prime inside the middle of the block so every allowed small step stays inside. Establish a short-interval prime lower bound uniform in the block origin; global mass alone gives no local lower bound. Verified lemmas are available through task imports.

gaps.statement: let W := fun (A B : Finset ℕ) (n : ℕ) => ((A ×ˢ B).filter (fun t => t.1+t.2=n)).card; ∀ (m n : ℕ) (A B : Finset ℕ), n < m → (∀ a ∈ A, a < m) → (∀ b ∈ B, b < m) → W A B (n+m) ≤ min ((A.filter (fun a => n < a)).card) ((B.filter (fun b => n < b)).card)

plain_statement.zh: 用高端步长数限制伪命中的重数
plain_statement.en: Bound wrapped multiplicity by the smaller upper tail

brief.zh: 在进位层两个坐标都大于 n。固定一个坐标后另一个惟一，分别向两个高端集合单射。
brief.en: Both summands exceed n on the wrapped layer. Project injectively onto each upper tail.

gaps.statement: let W := fun (A B : Finset ℕ) (n : ℕ) => ((A ×ˢ B).filter (fun t => t.1+t.2=n)).card; ∀ (m n : ℕ) (A B : Finset ℕ), 2 ≤ m → n+2 ≤ m → (∀ a ∈ A, a < m) → (∀ b ∈ B, b < m) → W A B (n+m) = W (A.image (fun a => m-1-a)) (B.image (fun b => m-1-b)) (m-2-n)

plain_statement.zh: 把进位层反射成低端整数的路径计数
plain_statement.en: Reflect wrapped paths into a low-end integer count

brief.zh: 两个坐标分别关于 m−1 作反射，用反射的自逆性保持路径重数。可用低端的支撑或筛界估计伪命中。
brief.en: Reflect both coordinates about the endpoints of [0,m−1]. An involution preserves multiplicity and gives access to low-end bounds.

gaps.statement: let W := fun (A B : Finset ℕ) (n : ℕ) => ((A ×ˢ B).filter (fun t => t.1+t.2=n)).card; ∀ (m n : ℕ) (A B : Finset ℕ), n < m → (∀ a ∈ A, a < m) → (∀ b ∈ B, b < m) → ((A ×ˢ B).filter (fun t => (t.1+t.2)%m=n)).card = W A B n + W A B (n+m)

plain_statement.zh: 模图的两步路径精确分成无进位与进位两层
plain_statement.en: Split modular two-step paths into two exact carry layers

brief.zh: 用 a+b<2m 列出两个可能的整数终点，再划分有序路径。后续估计必须扣除第二层。
brief.en: Use a+b<2m to partition ordered paths by their two possible integer endpoints.

gaps.statement: ∀ (A B : Set ℤ), (∀ x ∈ A, 0 < x) → (∀ x ∈ B, x < 0) → ∀ (P Q : Set ℤ), P.Nonempty → Q.Nonempty → (∀ F : Finset ℤ, ∃ k : ℤ, ∀ i ∈ F, (i ∈ P ↔ i+k ∈ A) ∧ (i ∈ Q ↔ i+k ∈ B)) → ∃ k : ℤ, ∀ i : ℤ, (i ∈ P ↔ i+k ∈ A) ∧ (i ∈ Q ↔ i+k ∈ B)

plain_statement.zh: 有限窗口可匹配的混合极限必为原轨道点
plain_statement.en: Recover mixed orbit limits from finite-window matches

brief.zh: 固定两个命中坐标，把平移限制到有限候选。若每个候选都失败，取各自一个反证坐标并合成一个窗口。
brief.en: Anchor one hit in each coordinate. Exclude each of the finitely many shifts with one witness and combine witnesses in a single window.

gaps.statement: ∀ (A B D E : Finset ℕ) (t : ℕ), let r := fun (B' : Finset ℕ) (n : ℕ) => (A.filter (fun p => p≤n ∧ n-p ∈ B')).card; t * (E.filter (fun n => t ≤ r B n ∧ r (B \ D) n = 0)).card ≤ A.card * (B ∩ D).card

plain_statement.zh: 删除大步长后有多少富终点会完全失去路径
plain_statement.en: Bound rich endpoints destroyed by deleting long steps

brief.zh: 每个失去全部路径的富终点消耗至少 t 个被删有序对，而每个小步长和被删大步长只能配成一对。
brief.en: Charge each destroyed rich target at least t distinct removed pairs; bound total pairs by the product of the two step counts.

gaps.statement: ∀ (E : Finset ℕ) (r b : ℕ → ℝ) (L : ℝ), 0 < L → (∀ n ∈ E, L ≤ b n) → ((E.filter (fun n => r n=0)).card:ℝ)*L^2 ≤ ∑ n ∈ E, (r n-b n)^2

plain_statement.zh: 用局部预测的均方误差约束漏点数
plain_statement.en: Charge each missed endpoint to local prediction error

brief.zh: 每个漏点的误差平方至少 L²。b 可随剩余类变化。后续若要推出漏点密度趋零，还须建立相应的小量误差。
brief.en: At each miss the squared error is at least L². The predictor may vary by residue; a little-o error estimate is still needed.

gaps.statement: let E := fun X : ℕ => (Finset.Icc X (2*X)).filter (fun n => Even n); let P := fun X : ℕ => (Finset.Icc (Nat.sqrt X) (2*Nat.sqrt X)).filter Nat.Prime; let H := fun (X n : ℕ) => ((P X).filter (fun p => p ≤ n ∧ Nat.Prime (n-p))).card; let K := fun (X p q : ℕ) => ((E X).filter (fun n => p≤n ∧ q≤n ∧ Nat.Prime (n-p) ∧ Nat.Prime (n-q))).card; ∀ X : ℕ, (∑ n ∈ E X, H X n * (H X n - 1)) = ∑ p ∈ P X, ∑ q ∈ (P X).erase p, K X p q

plain_statement.zh: 把碰撞矩分解成不同小素数对的共同终点
plain_statement.en: Resolve factorial collisions into shared endpoints

brief.zh: 数同一终点的两条不同路径。排除相同第一步，避免把对角线送进两素数筛。
brief.en: Count ordered distinct paths arriving together and remove the diagonal before applying a two-prime sieve.

gaps.statement: let E := fun X : ℕ => (Finset.Icc X (2*X)).filter (fun n => Even n); let P := fun X : ℕ => (Finset.Icc (Nat.sqrt X) (2*Nat.sqrt X)).filter Nat.Prime; let H := fun (X n : ℕ) => ((P X).filter (fun p => p ≤ n ∧ Nat.Prime (n-p))).card; let M := fun X : ℕ => Real.sqrt (X:ℝ) / (Real.log (X:ℝ))^2; ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∃ X₀ : ℕ, ∀ X ≥ X₀, c*(X:ℝ)*M X ≤ ∑ n ∈ E X, (H X n:ℝ)

plain_statement.zh: 平方根步长窗口内的一阶矩下界
plain_statement.en: Lower-bound total arrivals with a square-root-scale first prime

brief.zh: 用素数定理分别估计矩形的两边。只控制路径总量，允许部分偶数没有路径。
brief.en: Apply interval prime counts to each side of the interior rectangle. This total permits missed endpoints.

gaps.statement: let E := fun X : ℕ => (Finset.Icc X (2*X)).filter (fun n => Even n); let P := fun X : ℕ => (Finset.Icc (Nat.sqrt X) (2*Nat.sqrt X)).filter Nat.Prime; let H := fun (X n : ℕ) => ((P X).filter (fun p => p ≤ n ∧ Nat.Prime (n-p))).card; ∀ X : ℕ, ∑ n ∈ E X, H X n = ∑ p ∈ P X, ((E X).filter (fun n => p≤n ∧ Nat.Prime (n-p))).card

plain_statement.zh: 将两步路径的一阶矩换成逐个小素数求和
plain_statement.en: Double-count first arrivals by their small prime step

brief.zh: 交换终点和第一步的求和顺序，使不同小素数可以共用长区间素数下界。
brief.en: Count the same incidences in the opposite order so each small prime can use a common long-interval estimate.

gaps.statement: let E := fun X : ℕ => (Finset.Icc X (2*X)).filter (fun n => Even n); let P := fun X : ℕ => (Finset.Icc (Nat.sqrt X) (2*Nat.sqrt X)).filter Nat.Prime; let H := fun (X n : ℕ) => ((P X).filter (fun p => p ≤ n ∧ Nat.Prime (n-p))).card; ∀ X : ℕ, 64 ≤ X → (P X).card * ((Finset.Icc X (3*X/2)).filter Nat.Prime).card ≤ ∑ n ∈ E X, H X n

plain_statement.zh: 用一个完整素数矩形给路径总量下界
plain_statement.en: Embed an interior prime rectangle into the path count

brief.zh: 取小素数 p 和区间 [X,3X/2] 中的素数 q。证明 p+q 落在目标偶数区间，并保留第一步以免合并重数。
brief.en: Map the pair to its endpoint and first step. Bound endpoints and check parity before counting.

gaps.statement: let E := fun X : ℕ => (Finset.Icc X (2*X)).filter (fun n => Even n); let P := fun X : ℕ => (Finset.Icc (Nat.sqrt X) (2*Nat.sqrt X)).filter Nat.Prime; let H := fun (X n : ℕ) => ((P X).filter (fun p => p ≤ n ∧ Nat.Prime (n-p))).card; let M := fun X : ℕ => Real.sqrt (X:ℝ) / (Real.log (X:ℝ))^2; ∃ c δ : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ 0 < δ ∧ ∃ X₀ : ℕ, ∀ X ≥ X₀, δ*(X:ℝ) ≤ (((E X).filter (fun n => c*M X ≤ (H X n:ℝ))).card:ℝ)

plain_statement.zh: 正比例的偶数拥有许多小步长表示
plain_statement.en: Find a positive proportion of endpoints with many witnesses

brief.zh: 先扣除低于阈值的终点贡献，再对余下终点用柯西不等式。结论允许有正比例的例外。
brief.en: Subtract the contribution below a small threshold and use Cauchy–Schwarz on the rest. Exceptions are still allowed.

gaps.statement: ∀ N : ℕ, Even N → 4 ≤ N → ∃ A : Set ℕ, (∀ a ∈ A, Odd a) ∧ (∀ m : ℕ, 0 < m → ∃ a ∈ A, ∃ b ∈ A, (a+b)%m=N%m) ∧ ¬ (∃ a ∈ A, ∃ b ∈ A, a+b=N)

plain_statement.zh: 所有模数两步可达仍可漏掉指定整数
plain_statement.en: Construct a target missed despite reachability at every modulus

brief.zh: 取大于目标的所有奇数，同时平移两个加数的偶数模数倍。用它检查任何局部到整体的推理。
brief.en: Take all odd steps above the target and translate both summands by even multiples of the modulus.

gaps.statement: let E := fun X : ℕ => (Finset.Icc X (2*X)).filter (fun n => Even n); let P := fun X : ℕ => (Finset.Icc (Nat.sqrt X) (2*Nat.sqrt X)).filter Nat.Prime; let H := fun (X n : ℕ) => ((P X).filter (fun p => p ≤ n ∧ Nat.Prime (n-p))).card; let M := fun X : ℕ => Real.sqrt (X:ℝ) / (Real.log (X:ℝ))^2; ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∃ X₀ : ℕ, ∀ X ≥ X₀, (∑ n ∈ E X, (H X n:ℝ)^2) ≤ C*(X:ℝ)*(M X)^2

plain_statement.zh: 平方根步长窗口内的路径二阶矩
plain_statement.en: Bound the square-root-window path second moment

brief.zh: 用碰撞恒等式、共同邻点筛界与位移权重均值。对角项单独用每个终点至多有 |P| 条路径。
brief.en: Combine the collision identity with the two sieve inputs; bound diagonal arrivals separately by |E||P|.

gaps.statement: let E := fun X : ℕ => (Finset.Icc X (2*X)).filter (fun n => Even n); let P := fun X : ℕ => (Finset.Icc (Nat.sqrt X) (2*Nat.sqrt X)).filter Nat.Prime; let H := fun (X n : ℕ) => ((P X).filter (fun p => p ≤ n ∧ Nat.Prime (n-p))).card; let M := fun X : ℕ => Real.sqrt (X:ℝ) / (Real.log (X:ℝ))^2; ∃ η δ : ℝ, 0 < η ∧ 0 < δ ∧ ∃ X₀ : ℕ, ∀ X ≥ X₀, ∀ D : Finset ℕ, (D.card:ℝ) ≤ η*(X:ℝ)/Real.log (X:ℝ) → δ*(X:ℝ) ≤ (((E X).filter (fun n => ∃ p ∈ P X, p≤n ∧ Nat.Prime (n-p) ∧ n-p ∉ D)).card:ℝ)

plain_statement.zh: 探索猜想：删去一批大素数步长后仍有正比例命中
plain_statement.en: Conjecture: positive coverage survives adversarial long-step deletions

brief.zh: 由富终点下界和删除损失界，结合 |P| 的素数计数上界选 η。允许对手在看过图后选删除集合。
brief.en: Use the rich-target threshold, deletion loss and an upper prime count for |P|. The deleted set may depend on the graph.

gaps.statement: let E := fun X : ℕ => (Finset.Icc X (2*X)).filter (fun n => Even n); let P := fun X : ℕ => (Finset.Icc (Nat.sqrt X) (2*Nat.sqrt X)).filter Nat.Prime; let H := fun (X n : ℕ) => ((P X).filter (fun p => p ≤ n ∧ Nat.Prime (n-p))).card; let S := fun d : ℕ => ∏ l ∈ d.primeFactors.filter (fun l => 2 < l), (((l:ℝ)-1)/((l:ℝ)-2)); ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∃ X₀ : ℕ, ∀ X ≥ X₀, (∑ p ∈ P X, ∑ q ∈ (P X).filter (fun q => p < q), S (q-p)) ≤ C*((P X).card:ℝ)^2

plain_statement.zh: 控制小素数对的位移奇异因子均值
plain_statement.en: Bound the mean singular weight over small prime pairs

brief.zh: 将乘积按平方自由约数展开。小约数估计同余素数对，尾部需控制重模数；对单个位移的最大值会损失常数。
brief.en: Expand over squarefree divisors, count congruent prime pairs for small divisors and control the large-divisor tail.

gaps.statement: let E := fun X : ℕ => (Finset.Icc X (2*X)).filter (fun n => Even n); let P := fun X : ℕ => (Finset.Icc (Nat.sqrt X) (2*Nat.sqrt X)).filter Nat.Prime; let H := fun (X n : ℕ) => ((P X).filter (fun p => p ≤ n ∧ Nat.Prime (n-p))).card; let K := fun (X p q : ℕ) => ((E X).filter (fun n => p≤n ∧ q≤n ∧ Nat.Prime (n-p) ∧ Nat.Prime (n-q))).card; let S := fun d : ℕ => ∏ l ∈ d.primeFactors.filter (fun l => 2 < l), (((l:ℝ)-1)/((l:ℝ)-2)); ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∃ X₀ : ℕ, ∀ X ≥ X₀, ∀ p ∈ P X, ∀ q ∈ P X, p < q → (K X p q:ℝ) ≤ C*(X:ℝ)*S (q-p)/(Real.log (X:ℝ))^2

plain_statement.zh: 统一控制两个小素数平移的共同邻点
plain_statement.en: Sieve the shared neighbors of two distinct small primes

brief.zh: 在长区间对 n−p,n−q 作二维上界筛。区分整除位移的素数，常数须对 p,q 一致。
brief.en: Use an upper-bound sieve for two linear forms, separating primes dividing the shift and tracking uniform constants.

gaps.statement: let W := fun y : ℕ => Nat.floor ((y : ℝ) ^ ((13 : ℝ) / 225)); let P := fun X : ℕ => (Finset.Icc (Nat.sqrt X) (2 * Nat.sqrt X)).filter Nat.Prime; let R := fun (X n : ℕ) => ((P X).filter (fun p => p ≤ n ∧ Nat.Prime (n-p))).card; ∃ C δ : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ 0 < δ ∧ ∃ X₀ : ℕ, ∀ X ≥ X₀, ∀ y : ℕ, X ≤ y → y + W y ≤ 2 * X → (((Finset.Icc y (y + W y)).filter (fun n => Even n ∧ R X n = 0)).card : ℝ) ≤ C * ((W y : ℝ) + 1) * (X : ℝ) ^ (-δ)

plain_statement.zh: 短窗内平方根量级加数的漏点数有幂次节省
plain_statement.en: Power-saving exceptional set with a square-root-sized summand in every short window

brief.zh: 待证。对充分大的 X，每个完整落在 [X,2X] 的闭窗 [y,y+⌊y^(13/225)⌋] 中，不能写成 p+q 且 ⌊√X⌋≤p≤2⌊√X⌋ 的偶数至多为 C(⌊y^(13/225)⌋+1)X^(-δ) 个。p、q 都是素数。尝试为实际受限计数构造带奇异级数的正主项，并用逐窗局部均方误差和已证漏点能量引理计数。Li 定理 6 在同窗给出无加数限制的密度趋一结论。本题同时限制加数并要求幂次节省。可引用全站已核验的 Lean 模块；见 https://jenkins-hook.goldbach.tech/verified-imports.json。
brief.en: Open. For large X, every closed window [y,y+floor(y^(13/225))] inside [X,2X] has at most C(floor(y^(13/225))+1)X^(-δ) even integers without a prime pair p+q with floor(sqrt X) ≤ p ≤ 2 floor(sqrt X). Try a positive singular-series main term and a uniform local mean-square error to which the verified exception-energy lemma applies. Li's Theorem 6 gives density one on the same window with unrestricted summands. This target adds a summand constraint and a power saving. You may import verified Lean modules listed at https://jenkins-hook.goldbach.tech/verified-imports.json.

gaps.statement: let W := fun (A B : Finset ℕ) (n : ℕ) => ((A ×ˢ B).filter (fun t => t.1+t.2=n)).card; ∀ (m n : ℕ) (A B : Finset ℕ), n < m → (∀ a ∈ A, a < m) → (∀ b ∈ B, b < m) → min ((A.filter (fun a => n < a)).card) ((B.filter (fun b => n < b)).card) < ((A ×ˢ B).filter (fun t => (t.1+t.2)%m=n)).card → 0 < W A B n

plain_statement.zh: 模路径数超过伪命中预算时恢复整数命中
plain_statement.en: Certify an integer hit from a modular surplus

brief.zh: 组合进位分层与高端预算。须另行证明素数集合的模计数超过预算，才能用于一个指定偶数。
brief.en: Combine the carry split and the tail bound. A prime-set application still needs an independent surplus at its target.

gaps.statement: let E := fun X : ℕ => (Finset.Icc X (2*X)).filter (fun n => Even n); let P := fun X : ℕ => (Finset.Icc (Nat.sqrt X) (2*Nat.sqrt X)).filter Nat.Prime; let H := fun (X n : ℕ) => ((P X).filter (fun p => p ≤ n ∧ Nat.Prime (n-p))).card; ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ X₀ : ℕ, ∀ X ≥ X₀, (((E X).filter (fun n => H X n=0)).card:ℝ) ≤ ε*(X:ℝ)

plain_statement.zh: 探索猜想：平方根步长窗口的漏点密度趋零
plain_statement.en: Conjecture: vanishing density of missed square-root-window targets

brief.zh: 这比正比例命中更强。尝试针对小素数区间建立均方误差，对照局部同余主项；仅有二阶矩上界尚不够。
brief.en: Try a mean-square approximation with a residue-sensitive main term for the short prime factor. A bounded second moment alone leaves exceptions.

gaps.statement: let W := fun y : ℕ => Nat.floor ((y : ℝ) ^ ((26 : ℝ) / 1075)); ∃ X₀ : ℕ, ∀ X ≥ X₀, ∀ y : ℕ, X ≤ y → y + W y ≤ 2 * X → ∃ n : ℕ, y ≤ n ∧ n ≤ y + W y ∧ Even n ∧ (∃ p q : ℕ, Nat.Prime p ∧ Nat.Prime q ∧ Nat.sqrt X ≤ p ∧ p ≤ 2 * Nat.sqrt X ∧ p + q = n)

plain_statement.zh: 每个超短窗都有一个带平方根量级素数加数的哥德巴赫数
plain_statement.en: A Goldbach hit with a square-root-sized prime in every ultra-short window

brief.zh: 待证。对充分大的 X，每个完整落在 [X,2X] 的闭窗 [y,y+⌊y^(26/1075)⌋] 中，至少一个偶数能写成两个素数之和，且其中一个素数在 [⌊√X⌋,2⌊√X⌋]。可从 Li 定理 7 的短窗存在性及其筛法输入入手，研究短区间素数指示函数与平方根带素数的加权平均，直接证明一个非负短窗权下的总表示数为正。该窗明显短于 13/225 密度题；需要排除同窗全漏，长窗矩估计无法直接定位这个窗。可引用全站已核验的 Lean 模块；见 https://jenkins-hook.goldbach.tech/verified-imports.json。
brief.en: Open. For large X, each closed window [y,y+floor(y^(26/1075))] inside [X,2X] contains an even sum of two primes, one in [floor(sqrt X),2 floor(sqrt X)]. Start from the sieve inputs behind Li's Theorem 7 and seek a positive weighted short-window average against primes in the square-root band. The window is shorter than the 13/225 density window. The challenge is to rule out a wholly missed window at this scale. You may import verified Lean modules listed at https://jenkins-hook.goldbach.tech/verified-imports.json.

gaps.statement: ∀ (A B : Set ℤ), (∀ x ∈ A, 0 < x) → (∀ x ∈ B, x < 0) → ∀ i j k : ℤ, i+k ∈ A → j+k ∈ B → -i < k ∧ k < -j

plain_statement.zh: 混合柱集把平移时间锁进有限区间
plain_statement.en: Trap mixed-cylinder hitting times in a finite interval

brief.zh: 把两个非零坐标的支撑条件同时写出。得到的区间只依赖窗口位置，后续可用于轨道闭包。
brief.en: Use the opposite support signs at the two observed coordinates. The bounds depend only on the window.

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 小偶数覆盖 · FR-7032 · 十三个候选覆盖模 510510 的偶数类
plain_statement.en: New route · Finite-range coverage · FR-7032 · Thirteen candidates cover even residues modulo 510510

brief.zh: 逐类复核 255255 个偶类，可按 1001 个一块分 255 块由内核求值。再避开 17 后得到 19 粗的候选。
brief.en: Verify all 255255 even residues, e.g. by kernel evaluation in 255 blocks of 1001. Excluding 17 as well gives a 19-rough candidate.

gaps.statement: ∀ n : ℕ, 4 ≤ n → Even n → (n:ℝ) < Real.exp (Real.exp 5) → ∃ p : ℕ, Nat.Prime p ∧ 2 ≤ n-p ∧ (n-p).primeFactorsList.length ≤ 50

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 小偶数覆盖 · FR-7034 · 将原型全域因子上界降至五十
plain_statement.en: New route · Finite-range coverage · FR-7034 · Reduce the full prototype factor bound to fifty

brief.zh: 对 n≥2313 用模 510510 的 19 粗候选与 exp 5<51 log 19；更小的偶数取 p=2，因 n−2<2^51。
brief.en: For n≥2313 use the 19-rough candidate modulo 510510 and exp 5<51 log 19. For smaller even n take p=2, since n−2<2^51.

gaps.statement: Real.exp 5 < 51 * Real.log 19

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 小偶数覆盖 · FR-7033 · 19 粗候选在原型全域所需的指数比较
plain_statement.en: New route · Finite-range coverage · FR-7033 · Exponential comparison for 19-rough candidates on the full prototype

brief.zh: 用 e<2.7182818286 估计 exp 5<148.42，再由 log 19=4 log 2+log(19/16) 与 log x≥1−1/x 从下界定。
brief.en: Bound exp 5<148.42 from e<2.7182818286, and bound log 19=4 log 2+log(19/16) from below with log x≥1−1/x.

gaps.statement: ∀ n d e : ℕ, 0 < d → 0 < e → ((∃ p : ℕ, p % d = n % d ∧ p % e = 1 % e) ↔ n % (Nat.gcd d e) = 1 % (Nat.gcd d e))

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 小偶数覆盖 · FR-7012 · p−1 辅助权的广义 CRT
plain_statement.en: New route · Finite-range coverage · FR-7012 · Generalized CRT for the p−1 probe

brief.zh: 先仅处理相容性，不把两个模数当成独立；之后按 lcm 进入分布估计。
brief.en: Establish compatibility before applying progression estimates modulo the lcm.

gaps.statement: ∀ (q a n : ℕ), 3 ≤ q → q ≤ 105 → a < q → Nat.Coprime a q → 8000000000 ≤ n → |(∑ k ∈ (Finset.range (n+1)).filter (fun k => k % q = a % q), ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt k) - (n:ℝ)/Nat.totient q| ≤ (n:ℝ)/(840 * Real.log (n:ℝ))

plain_statement.zh: 把 BMOR 定理 1.1 的小模数 ψ 估计形式化
plain_statement.en: Formalize the small-modulus ψ bound of BMOR Theorem 1.1

brief.zh: 从定理 1.1 的式 (1.9)–(1.11) 取 q=3…105 的范围。保留 x≥8×10⁹ 和 1/840，核对端点包含在求和内。权威核验需要 Lean 证明及所用数值证书。
brief.en: Specialize (1.9)–(1.11) to 3 ≤ q ≤ 105. Retain the threshold and constant, reconcile the inclusive sum, and provide checked proofs for the analytic and numerical inputs.

gaps.statement: (∀ (q a n : ℕ), 3 ≤ q → q ≤ 105 → a < q → Nat.Coprime a q → 8000000000 ≤ n → |(∑ k ∈ (Finset.range (n+1)).filter (fun k => k % q = a % q), ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt k) - (n:ℝ)/Nat.totient q| ≤ (n:ℝ)/(840 * Real.log (n:ℝ))) → (∀ q n : ℕ, 1 ≤ q → 1 ≤ n → (∑ k ∈ (Finset.range (n+1)).filter (fun k => ¬ Nat.Coprime k q), ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt k) ≤ (q.primeFactors.card:ℝ)*Real.log n) → (∀ (q a n : ℕ), 1 ≤ q → q ≤ 105 → Nat.Coprime a q → 10^16 ≤ n → (n:ℝ) < Real.exp (Real.exp (19/5)) → |(∑ k ∈ (Finset.range (n+1)).filter (fun k => k % q = a % q), ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt k) - (n:ℝ)/Nat.totient q| ≤ (n:ℝ)/100)

plain_statement.zh: 由 BMOR 的 ψ 界恢复 FR-7022 的全部模数
plain_statement.en: Recover the full FR-7022 modulus range from BMOR ψ

brief.zh: 模 4 的奇类补足 q=2；再用 FR-7023 控制偶数权重补足 q=1。其余模数直接换算误差。
brief.en: Add the two odd classes modulo four for q=2, then use FR-7023 on the even contribution for q=1. The other moduli use the explicit error directly.

gaps.statement: ∀ n : ℕ, 10^16 ≤ n → (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n+1), (if k.Prime then 0 else ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt k)) ≤ (n:ℝ)/200

plain_statement.zh: 给所有高次素数幂一个显式的 n/200 总预算
plain_statement.en: Give all higher prime powers a global n/200 budget

brief.zh: 对 pᵏ≤n、k≥2，用已有底数上界 √n 和指数上界 log₂ n。于是总权重至多 √n·log₂(n)·log n；验证它从 10¹⁶ 起小于 n/200。可独立于等差数列完成。
brief.en: Use the base and exponent cutoffs for pᵏ ≤ n with k ≥ 2. Bound the total by √n log₂(n) log n and check the ratio from 10¹⁶ onward. No progression estimates are required.

gaps.statement: ∀ (q a n : ℕ), 1 ≤ q → q ≤ 105 → Nat.Coprime a q → 10^16 ≤ n → (n:ℝ) < Real.exp (Real.exp (19/5)) → |(∑ k ∈ (Finset.range (n+1)).filter (fun k => k % q = a % q), (if k.Prime then ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt k else 0)) - (n:ℝ)/Nat.totient q| ≤ (n:ℝ)/200

plain_statement.zh: 只计素数，给等差数列的误差留出 n/200
plain_statement.en: Bound the prime-only progression error by n/200

brief.zh: 对素数有 Λ(p)=log p。BMOR 定理 1.2 控制 q≥3；q=2 用模 4 的两个奇剩余类，q=1 再加素数 2。保留阈值 10¹⁶。
brief.en: Use Λ(p)=log p and Theorem 1.2 for q ≥ 3. For q=2 combine both odd classes modulo four. For q=1 also include the prime two. Keep the explicit threshold.

gaps.statement: (∀ (q a n : ℕ), 1 ≤ q → q ≤ 105 → Nat.Coprime a q → 10^16 ≤ n → (n:ℝ) < Real.exp (Real.exp (19/5)) → |(∑ k ∈ (Finset.range (n+1)).filter (fun k => k % q = a % q), (if k.Prime then ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt k else 0)) - (n:ℝ)/Nat.totient q| ≤ (n:ℝ)/200) → (∀ n : ℕ, 10^16 ≤ n → (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n+1), (if k.Prime then 0 else ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt k)) ≤ (n:ℝ)/200) → (∀ (q a n : ℕ), 1 ≤ q → q ≤ 105 → Nat.Coprime a q → 10^16 ≤ n → (n:ℝ) < Real.exp (Real.exp (19/5)) → |(∑ k ∈ (Finset.range (n+1)).filter (fun k => k % q = a % q), ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt k) - (n:ℝ)/Nat.totient q| ≤ (n:ℝ)/100)

plain_statement.zh: 合并素数与高次幂的两个半预算，推出 FR-7022
plain_statement.en: Combine the prime and higher-power budgets for FR-7022

brief.zh: 一个剩余类内的非素数权重非负且至多为全局总量。把两个 n/200 相加，得到原声明要求的 n/100。
brief.en: The nonprime weight in each class is nonnegative and bounded by the global sum. Adding the two n/200 budgets gives the original n/100.

gaps.statement: ∀ A : ℝ, 0 < A → ∃ B C : ℝ, 0 < B ∧ 0 < C ∧ ∃ X₀ : ℕ, ∀ X H : ℕ, X₀ ≤ X → H ≤ X → (X:ℝ)^((7:ℝ)/120) * (Real.log (X:ℝ))^B ≤ (H:ℝ) → ((((Finset.Icc (X-H) X).filter (fun n => 4 ≤ n ∧ Even n ∧ ∀ p ∈ Finset.range (n+1), ¬ (Nat.Prime p ∧ Nat.Prime (n-p)))).card):ℝ) ≤ C*(H:ℝ)/(Real.log (X:ℝ))^A

plain_statement.zh: 待证：把 Grimmelt 短窗例外集定理的幂次余量降为对数余量
plain_statement.en: Conjecture: a polylogarithmic endpoint loss in Grimmelt’s short-interval exception bound

brief.zh: 取任意 A>0，找与窗口起点无关的 B、C 和阈值。在原文引理 5.1 分别追踪 Y 与 H 尺度的两次幂损失，并检验非负模型的误差是否仍可吸收。固定 ε 定理中隐常数和阈值依赖 ε，直接令 ε 随 X 变动无效。结论控制每窗的真正漏点，仍允许孤立例外。可按任务 imports 复用已证引理。
brief.en: For each A>0 seek B,C and a threshold uniform in the window. Track the two power losses at Y and H in Lemma 5.1 and the error budget of the nonnegative model. A fixed-epsilon theorem does not justify taking epsilon to depend on X. The conclusion bounds genuine missed even targets in every window and allows isolated misses. Verified lemmas may be used according to task imports.

gaps.statement: let ps := fun (g : ℝ) (p : ℕ) => ∃ j : ℕ, 0 < j ∧ ⌊(j : ℝ)^(1/g)⌋₊=p; let c₀ : ℝ := ∏' l : ℕ, if Nat.Prime l ∧ 2 < l then 1-1/((l : ℝ)-1)^2 else 1; let sing := fun n : ℕ => 2*c₀*∏ l ∈ n.primeFactors.filter (fun l => 2 < l), ((l : ℝ)-1)/((l : ℝ)-2); ∀ u v : ℝ, 9/10 ≤ u → u ≤ 1 → 9/10 ≤ v → v ≤ 1 → let w := fun (g : ℝ) (p : ℕ) => @ite ℝ (Nat.Prime p ∧ ps g p) (Classical.propDecidable _) ((p : ℝ)^(1-g)*Real.log (p : ℝ)/g) 0; ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ X₀ : ℕ, ∀ X : ℕ, X₀ ≤ X → let bad := fun n : ℕ => Even n ∧ ε*sing n*(n : ℝ) < |(∑ p ∈ Finset.range (n+1), w u p*w v (n-p))-sing n*(n : ℝ)|; ((@Finset.filter ℕ bad (Classical.decPred bad) (Finset.Icc 4 X)).card : ℝ) ≤ ε*(X : ℝ)

plain_statement.zh: 两套独立 Piatetski–Shapiro 指数 γ₁、γ₂ 都允许降至 9/10，在几乎所有偶数上证明补偿加权的双素数表示渐近式，保留普通哥猜奇异级数主项。
plain_statement.en: Extend the compensated two-summand Piatetski–Shapiro Goldbach asymptotic to independent exponents in [9/10,1], with the usual binary singular series for almost all even targets.

brief.zh: 对标李洪泽定理 2 的 γᵢ>27/29。不能用仅保证下界或只约束一侧的结果替代。把素数上的薄序列权分别展开，重点估计双侧非零频率的交叉项。取 γ=1 时该侧恢复普通对数素数权。
brief.en: Compare H. Z. Li's Theorem 2. Subtract the ordinary logarithmic prime weight on each side and bound the cross term of the two sparse oscillatory errors. A one-sided estimate or a lower bound for equal exponents alone does not yield the asymptotic.

gaps.statement: ∀ (f : ℕ → ℝ), (∀ k : ℕ, ¬ k.Prime → f k = 0) → ∀ n : ℕ, (∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), f k) = (∑ k ∈ (Finset.range (n + 1)).filter (fun k => k % 4 = 1), f k) + (∑ k ∈ (Finset.range (n + 1)).filter (fun k => k % 4 = 3), f k) + (if 2 ≤ n then f 2 else 0)

plain_statement.zh: 将任意仅在素数上有权重的有限和，精确分解为模四的两个奇剩余类与素数二的例外项
plain_statement.en: Split any finite prime-supported weight sum into the two odd classes modulo four and the exceptional prime two

brief.zh: 为 FR-7022 的 fixed-ap-theta-half-budget 中 q=1、q=2 归约提供可复用的纯代数输入。对 q=2，任意加权奇类可分成模 4 的 1、3 类；对 q=1，仅在素数上非零的权额外加上 2 的有限范围指示项。原 BMOR 显式解析估计仍单独待证。
brief.en: Provides an exact algebraic input for reducing q=1 and q=2 in fixed-ap-theta-half-budget. The odd class modulo 2 splits into classes 1 and 3 modulo 4; a prime-supported total sum adds only the exceptional prime 2. The explicit BMOR analytic inequality remains open.

gaps.statement: ∀ (N D : ℕ) (η : ℕ → ℝ), let μ := fun d : ℕ => ((ArithmeticFunction.moebius d : ℤ) : ℝ); let Λ := ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt; let P := (Finset.range N).filter (fun p => Nat.Prime p ∧ Nat.Coprime p N); (∑ p ∈ P, η p * Λ (N - p)) = (-(∑ d ∈ (Finset.Icc 1 D).filter (fun d => Nat.Coprime d N), μ d * Real.log (d : ℝ) * ∑ p ∈ P.filter (fun p => p % d = N % d), η p)) + (-(∑ p ∈ P, η p * ∑ d ∈ (Nat.divisors (N - p)).filter (fun d => D < d), μ d * Real.log (d : ℝ)))

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 中央反射 · RD-7001 · 指定和的反射除数精确拆分
plain_statement.en: New route · Central reflection · RD-7001 · Exact reflected-divisor split for a designated sum

brief.zh: 把 Λ(N−p)=−∑_{d∣N−p} μ(d) log d 按 d≤D 与 d>D 精确拆分；对 (p,N)=1 的素数每个短除数自动满足 (d,N)=1 且 p≡N (mod d)，写成按模 d 单位剩余类分组的精确恒等式。
brief.en: Expand Λ(N−p)=−∑_{d∣N−p} μ(d) log d and split at d≤D vs d>D; for primes (p,N)=1 every short divisor is coprime to N and fixes p≡N (mod d), yielding an exact residue-class decomposition.

gaps.statement: ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ δ C : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧ δ < 1 ∧ 0 < C ∧ ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ X H : ℕ, N ≤ X → H ≤ X → (X:ℝ)^((7:ℝ)/120 + ε) < (H:ℝ) → ((((Finset.Icc (X-H) X).filter (fun n => 4 ≤ n ∧ Even n ∧ ∀ p ∈ Finset.range (n+1), ¬ (Nat.Prime p ∧ Nat.Prime (n-p)))).card):ℝ) ≤ C*(H:ℝ)^(1-δ)

plain_statement.zh: 在 Grimmelt 的全部短窗尺度上获得幂次例外界
plain_statement.en: Power saving throughout Grimmelt’s short-window range

brief.zh: 针对每个窗口的真实无表示偶数集，研究其 Fourier 变换与素数卷积的相关；在非负下界模型中定位只给对数节省的误差，争取一个依赖 ε 的幂次 δ。须对所有起点一致。改变 A 或仅缩短窗长的估计均不足。可按 imports 引用核验引理。
brief.en: Use the transform of the actual exceptional set in each window against the prime convolution. Isolate the logarithmic losses in the nonnegative minorant and seek a power gain depending on epsilon, uniformly in the endpoint. A larger fixed logarithmic saving or shorter windows alone do not suffice. Verified lemmas may be used according to task imports.

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · Li-Liu 1+1.9 加权筛 · SW-7001 · 交换筛的两个单边积分界
plain_statement.en: New route · Li-Liu 1+1.9 weighted sieve · SW-7001 · Edge-integral bounds for the switching sieve

brief.zh: 对应 Li–Liu 1+1.9 筛法的 g3、g8 系数解析上界：利用 exp 的泰勒下界给出 8 log(10/9) ≤ 0.84289，利用 log(1+u) 的奇次泰勒上界、精确长除与 log(4/3) 偶次下界给出 8 ∫_2^{8/3} log(t-1)/t dt ≤ 0.60962。
brief.en: Certify the analytic upper bounds for g3 and g8 in the Li–Liu 1+1.9 weighted sieve: 8 log(10/9) ≤ 0.84289 via Taylor lower bounds for exp, and 8 ∫_2^{8/3} log(t-1)/t dt ≤ 0.60962 via odd-degree Taylor upper bounds, exact division by 2+u, and an even-degree lower bound for log(4/3).

gaps.statement: ∀ (p b h a₁ a₂ c₁ c₂ : ℤ), 0 ≤ b → b^2 < p-b → 0 < h → p-b ≤ a₁ → a₁ ≤ a₂ → p-b ≤ c₁ → c₁ ≤ c₂ → Even (a₁+a₂) → Even (c₁+c₂) → a₁*a₂ = p^2+h → c₁*c₂ = p^2-h → ∃ k u v : ℤ, 0 < k ∧ p*k ≤ h ∧ 0 ≤ u ∧ 0 ≤ v ∧ a₁ = p+k-u ∧ a₂ = p+k+u ∧ c₁ = p-k-v ∧ c₂ = p-k+v ∧ u^2+v^2 = 2*k^2 ∧ |h-2*p*k| ≤ k^2

plain_statement.zh: 设 p、b、h 及四个因子均为整数，b≥0、b²<p−b、h>0。设 p²+h 与 p²−h 的两组因子各按升序排列，每组之和为偶数，且四个因子均不小于 p−b。则可分别写成 (p+k−u,p+k+u) 和 (p−k−v,p−k+v)，其中 k>0、u,v≥0、pk≤h、u²+v²=2k² 且 |h−2pk|≤k²。
plain_statement.en: Let p,b,h and four factors be integers with b≥0, b²<p−b and h>0. Suppose the ordered factor pairs for p²+h and p²−h each have even sum and all four factors are at least p−b. The pairs then have the forms (p+k−u,p+k+u) and (p−k−v,p−k+v) with k>0, u,v≥0, pk≤h, u²+v²=2k² and |h−2pk|≤k².

brief.zh: 对大奇素数 p 取 b=⌊√p⌋−1，可把深筛后两端均为合数的中央偏移归约为勾股数计数。一端是素数、另一端是合数的情形另需估计。
brief.en: With b=floor(sqrt(p))−1 for a large odd prime p, the lemma reduces the offsets with two surviving composites to a count of Pythagorean triples. Offsets with one prime and one composite require a separate estimate.

gaps.statement: let z := fun n : ℕ => ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n - (1 : ℝ); RiemannHypothesis → ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ N : ℕ, 2 ≤ N → |∑ a ∈ Finset.Icc 1 N, ∑ b ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (N-a), z a * z b| ≤ C*(N : ℝ)*(Real.log (N : ℝ))^2

plain_statement.zh: 只假设黎曼猜想，将正整数三角域 a+b≤N 上中心化冯·曼戈尔特乘积的有符号和控制在 O(N log² N)。
plain_statement.en: Under RH, bound the signed triangular sum of (Λ(a)−1)(Λ(b)−1) over positive a+b≤N by O(N log² N) with a sharp cutoff.

brief.zh: 对标 Goldston–Yang 定理 1 及证明中的中心化余项。展开乘积，单变量项可按 a≤N 的权 N−a 单独求和，余下双变量项正是本题。成功会把未平滑的哥德巴赫加权表示累加公式误差从 O(N log³ N) 降为 O(N log² N)。保留所有素数幂与端点；避免对各频段分别取绝对值而损失一次对数。累加估计仍允许单个偶数无表示。
brief.en: Compare Goldston–Yang, Theorem 1 and its centered remainder. Expanding the product separates the one-variable sum with weight N−a. Saving one logarithm in the residual would improve the sharp-cutoff summatory estimate while keeping the explicit zero term. Retain prime powers and the endpoints. Try cancellation between dyadic frequency bands before taking absolute values. This controls averages, leaving individual targets open.

gaps.statement: let θ := fun t : ℝ => ∑ p ∈ (Finset.Icc 2 ⌊t⌋₊).filter Nat.Prime, Real.log (p : ℝ); RiemannHypothesis → ∀ x δ : ℝ, (10 : ℝ)^13 ≤ x → 0 < δ → δ ≤ 1/(10 : ℝ)^13 → (intervalIntegral (fun y : ℝ => (θ ((1+δ)*y) - θ y - δ*y)^2) (1 : ℝ) x MeasureTheory.volume) ≤ (25571/10000 : ℝ)*δ*Real.log ((20001/10000 : ℝ)/δ)*x^2

plain_statement.zh: 在黎曼猜想假设下，保留定理 3 的 x、δ 范围及常数 2.5571，将素数切比雪夫函数短区间方差上界中的 log²(2.0001/δ) 改为一次对数。
plain_statement.en: Assuming RH, retain the exact range and coefficient of Theorem 3 while replacing log²(2.0001/δ) by one logarithm in the short-interval theta variance bound.

brief.zh: 对标《On Goldbach numbers in short intervals》定理 3。因 0<δ≤10⁻¹³，对数大于 1，故候选严格推出原界。可从显式公式的成对零点项出发保留相位，单独核对由 ψ 转成 θ 的素数幂误差。不准把额外的对相关猜想藏进假设。成功会在短窗缺素数的二阶矩预算中省去整项对数；转成哥德巴赫数的具体窗长还须重做反射估计。
brief.en: Compare Theorem 3 in On Goldbach numbers in short intervals. The logarithm exceeds one throughout the original range, so the candidate implies the old bound directly. Retain phases of zero pairs and control the prime-power correction in passing from psi to theta. No pair-correlation hypothesis is supplied. Revisit the reflected-window argument before claiming a new explicit Goldbach gap.

gaps.statement: (∀ (Q : ℕ) [NeZero Q] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ Q) (s : ℂ), 0 < s.re → s.re < 1 → DirichletCharacter.LFunction χ s = 0 → s.re = 1 / 2) → let w : ℕ → ℝ := fun k => if Nat.Prime k then Real.log (k : ℝ) else 0; let R := fun n : ℕ => Finset.sum (Finset.range (n + 1)) (fun p => w p * w (n - p)); let U := fun W n : ℕ => (Finset.range W).filter (fun a => Nat.Coprime a W ∧ Nat.Coprime (n + W - a) W); ∃ N₀ : ℕ, ∀ N W H : ℕ, N₀ ≤ N → Even N → 2 ≤ W → Even W → Squarefree W → W ^ 12 ≤ N → N ^ 2 ≤ H ^ 3 → W * H ≤ N → (N : ℝ) * H * W * ((U W N).card : ℝ) ≤ 16 * (Nat.totient W : ℝ) ^ 2 * (Finset.sum (Finset.range H) (fun h => R (N + h * W)))

plain_statement.zh: 假设 GRH。对每个充分大的偶数 N，在偶平方自由轮模 W 上，若 W¹²≤N、N²≤H³ 且 WH≤N，则 N,N+W,…,N+(H−1)W 的素数对数权表示数之和至少为 NHW·#U/(16φ(W)²)。U 是两端对 W 均互素的允许剩余类。
plain_statement.en: Assume GRH. For every sufficiently large even N, even squarefree W with W¹²≤N, and H with N²≤H³ and WH≤N, the prime-log representation counts at N+hW for 0≤h<H sum to at least NHW·#U/(16φ(W)²), where U counts admissible residue classes for the two summands.

brief.zh: 分别在 N/4 至 N/2 的左素数和其补数所在的同一个剩余类中使用 GRH 的算术级数估计。扣除真素数幂的误差后，两端主项相乘，再对全部允许类求和。
brief.en: Apply the GRH progression estimate first to left primes between N/4 and N/2, then to their complements in a single residue class over an interval of length WH. Remove proper prime powers, multiply the lower bounds and sum over admissible classes.

gaps.statement: ∀ (I : Finset ℕ) (K : ℕ) (b : ℕ → ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℂ) (r y : ℕ → ℝ) (G : ℕ → ℝ → ℂ), (∀ m ∈ I, b m < K) → (∀ m ∈ I, ‖f m‖ ≤ 1) → let B : ℕ → Finset ℕ := fun j => I.filter (fun m => b m = j); ‖∑ m ∈ I, f m * G m (r m)‖ ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range K, ‖∑ m ∈ B j, f m * G m (y j)‖ + ∑ j ∈ Finset.range K, ∑ m ∈ B j, ‖G m (r m) - G m (y j)‖ ∧ (∑ j ∈ Finset.range K, Real.sqrt ((B j).card : ℝ)) ≤ Real.sqrt (K : ℝ) * Real.sqrt (I.card : ℝ)

plain_statement.zh: 移动上界分箱端点冻结分解与子箱长度平方根预算
plain_statement.en: Moving-cutoff bin-freezing decomposition and square-root bin cardinality budget

brief.zh: 按分箱映射将求和拆为互斥纤维，在每箱插入冻结端点项并用三角不等式估计差值；第二式对常数列与箱长平方根应用实数柯西不等式。
brief.en: Fiber the sum by the bin map, insert the frozen value on each fiber with the triangle inequality, and apply real Cauchy-Schwarz to ones against square-root fiber cardinalities.

gaps.statement: let C := fun N : ℕ => (Finset.range N).filter (fun p => Nat.Prime p ∧ N < 3*p ∧ 3*p < 2*N ∧ 1 < N-p ∧ N < (N-p).minFac^5); ∀ N : ℕ, 2*(((C N).filter (fun p => Nat.Prime (N-p))).card:ℝ) = ((C N).card:ℝ) - (C N).sum (fun p => (ArithmeticFunction.liouville (N-p) : ℝ)) - 2*(((C N).filter (fun p => ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors (N-p) = 3)).card:ℝ)

plain_statement.zh: 对每个自然数 N，令 M 为同一候选数，L 为补数的 Liouville 符号和，T 为恰含三个素因子的补数计数，P 为素数补数计数，则 2P=M−L−2T。
plain_statement.en: At every N on this common support, twice the number of prime complements equals the total count minus the Liouville sum minus twice the number with three prime factors.

brief.zh: 最小素因子的五次幂大于 N，因此补数的素因子个数只能是 1、2、3、4。逐项检验 Liouville 符号并求和，保留恰有三个素因子的扣减。
brief.en: The fifth power of the least prime factor exceeds N, so the multiplicity count is one, two, three or four. Sum the exact indicator identity over the shared candidates, including the subtraction for triples.

gaps.statement: let C := fun N : ℕ => (Finset.range N).filter (fun p => Nat.Prime p ∧ N < 3*p ∧ 3*p < 2*N ∧ 1 < N-p ∧ N < (N-p).minFac^5); ∃ η : ℝ, 0 < η ∧ η < 2/5 ∧ ∃ N₀ : ℕ, ∀ N : ℕ, N₀ ≤ N → Even N → (C N).sum (fun p => (ArithmeticFunction.liouville (N-p) : ℝ)) ≤ (2/5-η)*((C N).card:ℝ)

plain_statement.zh: 存在固定的 0<η<2/5，对每个充分大偶数 N，同一粗糙候选集 C 上补数的 Liouville 符号之和至多为 (2/5−η)|C|。
plain_statement.en: For one fixed 0<η<2/5 and every sufficiently large even N, the sum of the Liouville signs of the complements on the same sifted set is at most (2/5−η)|C|.

brief.zh: 对各个指定偶数单侧控制 p 为素数时的 λ(N−p)。该和包括三个和四个素因子的补数；粗糙集合中不可预先只保留素数及半素数。文献提供相关的莫比乌斯扭曲分布思路，并未证明这个 Liouville 预算。
brief.en: Control the signed sum at each specified N. Complements with three or four prime factors remain in the common support. Huang and Li study related Möbius-twisted distribution estimates. Their paper does not supply this Liouville budget.

gaps.statement: let C := fun N : ℕ => (Finset.range N).filter (fun p => Nat.Prime p ∧ N < 3*p ∧ 3*p < 2*N ∧ 1 < N-p ∧ N < (N-p).minFac^5); ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∃ N₀ : ℕ, ∀ N : ℕ, N₀ ≤ N → Even N → c*(N:ℝ) ≤ ((C N).card:ℝ)*(Real.log (N:ℝ))^2

plain_statement.zh: 对每个充分大偶数 N，中央三分区间的素数 p 中，至少有 cN/(log N)² 个的补数 N−p 没有不超过 N 的五次方根的素因子。
plain_statement.en: For every sufficiently large even N, at least cN/(log N)² central primes p have complement with least prime factor greater than the fifth root of N, for one absolute c>0.

brief.zh: 在 p 与 N−p 同时位于开中央三分区间的条件下筛去 N−p 的小素因子。维数一线性下界筛以略低于平方根的分布水平筛到五次方根，保留绝对正常数。此节点只计粗糙补数。
brief.en: Sieve the complements of primes in the open middle third. A dimension-one lower-bound sieve at a level just below the square root has sieve parameter strictly above two at this cutoff. This node counts all rough complements.

gaps.statement: let C := fun N : ℕ => (Finset.range N).filter (fun p => Nat.Prime p ∧ N < 3*p ∧ 3*p < 2*N ∧ 1 < N-p ∧ N < (N-p).minFac^5); ∀ N z : ℕ, 1 ≤ z → z^5 ≤ N → z*((C N).filter (fun p => ¬ Squarefree (N-p))).card ≤ N

plain_statement.zh: 对任意自然数 N 和满足 1≤z、z⁵≤N 的整数 z，令 D 为中央粗糙候选集中补数有素数平方因子的候选数。则 zD≤N。
plain_statement.en: For all natural numbers N and z with 1≤z and z⁵≤N, let D count central rough candidates whose complement is divisible by the square of a prime. Then zD≤N.

brief.zh: 每个这样的补数 n 都有素数平方 q² 整除它，且 q>z。映射 p↦N−p 在候选集上单射。对 z<q≤√N 的所有整数 q，将各自的正倍数个数相加即得上界。用 1/q²≤1/(q−1)−1/q 求和。取 z 为 N 的五次方根的整数部分，得 D=O(N⁴ᐟ⁵)。Liouville 与 Möbius 和之差的绝对值、含重复素因子的三因子补数个数均至多为 D。
brief.en: Each such complement n has q² dividing n for some prime q>z. Reflection is injective on the candidates. Bound the count by summing the number of positive multiples of q² over all integers z<q≤√N. The inequality 1/q²≤1/(q−1)−1/q telescopes. Taking the integer part of the fifth root gives D=O(N^(4/5)). Both the absolute difference of the Liouville and Möbius sums and the count of triples with a repeated prime factor are at most D.

gaps.statement: let C := fun N : ℕ => (Finset.range N).filter (fun p => Nat.Prime p ∧ N < 3*p ∧ 3*p < 2*N ∧ 1 < N-p ∧ N < (N-p).minFac^5); ∃ N₀ : ℕ, ∀ N : ℕ, N₀ ≤ N → Even N → 10*((C N).filter (fun p => ArithmeticFunction.cardFactors (N-p) = 3)).card ≤ 3*(C N).card

plain_statement.zh: 对每个充分大偶数 N，同一中央粗糙候选集 C 中，补数恰有三个素因子（按重数计）的候选数至多为 3|C|/10。
plain_statement.en: Uniformly for sufficiently large even N, at most three tenths of these same central rough candidates have complement with exactly three prime factors counted with multiplicity.

brief.zh: 在同一个筛后集合上计数 N−p=uvw，u≤v≤w 为大于五次方根的素数，包含重复因子。目标是相对于实际候选数的上界；给定分母的比例尚待证明。
brief.en: Bound the ordered-by-size factor triples N−p=uvw with prime u≤v≤w above the cutoff, allowing repetitions. The denominator is the actual sifted count at the same N. The three-tenths budget is a proposed estimate.

gaps.statement: let E (x : ℝ) := Complex.exp (((2 * Real.pi * x : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I); ∀ (M N : ℕ) (x : Fin M → ℝ) (δ : ℝ) (a : ℕ → ℂ), 0 < δ → (∀ i j : Fin M, i ≠ j → δ ≤ |x i - x j - ((round (x i - x j) : ℤ) : ℝ)|) → (∑ i : Fin M, ‖∑ k ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), a k * E ((k : ℝ) * x i)‖ ^ 2) ≤ ((N : ℝ) + max 1 (2 / δ)) * ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), ‖a k‖ ^ 2

plain_statement.en: For M points separated modulo one by δ > 0, the squared samples of a trigonometric polynomial on frequencies 0 through N sum to at most (N + max(1, 2/δ)) times its coefficient energy.
plain_statement.zh: 对模一间距至少为 δ > 0 的 M 个点，频率从 0 至 N 的三角多项式在这些点上的取值模平方之和至多为系数平方和的 N + max(1, 2/δ) 倍。

brief.en: Average the dual sum over translates of the frequency interval. A reciprocal-square bound on each row controls the off-diagonal terms, and duality gives coefficient one on N.
brief.zh: 在频率区间的平移上平均对偶和，以每行的倒数平方和控制非对角项，再由对偶性得到 N 项的系数一。
