plain_statement.en: Assume that on the whole unit interval the specified circle model approximates the prime-log sum with error at most C n^(3/4) L(n)^k eventually. For each ε > 0, at most X^(1/2 + ε) even integers from 4 through X then lack a two-prime representation, for all sufficiently large X.
plain_statement.zh: 设所给圆法模型在整个单位区间对素数对数和的误差最终至多为 C n^(3/4) L(n)^k。则对任意 ε > 0，当 X 充分大时，4 至 X 中至多有 X^(1/2 + ε) 个偶数不能表示为两素数之和。

brief.en: Apply the variance bound to the uniform model hypothesis, pass from dyadic blocks to the cumulative count, and recognize an exception by the empty computable set of prime summands.
brief.zh: 对全区间的模型假设应用方差界，从二进区间推广到累积计数，并用可计算的素数加数集合是否为空判定例外。

gaps.statement: ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → let e := fun u : ℝ => Complex.exp (((2 * Real.pi * u : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I); let w := fun k : ℕ => if Nat.Prime k then Real.log (k : ℝ) else 0; let Q := fun n : ℕ => ⌊(n : ℝ) ^ (1 / 3 : ℝ)⌋₊; let H : ℕ → ℕ := fun n => 256 * Q n * (Nat.log 2 (n + 2)) ^ 2; ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, N ≤ n → ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, (¬ ∃ q a : ℕ, 1 ≤ q ∧ q ≤ Q n ∧ a ≤ q ∧ Nat.Coprime a q ∧ |t - (a : ℝ) / q| ≤ (H n : ℝ) / ((q : ℝ) * n)) → ‖∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (w k : ℂ) * e ((k : ℝ) * t)‖ ≤ (n : ℝ) ^ (5 / 6 + ε)

plain_statement.en: For every ε > 0 and all sufficiently large n, the prime-log sum on the minor arcs has norm at most n^(5/6 + ε). The denominator cutoff is the floor of the cube root of n, and the windows have the stated logarithmic width.
plain_statement.zh: 对任意 ε > 0 及充分大的 n，次弧上素数对数指数和的范数至多为 n^(5/6 + ε)。分母上限为 n 的立方根的下取整，窗口宽度含有给定的对数因子。

brief.en: Apply the rational-approximation bound outside the windows of width 256 Q (log₂(n+2))²/(q n), with the integral dyadic logarithm. Absorb the remaining logarithmic factors into n^ε.
brief.zh: 在宽度为 256 Q (log₂(n+2))²/(q n) 的窗口之外应用有理逼近估计，其中对数取整数部分，再将其余对数因子吸收到 n^ε 中。

gaps.statement: ∃ C : ℝ, 0<C ∧ ∀ T D : ℕ, 2≤T → (∑ d ∈ (Finset.Icc 3 D).filter (fun d => Odd d ∧ (∀ p ∈ d.primeFactors, d.factorization p ≤ 1) ∧ T < orderOf (2 : ZMod d)), 1/((d:ℝ)*(orderOf (2 : ZMod d):ℝ))) ≤ C*Real.log (2*(T:ℝ))/(T:ℝ)

plain_statement.zh: 文献推论：大乘法阶的平方自由模数贡献有可截断尾界
plain_statement.en: Literature corollary: a truncation bound for squarefree moduli of large order

brief.zh: 将论文式 (26) 按阶的二倍区间求和，核对奇数平方自由筛选、大于 T 的严格端点及与 D 无关的常数。
brief.en: Sum equation (26) over dyadic order intervals. Track squarefreeness, the strict cutoff and uniformity in the modulus bound D.

gaps.statement: let A := fun h : ℕ => ∏ p ∈ (2^h-1 : ℕ).primeFactors.filter (fun p => 2<p), (1 + 1/((p:ℝ)-2)); ∃ C : ℝ, 0<C ∧ ∀ L : ℕ, (∑ h ∈ Finset.Icc 1 L, A h) ≤ C*(L:ℝ)

plain_statement.zh: 估计候选：幂差的双素数筛局部代价具有有界平均
plain_statement.en: Candidate estimate: bounded average local sieve cost of power differences

brief.zh: 将乘积展开到平方自由因子，按 2 的乘法阶重新计数；目标是去掉逐项取最大值带来的损失。论文的加权幂差估计可作入口。
brief.en: Expand over squarefree divisors and count exponent multiples of their orders. Compare with the paper's weighted difference estimate instead of using a worst-case divisor product.

gaps.statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (c : Finset ℕ → ℝ), c ∅ = 1 → (∀ T ∈ (Finset.range m).powerset, -1 ≤ c T) → (1 / 2 : ℝ) < Finset.sum (Finset.range m).powerset (fun T => c T * Finset.prod T (fun j => 1 / (4 * ((j : ℝ) + 1)^2)))

plain_statement.zh: 对任意自然数 m，给 {j ∈ ℕ | j < m} 的每个子集 T 指定实系数 c(T)。若 c(∅)=1 且所有 c(T)≥−1，则各子集的 c(T)·∏_{j∈T} 1/[4(j+1)²] 之和严格大于 1/2。
plain_statement.en: For any natural m, assign a real coefficient c(T) to each subset T of the natural indices j < m. If c(∅) = 1 and every c(T) ≥ −1, the sum of c(T) times the product of 1/[4(j+1)²] over j in T is strictly greater than 1/2.

brief.zh: 将 ∏_{j<m}(1+1/[4(j+1)²]) 展开，并用归纳法证明其至多为 (3m+2)/(2m+2)。由此可控制所有非空子集的总权重。在奇素数 p=2j+3 处，单项权重为 1/(p−1)²，取零系数可表示对平方自由分母的截断。
brief.en: Expand the product of 1+1/[4(j+1)²] over j < m and bound it by (3m+2)/(2m+2) by induction. This controls the combined weight of the nonempty subsets. At an odd prime p = 2j+3 the weight is 1/(p−1)², and zero coefficients can encode a cutoff on squarefree denominators.

plain_statement.zh: B13 的双侧 Vaughan 余项归约
plain_statement.en: Bilateral Vaughan reduction for B13

brief.zh: 保持每个充分大偶数的量词。第一带把 Mangoldt 因子换为阈值 n^(1/96) 的截断卷积长项。第三带只在右侧余因子超过 floor(n^(33/64)) 时作阈值 n^(1/256) 的对应替换。用两侧 Type-I 散项的 o(n) 界证明两向归约。
brief.en: Keep the quantifier over sufficiently large even n. Replace the first-band Mangoldt factor by the long convolution at n^(1/96). Apply the corresponding n^(1/256) expansion in the third band for right cofactors above floor(n^(33/64)). Bound the discarded Type-I terms by o(n) in both directions.

gaps.statement:
let Λ := ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt
    let μ := fun d : ℕ => ((ArithmeticFunction.moebius d : ℤ) : ℝ)
    let U := fun n : ℕ => ⌊(n:ℝ)^(1/16:ℝ)⌋₊
    let B₁ := fun n : ℕ => ⌊(n:ℝ)^(1/4:ℝ)⌋₊
    let B₂ := fun n : ℕ => ⌊(n:ℝ)^(1/3:ℝ)⌋₊
    let B₃ := fun n : ℕ => ⌊(n:ℝ)^(2/3:ℝ)⌋₊
    let M := (ArithmeticFunction.moebius : ArithmeticFunction ℝ)
    let truncate : ArithmeticFunction ℝ → ℕ → ArithmeticFunction ℝ := fun f H => ⟨fun m => if m ≤ H then f m else 0, by simp⟩
    let PL := fun n : ℕ => ⌊(n : ℝ) ^ (1 / 96 : ℝ)⌋₊
    let PR := fun n : ℕ => ⌊(n : ℝ) ^ (1 / 256 : ℝ)⌋₊
    let K := fun n : ℕ => ⌊(n : ℝ) ^ (33 / 64 : ℝ)⌋₊
    let Lcap := fun n : ℕ => ⌊(n : ℝ) ^ (3 / 10 : ℝ)⌋₊
    let split := fun n : ℕ => ⌊(n : ℝ) ^ (7 / 12 : ℝ)⌋₊
    let stepCap := fun n : ℕ => U n * ⌊(n : ℝ) ^ (111 / 256 : ℝ)⌋₊
    let F := fun (P : ℕ) => ((M - truncate M P) * (Λ - truncate Λ P) : ArithmeticFunction ℝ)
    let u := fun i : ℕ × ℕ => i.1 * i.2
    let vl := fun j : (Σ _ : ℕ, ℕ) => j.2 * j.1
    let vh := fun j : (Σ _ : ℕ, ℕ × ℕ) => j.1 * j.2.1 * j.2.2
    let X := fun n : ℕ => (((Finset.Ioc (U n) (B₁ n) ×ˢ Finset.Icc 1 n).filter (fun i => Lcap n < u i)).filter (fun i => u i ≤ n))
    let Y := fun n : ℕ => (Finset.Ioc (U n) (min n (K n))).sigma (fun b => Finset.Icc 1 (min (U n) (n / b)))
    let Z := fun n : ℕ => ((Finset.Icc 1 (U n)).sigma (fun d => Finset.Ioc (B₂ n / d) (min (split n / d) (n / (K n + 1) / d)) ×ˢ Finset.Icc 1 n)).filter (fun j => vh j ≤ n)
    let w := fun (n : ℕ) (i : ℕ × ℕ) => ((∑ d ∈ (Nat.divisors i.1).filter (fun d => U n < d), μ d : ℝ) : ℂ) * (F (PL n) i.2 : ℂ)
    let errorPart := fun (n g h a b c d : ℕ) => (let e := g.gcd h; let A := max (a : ℤ) (((n : ℤ) - (h : ℤ)*d - 1)/(g : ℤ)); let B := min (b : ℤ) (((n : ℤ) - (h : ℤ)*((c : ℤ)+1))/(g : ℤ)); let m : ℤ := (h/e : ℕ); let z := ((n/e : ℕ) : ℤ) * Nat.gcdA (g/e) (h/e) % m; if e ∣ n then (if A ≤ B then ((((A-z)%m : ℤ) : ℝ) - (((B-z)%m : ℤ) : ℝ))/(m : ℝ) else 0) else 0)
    let expandedCap := fun n : ℕ => ⌊(n : ℝ)^(511/768 : ℝ)⌋₊
    let productCap := fun n : ℕ => 2*⌊(n : ℝ)^(4097/4096 : ℝ)⌋₊
    let inside := fun (n u v : ℕ) =>
      (stepCap n^2 < u*v ∧ u.gcd v ≤ stepCap n) ∧ u*v ≤ productCap n
    let insideLow := fun n : ℕ =>
      ∑ i ∈ (X n).filter (fun i => u i ≤ expandedCap n),
      ∑ j ∈ ((Y n).filter (fun j => ¬j.1 ∣ n)).filter (fun j => vl j ≤ expandedCap n),
        @ite ℂ (inside n (u i) (vl j)) (Classical.propDecidable _) (w n i*((-(μ j.2 : ℂ))*(Λ j.1 : ℂ))*
          (errorPart n (u i) (vl j) 0 (n/u i) 0 (min (B₃ n/j.2) (n/vl j)) : ℂ)) 0
    let insideHigh := fun n : ℕ =>
      ∑ i ∈ (X n).filter (fun i => u i ≤ expandedCap n),
      ∑ j ∈ (Z n).filter (fun j => vh j ≤ expandedCap n),
        @ite ℂ (inside n (u i) (vh j)) (Classical.propDecidable _) (w n i*((-(μ j.1 : ℂ))*(F (PR n) j.2.2 : ℂ))*
          (errorPart n (u i) (vh j) 0 (n/u i) (K n/j.2.2) (n/vh j) : ℂ)) 0
    let residual := fun n => insideLow n + insideHigh n
    ∀ e : ℝ, 0 < e → ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, N ≤ n → Even n → ‖residual n‖ ≤ e * (n : ℝ)

plain_statement.zh: B13 界内有界乘积的同余计数误差为 o(n)
plain_statement.en: Saving for the bounded-product residue discrepancy in B13

brief.zh: 对两步长至多 floor(n^(511/768))、乘积至多 2 floor(n^(4097/4096)) 的低段和高段求和。保留同余归约的乘积下界和公因数条件，以及低段右因子不整除 n 的条件。证明带权同余误差的复范数为 o(n)。
brief.en: Sum the low and high weighted residue discrepancies for both steps at most floor(n^(511/768)) and product at most 2 floor(n^(4097/4096)). Keep the product lower cutoff, the gcd restriction and the low right cofactor exclusion from the residue reduction. Bound the complex norm by o(n).

          (errorPart n (u i) (vl j) 0 (n/u i) 0 (min (B₃ n/j.2) (n/vl j)) : ℂ)) 0
    let retainedHigh := fun n : ℕ =>
      ∑ i ∈ (X n).filter (fun i => u i ≤ expandedCap n),
      ∑ j ∈ (Z n).filter (fun j => vh j ≤ expandedCap n),
        @ite ℂ (retained n (u i) (vh j)) (Classical.propDecidable _) (w n i*((-(μ j.1 : ℂ))*(F (PR n) j.2.2 : ℂ))*

plain_statement.zh: B13 界内大乘积中高次素数幂和大公因数项的贡献为 o(n)
plain_statement.en: Saving for proper prime powers and large gcd slices at large products in B13

brief.zh: 在相同步长界内、乘积超过 2 floor(n^(4097/4096)) 时，证明原和减保留和的复范数为 o(n)。低段保留素数右因子，两段共同保留 gcd(u,v)≤floor(n^(1/4096))、gcd(u,n)≤floor(n^(1/2048))、gcd(v,n)≤floor(n^(1/128)) 的项。
brief.en: Keep both step caps and restrict to products above 2 floor(n^(4097/4096)). Bound by o(n) the difference between the original and retained sums. Keep prime right cofactors in the low range and the cuts gcd(u,v)≤floor(n^(1/4096)), gcd(u,n)≤floor(n^(1/2048)), and gcd(v,n)≤floor(n^(1/128)) in both ranges.

plain_statement.zh: B13 从 Vaughan 余项到同余计数误差的归约
plain_statement.en: Reduction of the B13 Vaughan remainder to residue discrepancies

brief.zh: 从双侧 Vaughan 余项出发，处理短乘积、大公因数和整除 n 的右侧低段因子。两步长至多 floor(n^(511/768)) 时用加权同余计数误差替代深弧项，界外保留格点计数减宽主弧积分。保留两个方向及充分大偶数的量词。
brief.en: Start with the bilateral Vaughan remainder. Control short products, large common divisors and the low right cofactors dividing n. For two steps at most floor(n^(511/768)), keep the weighted residue discrepancy. Beyond that cap, retain the lattice count minus the wide-major-arc integral. Preserve the equivalence and the quantifier over sufficiently large even n.

plain_statement.en: New route · Signed factors and shift windows · FW-8001 · Unfold a Vaughan band into a product-truncated double sum

brief.en: Use m=ab and the exact floors, including m=0 and empty intervals. Substituting the first three bands serves all six core cells.

plain_statement.en: New route · Signed factors and shift windows · FW-9001 · Transport a weighted factor box to its exact Bézout interval

brief.zh: 对 gcd 整除的纤维用 Bézout 解定位原点，把两个闭区间分别取整并求交。权可取截断 Möbius 除数和与两份 Mangoldt 权的乘积，取常数 1 得到实际纤维数。FW-9002 使用同一组端点。
brief.en: Use a Bézout solution on each compatible fiber. Intersect both integer ranges using floor division. Weight one gives the actual multiplicity. The same interval transports truncated Möbius and Mangoldt weights into FW-9002.

brief.en: The determinant step on a nonempty fiber is n/g. Each point has at most 2⌊Hg/n⌋ neighbors. Apply 2|uv|≤u²+v² in both orders to retain the actual squared weights. Set A=⌊n^(1/3)⌋+1 and B=⌊n^(2/3)⌋ for band three. Far shells and wide arcs need separate estimates.

brief.en: Use exact division of the steps and expand. The determinant off the diagonal grows with the target.

plain_statement.en: New route · Signed factors and shift windows · FW-8006 · Parametrize the integer solutions on a factor line

brief.zh: 除以公因子后使用约化步长互素。证明所有整点恰落在这个参数族内，再将带限交给参数区间。
brief.en: Divide by the gcd and use coprimality of the reduced steps. Prove both directions for all integers before imposing band limits.

plain_statement.en: New route · Signed factors and shift windows · FW-8008 · Bound the near-diagonal energy of a finite fiber

brief.zh: 固定 i 后注入长度 2D 的双侧非零移位集，再用绝对值和与权上界。全局预算还须乘上每类纤维的实际数量。
brief.en: For each i, inject the adjacent indices into the 2D nonzero offsets. Apply the absolute weight bound. The global budget also needs the number of fibers in each range.

gaps.statement: let Λ := ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt; ∀ (n a b U : ℕ), 0 < a → 0 < b → let g := Nat.gcd a b; (∑ r ∈ Finset.Ioc U (n/a), ∑ s ∈ (Finset.Ioc U (n/b)).filter (fun s => a*r+b*s=n), Λ r * Λ s) = if g ∣ n then ∑ r ∈ (Finset.Ioc U (n/a)).filter (fun r => (a/g)*r % (b/g) = (n/g) % (b/g) ∧ U < (n-a*r)/b), Λ r * Λ ((n-a*r)/b) else 0

brief.en: Fix a,b. Divide by the gcd before taking the congruence. Divisibility and ar≤n determine the other cofactor and its endpoints. This treats the full-circle diagonal. The wide-arc subtraction remains.

brief.en: Keep the weights and mask at n before interchanging the sum and integral. The existing kernel bounds frequencies away from half-integers. A separate one-sided loss remains at n.

plain_statement.en: New route · Signed factors and shift windows · FW-8003 · Lower-bound the support of a normalized even-shift kernel

brief.en: Apply Cauchy–Schwarz to the unit mass and insert the frozen energy budget. This excludes short windows. Transfer to n is a separate estimate.

brief.en: Use orthogonality of integer frequencies on the full interval. Subtract the finite union of measurable wide arcs. Keep the frozen cutoffs and complex value when comparing with GSP.

brief.en: Fix d before choosing the constant and threshold, uniformly in the admissible classes. Formalize the short-interval prime distribution input and weighted linear sieve or provide an independent proof. The source gives parameters, remainder sums and checked finite factor-count lemmas. The smaller summand may be composite.

plain_statement.en: TH-8001 · Theta reflection · Sharp minimum ordered overlap with prescribed residue counts

plain_statement.en: New route · Theta reflection · TH-0092 · Indefinite unitary reflection pairing and spacelike norm identity

brief.zh: 将零频分量并入完整离散傅里叶和，利用模 N 几何级数正交性分别导出和为 N 的反射卷积与对角平方和。 对应 Theta 反射路线的签名几何约束。
brief.en: Merge the zero mode into the full discrete Fourier sum and apply modulo-N geometric-series orthogonality to evaluate both the reflected sum n+m=N and the Plancherel norm.

gaps.statement: let E := fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (((2*Real.pi*x:ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.I); ∀ (h : ℕ) (θ : ℝ), ((‖∑ j ∈ Finset.range h, E (2*(j:ℝ)*θ)‖^2 : ℝ) : ℂ) = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range h, ∑ j ∈ Finset.range h, E (2*((i:ℝ)-(j:ℝ))*θ)

plain_statement.zh: Fejér 核的平方等于差变量双和：‖∑ᵢE(2iθ)‖² = ∑ᵢⱼE(2(i−j)θ)。
plain_statement.en: The Fejér kernel square equals a two-variable difference sum: ‖∑ᵢE(2iθ)‖² = ∑ᵢⱼE(2(i−j)θ).

brief.zh: 用 ‖z‖² = z·conj z、conj(E x) = E(−x)、E x·E y = E(x+y) 三项展开，是角胞 L⁴ 交叉项的纯代数一步。仍缺：交叉项在宽弧之外的积分估计。
brief.en: Expand with ‖z‖² = z·conj z, conj(E x) = E(−x) and E x·E y = E(x+y); this is the purely algebraic step behind the L⁴ cross terms. Still missing: the estimate of those cross terms off the wide arcs.

gaps.statement: let μ := fun d : ℕ => ((ArithmeticFunction.moebius d : ℤ) : ℝ); ∀ (a U : ℕ), 1 < a → (∑ d ∈ (Nat.divisors a).filter (fun d => U < d), μ d) = - ∑ d ∈ (Nat.divisors a).filter (fun d => d ≤ U), μ d

plain_statement.zh: Möbius 截断恒等式：a>1 时，除数上 d>U 的 μ 和等于 d≤U 的 μ 和的相反数。
plain_statement.en: Truncated Möbius identity: for a>1, the μ-sum over divisors d>U is minus the μ-sum over d≤U.

brief.zh: 对 a>1 有 ∑_{d|a} μ(d)=0，按 d≤U 与 d>U 切开即得；这是 Vaughan 平滑系数 τ₁ 的算术核心。仍缺：截断短和的均方或大筛估计。
brief.en: Use ∑_{d|a} μ(d)=0 for a>1 and split divisors at U; this is the arithmetic core of the Vaughan coefficient τ₁. Still missing: mean-square or large-sieve estimates for the truncated sum.

gaps.statement: let Q₁ := fun n : ℕ => ⌊(n:ℝ)^(1/3:ℝ)⌋₊; let Q := fun n : ℕ => (Nat.log 2 (n+2))^2; let H := fun n : ℕ => 256 * Q₁ n * Q n; let wideArcs := fun n : ℕ => {t : ℝ | ∃ q a : ℕ, 1≤q ∧ q≤Q₁ n ∧ a≤q ∧ Nat.Coprime a q ∧ |t-(a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ)| ≤ (H n:ℝ)/((q:ℝ)*(n:ℝ))}; ∀ n : ℕ, IsClosed (wideArcs n)

plain_statement.zh: 宽弧带 wideArcs n 是闭集：它是有限个闭区间的并。
plain_statement.en: The wide-arc band wideArcs n is closed: a finite union of closed intervals.

brief.zh: 把 q≤Q₁ n、a≤q 两重存在量词写成有限并，每段 {t | |t−a/q| ≤ H/(qn)} 是闭区间，再用有限并的闭性。用于说明角胞积分的指标函数可测、补集为开集。仍缺：这些弧的总测度与例外模数估计。
brief.en: Rewrite the two existential quantifiers over q≤Q₁ n and a≤q as a finite union, note each piece {t | |t−a/q| ≤ H/(qn)} is a closed interval, and apply closedness under finite unions. This makes the indicator measurable and its complement open. Still missing: total arc measure and exceptional moduli.

gaps.statement: let reps (n : ℕ) := (Finset.range (n + 1)).filter (fun p => Nat.Prime p ∧ Nat.Prime (n - p)); (∀ A : ℝ, 0 < A → ∃ X₀ : ℕ, ∀ X : ℕ, X₀ ≤ X → (((Finset.range (X + 1)).filter (fun n => 4 ≤ n ∧ Even n ∧ (reps n).card = 0)).card : ℝ) ≤ (X : ℝ) * (Real.log (X : ℝ)) ^ (-A)) ∧ Filter.Tendsto (fun X : ℕ => (((Finset.range (X + 1)).filter (fun n => 4 ≤ n ∧ Even n ∧ (reps n).card = 0)).card : ℝ) / (X : ℝ)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)

plain_statement.en: For every A > 0, the number of even integers from 4 through X having no two-prime representation is eventually at most X/(log X)ᴬ. Their natural density is zero.
plain_statement.zh: 对每个 A > 0，当 X 充分大时，从 4 到 X 不能表示为两素数之和的偶数至多有 X/(log X)ᴬ 个，其自然密度为零。

brief.en: Count the empty computable sets of prime summands. The dyadic exceptional-set estimates give the cumulative logarithmic bound and its density limit.
brief.zh: 用可计算的素数加数集合判定例外。由二进区间的例外估计得到累积的对数幂上界及密度极限。

gaps.statement: let w (k : ℕ) := if Nat.Prime k then Real.log (k : ℝ) else 0; let E (x : ℝ) := Complex.exp (((2 * Real.pi * x : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I); let S (n : ℕ) (u : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ℝ) := ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (u k : ℂ) * E ((k : ℝ) * t); let Qpow (B n : ℕ) := (Nat.log 2 (n + 2)) ^ B; let arcsPoly (B n : ℕ) := {t : ℝ | ∃ q a : ℕ, 1 ≤ q ∧ q ≤ Qpow B n ∧ a ≤ q ∧ Nat.Coprime a q ∧ |t - (a : ℝ) / q| ≤ (Qpow B n : ℝ) / ((q : ℝ) * n)}; ∀ A : ℝ, 0 < A → ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, N ≤ n → ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1, t ∉ arcsPoly (2 * ⌈A⌉₊ + 16) n → ‖S n ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt t‖ ≤ (n : ℝ) * (Real.log (n : ℝ)) ^ (-A) ∧ ‖S n w t‖ ≤ (n : ℝ) * (Real.log (n : ℝ)) ^ (-A)

plain_statement.en: For every A > 0, the von Mangoldt and prime-log sums both have norm at most n/(log n)ᴬ on the specified minor arcs for all sufficiently large n. The cutoff exponent is 2⌈A⌉ + 16.
plain_statement.zh: 对每个 A > 0，当 n 充分大时，冯·曼戈尔特和及素数对数和在所给次弧上的范数均至多为 n/(log n)ᴬ。分母截断的指数为 2⌈A⌉ + 16。

brief.en: Approximate the frequency by a reduced fraction and apply the rational exponential-sum bound. The minor-arc cutoff restricts the denominator at both ends.
brief.zh: 用既约分数逼近频率，再应用有理逼近处的指数和估计。次弧条件同时限制分母的上下界。

gaps.statement: ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, N ≤ n → Odd n → ∃ p q r : ℕ, Nat.Prime p ∧ Nat.Prime q ∧ Nat.Prime r ∧ p + q + r = n

plain_statement.en: Every sufficiently large odd integer is a sum of three primes.
plain_statement.zh: 每个充分大的奇数都可以表示为三个素数之和。

brief.en: A positive lower bound for the ternary Fourier coefficient gives a positive term in the prime-log triple convolution and hence three prime summands.
brief.zh: 三元傅里叶系数的正下界保证素数对数三重卷积中有正项，从而给出三个素数加数。

gaps.statement: let S := fun (N : ℕ) (x : ℝ) => ∑ m ∈ Finset.range N, ((ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt m : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.exp (((2*Real.pi*(m : ℝ)*x : ℝ) : ℂ)*Complex.I); ∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → ∃ N₀ : ℕ, ∀ N q : ℕ, N₀ ≤ N → 2 ≤ N → ∀ a : ℤ, ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < q → q^2 ≤ N → Nat.Coprime a.natAbs q → let e := |x - (a : ℝ)/(q : ℝ)|; e ≤ 1/((q : ℝ)*Real.sqrt (N : ℝ)) → let B := max (q : ℝ) ((q : ℝ)*(N : ℝ)*e); ‖S N x‖ ≤ (N : ℝ)^η * (N : ℝ)/Real.sqrt B

plain_statement.zh: 对每个 Dirichlet 有理逼近 x=a/q+e，证明 Mangoldt 指数和只有 N^(1+o(1))/√B 这一项，其中 B=max(q,qN|e|)，q²≤N 且 |e|≤1/(q√N)。
plain_statement.en: Prove uniform denominator decay N^(1+o(1))/sqrt(B) for the Mangoldt exponential sum at every Dirichlet approximation x=a/q+e with q²≤N, |e|≤1/(q sqrt N), and B=max(q,qN|e|).

brief.zh: 与 Maynard–Pandey–Radziwiłł 定理 1.1 的全部参数对齐，挑战是去掉独立的 N^(19/24) 项。原定理已覆盖 B≤N^(5/12) 的尺度；优先处理大 B，尤其靠近 √N 的 Type II 项。终点得到 N^(3/4+o(1)) 的逐点界。用于小弧大值分析时仍须处理低分母区；单个指数和上界也不直接控制每个偶数的带符号傅里叶系数。 综合该文比较的 Kumchev 界，B≤N^(9/20) 的范围也已覆盖。
brief.en: The extra N^(19/24) term in the 2026 theorem is absorbed for B≤N^(5/12). Concentrate on the Type II estimates beyond this threshold. At B near sqrt N the requested exponent is 3/4. This sharpens large-value budgets on high-denominator arcs; low denominators and the signed target coefficient still need separate estimates. Kumchev's alternative estimate in the same introduction already covers B≤N^(9/20).

gaps.statement: let S := fun (N : ℕ) (x : ℝ) => ∑ m ∈ Finset.range N, ((ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt m : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.exp (((2*Real.pi*(m : ℝ)*x : ℝ) : ℂ)*Complex.I); ∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → ∃ N₀ : ℕ, ∀ N p : ℕ, N₀ ≤ N → 2 ≤ N → Nat.Prime p → let q := p^2; q^2 ≤ N → N ≤ 4*q^2 → ∀ a : ℤ, Nat.Coprime a.natAbs q → ∀ e : ℝ, |e| ≤ 1/((q : ℝ)*Real.sqrt (N : ℝ)) → ‖S N ((a : ℝ)/(q : ℝ)+e)‖ ≤ (N : ℝ)^((3 : ℝ)/4+η)

plain_statement.zh: 在 q=p² 且 √N/2≤q≤√N 的所有标准有理逼近弧上，对每个既约分子无条件证明 N^(3/4+η) 的冯·曼戈尔特指数和界。
plain_statement.en: For prime-square denominators between √N/2 and √N, seek the unconditional N^(3/4+η) pointwise bound throughout every reduced rational arc.

brief.zh: 对标 Maynard–Pandey–Radziwiłł 定理 1.1 在此分母族的特例：去掉主导的 19/24 指数。#4193 已核验高次素数幂质量无需相位抵消即可处理。对素数贡献先沿模 p 分层，再利用模 p² 的加法相位对提升变量是线性的；完整主特征项因 μ(p²)=0 消失。一般分母与次弧带符号系数仍须另做。
brief.en: In this denominator family the 19/24 term of Theorem 1.1 dominates. Remove it without GRH. Reuse #4193 for the higher-prime-power contribution. Group the prime part by residues mod p and exploit the linear phase in the lift from p to p². The complete principal Gauss sum vanishes. General denominators remain open.

gaps.statement: let E (x : ℝ) := Complex.exp (((2 * Real.pi * x : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I); let cap (H : ℕ) (x : ℝ) := if E x = 1 then (H : ℝ) else min (H : ℝ) (2 / ‖1 - E x‖); ∀ (N D : ℕ) (a : ℕ → ℂ) (t : ℝ), ‖∑ d ∈ Finset.Icc 1 D, a d * ∑ k ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (N / d), E ((d : ℝ) * (k : ℝ) * t)‖ ≤ ∑ d ∈ Finset.Icc 1 D, ‖a d‖ * cap (N / d) ((d : ℝ) * t)

plain_statement.en: Type I bound with the product cutoff and resonant terms
plain_statement.zh: 保留乘积截断与共振项的一类和估计

brief.en: For each divisor length N / d use both the geometric-series bound and the number of terms.
brief.zh: 按 d 固定求和长度，同时使用几何级数界与项数界。

gaps.statement: let E (x : ℝ) := Complex.exp (((2 * Real.pi * x : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I); let cap (H : ℕ) (x : ℝ) := if E x = 1 then (H : ℝ) else min (H : ℝ) (2 / ‖1 - E x‖); ∀ (N M H : ℕ) (K : Finset ℕ) (a b : ℕ → ℂ) (t : ℝ), let I := Finset.Ico M (M+H); ‖∑ m ∈ I, a m * ∑ k ∈ K, (if m*k ≤ N then b k * E ((m : ℝ) * (k : ℝ) * t) else 0)‖ ^ 2 ≤ (∑ m ∈ I, ‖a m‖ ^ 2) * (∑ k ∈ K, ∑ l ∈ K, ‖b k‖ * ‖b l‖ * cap H (((k : ℝ) - (l : ℝ)) * t))

plain_statement.en: Type II bound in terms of frequency differences
plain_statement.zh: 由频率差控制的二类和估计

brief.en: Use Cauchy–Schwarz in the first factor. Two product cutoffs intersect in an initial segment of the row interval.
brief.zh: 对第一个因子用柯西不等式，两道乘积截断把行区间截成一个初始子段。

gaps.statement: let cut (h : ℕ) (f : ArithmeticFunction ℝ) : ArithmeticFunction ℝ := ⟨fun k => if k ≤ h then f k else 0, (ite_eq_left (Nat.zero_le h)).trans f.map_zero⟩; let L := ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt; let m : ArithmeticFunction ℝ := ArithmeticFunction.moebius; let z : ArithmeticFunction ℝ := ArithmeticFunction.zeta; ∀ U V : ℕ, let a := cut U m; let b := cut V L; L = b + a * ArithmeticFunction.log - a * b * z + (m-a) * ((L-b) * z)

plain_statement.en: Four-term Vaughan identity with independent cutoffs
plain_statement.zh: 两个独立截断下的四项沃恩恒等式

brief.en: Use Dirichlet convolution, Möbius inversion and the identity Λ * ζ = log.
brief.zh: 用狄利克雷卷积、莫比乌斯反演和 Λ * ζ = log 展开。

gaps.statement: let S := fun (N : ℕ) (x : ℝ) => ∑ m ∈ Finset.range N, ((ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt m : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.exp (((2*Real.pi*(m : ℝ)*x : ℝ) : ℂ)*Complex.I); ∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → ∃ N₀ : ℕ, ∀ N : ℕ, N₀ ≤ N → 2 ≤ N → ∀ a : ℕ → ℕ, (∀ q : ℕ, Nat.Prime q → a q < q ∧ Nat.Coprime (a q) q) → (∑ q ∈ (Finset.Icc 2 N.sqrt).filter (fun q => Nat.Prime q ∧ N ≤ 4*q^2), ‖S N ((a q : ℝ)/(q : ℝ))‖^2) ≤ (N : ℝ)^((23 : ℝ)/12+η)

plain_statement.zh: 对 √N/2≤q≤√N 的素分母，每个 q 任选最坏的既约分子，要求相应冯·曼戈尔特指数和的平方和至多为 N^(23/12+η)。
plain_statement.en: Allow an adversarial reduced numerator for each prime denominator between √N/2 and √N; bound the sum of squared Mangoldt sums at these selected rationals by N^(23/12+η).

brief.zh: 间距至少 1/N 的加法大筛给出 N^(2+o(1))，与目标相差 N^(1/12)。若新界成立，以 N^(3/4) 为阈值，坏素分母数至多 N^(5/12+η)，小于整个约 √N/log N 的分母族。此题保留最坏分子，但仅对精确有理点作模数平均；和逐点父题互补。#4193 的素数幂部分可按绝对值界去除，重点是素数权在选定分数上的平均消去。
brief.en: The additive large sieve for 1/N-separated reduced fractions yields N^(2+o(1)). Save N^(1/12). At threshold N^(3/4) this would leave at most N^(5/12+η) bad prime denominators, even after optimizing the numerator. Focus on the prime part after #4193 (its underlying √N log N estimate suffices). This is a mean estimate for exact rationals, separate from pointwise or perturbed arcs.

gaps.statement:
by
  classical
  let n := fun (p y : ℕ) => ∏ r ∈ (Finset.Icc 2 y).filter (fun r => Nat.Prime r ∧ r ≠ p), r
  let Q := fun N : ℕ => (Nat.log 2 (N+2))^2
  let mass := fun (N q : ℕ) =>
    let lo := (Q N : ℝ) / ((q:ℝ)*(N:ℝ))
    2 * intervalIntegral (fun t : ℝ => (Real.sin (Real.pi*((N:ℝ)+1)*t) / Real.sin (Real.pi*t))^2) lo (lo*(N:ℝ)^((1:ℝ)/6)) MeasureTheory.volume
  exact ∀ p : ℕ, Nat.Prime p → 3 ≤ p → ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∃ Y : ℕ, ∀ y : ℕ, Y ≤ y →
    let N := n p y
    let D := N.divisors.filter (fun d => Q N < p*d ∧ p*d ≤ 2*Q N)
    c*(N:ℝ) ≤ ∑ d ∈ D, ((d.totient:ℝ)/(((p*d).totient:ℝ)^2)) * mass N (p*d)

plain_statement.zh: 对剔除一个固定奇素数的素数连乘目标，在首个二倍分母段证明裙边模型负部至少为 cₚN。
plain_statement.en: For primorial targets omitting one fixed odd prime, show that the negative model mass in the first dyadic denominator band is at least cₚN.

brief.zh: 讨论 #3806 更正后尝试把负部单独压到 o(N)。本题检验其障碍：固定奇素数 p，N 为不含 p 的素数连乘，取 q=pd、d|N，则 q 平方自由且 c_q(N)=−φ(d)。在 Q<q≤2Q 时积分应包含一个远离零点、长度与 1/N 同阶的区间。另需证明该倍段内有正比例的平方自由、与 p 互素、素因子不超过 y 的 d。常数可依赖 p。若得证，仅排除丢弃正项的估计，原带符号下界仍开放。
brief.en: Discussion #3806 proposes discarding the positive model terms. At a primorial missing p take q=pd with d dividing N. Then q is squarefree and its Ramanujan sum at N is −φ(d). Bound the kernel mass below on a fixed interval scaled by 1/N and count y-smooth squarefree divisors in the moving dyadic window. Constants may depend on p. A proof rules out the negative-only estimate while leaving the signed floor open.

gaps.statement: let w := fun k : ℕ => if Nat.Prime k then Real.log (k:ℝ) else 0; let E := fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (((2*Real.pi*x:ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.I); let S := fun (n : ℕ) (u : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ℝ) => Finset.sum (Finset.range (n+1)) (fun k => (u k:ℂ)*E ((k:ℝ)*t)); let Q := fun n : ℕ => (Nat.log 2 (n+2))^2; let arcs := fun n : ℕ => {t : ℝ | ∃ q a : ℕ, 1≤q ∧ q≤Q n ∧ a≤q ∧ Nat.Coprime a q ∧ |t-(a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ)| ≤ (Q n:ℝ)/((q:ℝ)*(n:ℝ))}; let f := fun (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) => (S n w t)^2*E (-(n:ℝ)*t); let Q₁ := fun n : ℕ => ⌊(n:ℝ)^(1/3:ℝ)⌋₊; let H := fun n : ℕ => 256 * Q₁ n * Q n; let wideArcs := fun n : ℕ => {t : ℝ | ∃ q a : ℕ, 1≤q ∧ q≤Q₁ n ∧ a≤q ∧ Nat.Coprime a q ∧ |t-(a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ)| ≤ (H n:ℝ)/((q:ℝ)*(n:ℝ))}; let lowWideArcs := fun n : ℕ => {t : ℝ | ∃ q a : ℕ, 1≤q ∧ q≤Q n ∧ a≤q ∧ Nat.Coprime a q ∧ |t-(a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ)| ≤ (H n:ℝ)/((q:ℝ)*(n:ℝ))}; let lowPart := fun n : ℕ => lowWideArcs n \ arcs n; let remainder := fun n : ℕ => (wideArcs n \ arcs n) \ lowPart n; let inner := fun n : ℕ => {t : ℝ | ∃ q a : ℕ, 1≤q ∧ q≤Q₁ n ∧ a≤q ∧ Nat.Coprime a q ∧ |t-(a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ)| ≤ (Q n : ℝ) * (n : ℝ)^(1/6 : ℝ) / ((q:ℝ)*(n:ℝ))}; let J := fun (n : ℕ) (A : Set ℝ) => (intervalIntegral (fun t => A.indicator (f n) t) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume).re; let floor := fun (A : ℕ → Set ℝ) => ∀ e : ℝ, 0 < e → ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, N ≤ n → Even n → -(e * (n:ℝ)) ≤ J n (A n); floor (fun n => remainder n ∩ inner n)

plain_statement.zh: 剩余扩宽弧区的近有理部分具有无条件单侧下界。
plain_statement.en: Unconditional signed floor in the near-rational part of the widened remainder.

brief.zh: 用较短的相位范围，比较算术级数主项和积分余项。取交集时保留已剔除的低模数区域。
brief.en: Use the shorter phase range to approximate progression main terms and keep the low-modulus mask excluded.

gaps.statement: let w := fun k : ℕ => if Nat.Prime k then Real.log (k:ℝ) else 0; let E := fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (((2*Real.pi*x:ℝ):ℂ)*Complex.I); let S := fun (n : ℕ) (u : ℕ → ℝ) (t : ℝ) => Finset.sum (Finset.range (n+1)) (fun k => (u k:ℂ)*E ((k:ℝ)*t)); let Q := fun n : ℕ => (Nat.log 2 (n+2))^2; let arcs := fun n : ℕ => {t : ℝ | ∃ q a : ℕ, 1≤q ∧ q≤Q n ∧ a≤q ∧ Nat.Coprime a q ∧ |t-(a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ)| ≤ (Q n:ℝ)/((q:ℝ)*(n:ℝ))}; let f := fun (n : ℕ) (t : ℝ) => (S n w t)^2*E (-(n:ℝ)*t); let Q₁ := fun n : ℕ => ⌊(n:ℝ)^(1/3:ℝ)⌋₊; let H := fun n : ℕ => 256 * Q₁ n * Q n; let wideArcs := fun n : ℕ => {t : ℝ | ∃ q a : ℕ, 1≤q ∧ q≤Q₁ n ∧ a≤q ∧ Nat.Coprime a q ∧ |t-(a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ)| ≤ (H n:ℝ)/((q:ℝ)*(n:ℝ))}; let lowWideArcs := fun n : ℕ => {t : ℝ | ∃ q a : ℕ, 1≤q ∧ q≤Q n ∧ a≤q ∧ Nat.Coprime a q ∧ |t-(a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ)| ≤ (H n:ℝ)/((q:ℝ)*(n:ℝ))}; let lowPart := fun n : ℕ => lowWideArcs n \ arcs n; let remainder := fun n : ℕ => (wideArcs n \ arcs n) \ lowPart n; let inner := fun n : ℕ => {t : ℝ | ∃ q a : ℕ, 1≤q ∧ q≤Q₁ n ∧ a≤q ∧ Nat.Coprime a q ∧ |t-(a:ℝ)/(q:ℝ)| ≤ (Q n : ℝ) * (n : ℝ)^(1/6 : ℝ) / ((q:ℝ)*(n:ℝ))}; let J := fun (n : ℕ) (A : Set ℝ) => (intervalIntegral (fun t => A.indicator (f n) t) (0:ℝ) 1 MeasureTheory.volume).re; let floor := fun (A : ℕ → Set ℝ) => ∀ e : ℝ, 0 < e → ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, N ≤ n → Even n → -(e * (n:ℝ)) ≤ J n (A n); floor (fun n => remainder n \ inner n)

plain_statement.zh: 剩余扩宽弧区的远有理部分具有无条件单侧下界。
plain_statement.en: Unconditional signed floor in the far part of the widened remainder.

brief.zh: 尝试部分求和和振荡抵消。按集合去重，避免重复计入重叠弧。只要求控制负贡献。
brief.en: Try partial summation and oscillatory cancellation. Treat overlapping arcs as a union and bound only the negative contribution.

plain_statement.zh: 把低模数弧带、近有理区和远有理区的三个下界拼起来。
plain_statement.en: Combine the low-modulus, near and far signed estimates.

brief.zh: 证集合不交并覆盖，核对低模数扩宽弧最终包含在全部扩宽弧内。每部分分配 ε/3，并取共同阈值。
brief.en: Show disjoint coverage and eventual containment of the low-modulus widened arcs. Use ε/3 in each input and take the common threshold.

plain_statement.zh: 证明扩宽弧区去掉原主弧后的整个积分，实部无条件至少为 −εn。
plain_statement.en: Prove an unconditional −εn floor on the whole widened region outside the original major arcs.

brief.zh: 可用三个区域的下界拼合，也可直接估计总积分，保留区域间的抵消。后续还需控制扩宽弧外的深次弧。
brief.en: Combine the three regional floors or bound the union directly and retain cancellation across regions. The deep minor arcs still require a separate estimate.

title.zh: Theta 提升与素数反射
title.en: Theta lifts and prime reflection

description.zh: 固定测试向量，比较正负反射范数；核心缺口是同一归一化下的算术匹配与严格间隔。 建议从中心卷积一阶矩、上界筛或局部因子二阶均值开始；这些中间结果允许剩余例外。
description.en: Fix both test vectors and compare their norms with one normalization. Arithmetic matching and strict separation remain open. Start with the central first moment, the sieve envelope or the local second moment; these allow exceptional targets.

title.zh: 奇特征零点干涉
title.en: Odd-character zero interference

description.zh: 固定偶模数，保留相位、重数和原平均分母；目标是截断交叉项的逐点单侧裕量。
description.en: Keep phases, multiplicities and the original denominator. Seek a one-sided margin at each even modulus.

title.zh: 把素数对变成可估计的量
title.en: From prime pairs to a weighted sum

description.zh: 为傅里叶系数提取和换权误差提供有限卷积恒等式。
description.en: Finite convolution identities for coefficient extraction and changes of weight.

title.zh: 剔除真素数幂
title.en: Remove higher prime powers

description.zh: 将 Λ 卷积换回只含素数的卷积，并定量控制误差。
description.en: Convert the Mangoldt correlation to primes and bound the correction.

title.zh: 计算每个模数的局部障碍
title.en: Count admissible residue pairs

description.zh: 给奇异级数提供可证明的局部因子，从素模数推广到合数。
description.en: Supply local factors for the singular series, from primes through composite moduli.

title.zh: 给局部修正乘积建立下界
title.en: Lower-bound the local product

description.zh: 把有限局部计数归一化，控制乘积截断，以便估计主弧主项。
description.en: Normalize local counts and control truncated products for the major-arc main term.

title.zh: 建立有限傅里叶变换
title.en: Build the finite Fourier transform

description.zh: 在有限循环群上验证正交性、反演与能量公式，为检查圆法系数提供独立模型。
description.en: Use character orthogonality, inversion and energy on a finite cyclic group as an independent coefficient model.

title.zh: 提取圆法积分系数
title.en: Extract continuous Fourier coefficients

description.zh: 逐项验证单位圆、截断权和主次弧分割的积分操作。
description.en: Verify integration on the unit interval, truncated weights, and the partition into arcs.

title.zh: 从同余类到主弧指数和
title.en: From progressions to rational frequencies

description.zh: 先组织剩余类上的 Λ 质量，再通过分部求和传递误差。若采用 GRH，各结论保留该假设。
description.en: Organize Mangoldt mass by residue and transport errors by partial summation. Keep GRH explicit where used.

title.zh: 计算有理频率的主项
title.en: Evaluate rational main terms

description.zh: 从单位根和与几何核出发，建立主弧近似的可计算模型。
description.en: Combine unit-root sums with the geometric kernel to model the main arcs.

title.zh: 主弧下界与次弧抵消
title.en: Major-arc gain and minor-arc cancellation

description.zh: 两条攻关任务采用同一套弧宽、权和阈值定义。两项估计若都成立，可得到充分大偶数的结论，阈值以下仍需另证。
description.en: Both research targets use the same arcs and weights. Together they would cover sufficiently large evens. Values below the resulting threshold require a separate proof.

title.zh: 估计例外集合并识别平均界的局限
title.en: Control exceptional sets and track what averages imply

description.zh: 这些任务可给出几乎处处的结果。要排除最后一个例外，还需要逐点输入或把整数计数严格压到一以下。
description.en: These estimates can give almost-all results. Eliminating the last exception needs pointwise information or an exceptional count strictly below one.

title.zh: 临界带与反射零点
title.en: Strip geometry and reflected zeros

description.zh: 对照 prim_reflect 和 strip；把所需的零点条件写在前提中。
description.en: Trace prim_reflect and strip; keep the zero-location input explicit.

title.zh: 带重数的截断零点和
title.en: Truncated zero sums with multiplicity

description.zh: 以有限指标记录重数；从 LFunction_eq_zero_re 只取实部信息，再处理各块系数。
description.en: Index multiplicities separately; extract real parts from LFunction_eq_zero_re and estimate the coefficients.

title.zh: 从本原特征转回原模数
title.en: Euler-factor losses under change of modulus

description.zh: 从 prim_zero 的有限欧拉因子出发，区分单个因子的非消失、有限乘积的误差与总预算。
description.en: Follow prim_zero; separate nonvanishing, product stability and the total cost.

title.zh: 把剩余类的估计合并成频率估计
title.en: From residue-class errors to frequency bounds

description.zh: 借鉴 everyCharacter_of_row 逐块归并；保持模数、权函数与频率统一。
description.en: Use the block assembly in everyCharacter_of_row; keep the modulus, weight and frequency fixed.

title.zh: 把区间误差转成平滑权误差
title.en: Transfer interval bounds to smooth weights

description.zh: 先控制权的离散差分，再用已知的前缀和误差做分部求和。
description.en: Bound discrete variation before summation by parts against prefix discrepancies.

title.zh: 将单侧素数误差传给二元卷积
title.en: Propagate one-variable errors into binary convolution

description.zh: 固定同一个目标偶数；在有限反射卷积内展开两个输入，保留交叉项的符号。
description.en: Keep the target fixed, expand both inputs in the reflected convolution, and track the cross term.

title.zh: 从 GRH 分布估计到区间主项
title.en: GRH progression estimates on moving windows

description.zh: 先核对上游任意模数的零点命题，再从本项目 grh-progression-error 的单端点界推导；保留 GRH 前提。
description.en: Check the upstream all-moduli zero statement and derive from the project's grh-progression-error endpoint bound. Keep GRH explicit.

title.zh: 中央表示的支撑、重数和逐点缺口
title.en: Central support, multiplicity and pointwise gaps

description.zh: 在中央窗口做集合计数；将密度输入同真正的逐点配对输入分开。
description.en: Count candidates on the central window. Distinguish marginal density from a pointwise overlap bound.

title.zh: 从单变量主弧逼近到二元系数误差
title.en: Propagate major-arc approximation into the binary coefficient

description.zh: 沿用有理频率附近的 Λ 指数和估计，量化平方、积分和多个弧段累加的损失。最后仍须单独证明逐点次弧下界。
description.en: Start with the Mangoldt estimate near a rational frequency. Track the cost of squaring and integrating across arcs; pointwise minor-arc cancellation remains open.

title.zh: 为主弧模型建立模数系数表
title.en: Build the major-arc coefficient table

description.zh: 调用一般 Ramanujan 和，再核对 Möbius 值与单位类数；频率分子保持任意互素。
description.en: Apply the Ramanujan sum identity and certify the totient and Möbius coefficient.

title.zh: 次弧：先剔除立方根以下的素数
title.en: Minor arcs after removing small primes

description.zh: 保持原题的弧和频率；先用低段长度与 Parseval 控制低低、低高项，再单独攻高高项的有符号下界。
description.en: Keep the original arcs and frequency. Use the short support and Parseval on the small terms, then study the signed bulk.

title.zh: 前沿一：中弧 Siegel/Gallagher/BV 模数带子猜想
title.en: Frontier 1: Medium-arc Siegel, Gallagher, and BV modulus-band sub-conjectures

description.zh: 将主弧补集分为中弧核、中弧裙边与深次弧，无条件证明 Ramanujan-Fejér 模型非负性，并将中弧按模数尺度精细拆分为 Siegel 准多项式带、Gallagher 无对数零点密度带与 Bombieri-Vinogradov 越界带五个开放子猜想。
description.en: Partition minor arcs into medium core, skirt, and deep zones; prove unconditional Fejér model positivity; and split medium-arc approximation into 5 open sub-conjectures across Siegel, Gallagher, and BV modulus bands.

title.zh: 前沿二：深次弧 Vaughan 双线性 Type-II 十格点猜想矩阵
title.en: Frontier 2: Ten-cell dyadic Type-II × Type-II bilinear conjecture matrix

description.zh: 在深次弧上先无条件完成 L² Parseval 换权并消去所有初段与 Type-I 交叉项，将未知核心压缩为四段 Type-II 二分带交织出的十个双线性元胞，精准分离可攻克角格点与真正的奇偶性核心 (n^(1/3), n^(2/3)]。
description.en: Unconditionally swap to Λ and eliminate all Type-I terms on deep minor arcs, compressing the open core to 10 dyadic Type-II × Type-II cells that isolate the parity core (n^(1/3), n^(2/3)].

title.zh: 前沿三：四阶矩、3/4 幂 saving 与反尖峰平滑传递猜想
title.en: Frontier 3: Fourth-moment, 3/4 power-saving, and anti-spike transfer conjectures

description.zh: 深次弧四阶矩上界收到反证（#2508），暂停该题的正向领取，等待 Lean 对冻结声明的否定进行核验。3/4 逐点估计与二阶矩—反尖峰传递仍分别开放。
description.en: A refutation of the deep fourth-moment bound is under review (#2508). Positive claims on that task are paused pending kernel verification. The three-quarters estimate and second-moment/anti-spike transfer remain open.

title.zh: 前沿四：GRH 压缩等价链、无 Siegel 零点与 3/5-BV 水平
title.en: Frontier 4: GRH equivalence chain, no Siegel zeros, and 3/5-BV level

description.zh: 用 GRH 将中弧彻底消去并把深次弧的开放困难隔离出来，同时独立刻画排除 Siegel 零点、水平 3/5 的 Bombieri-Vinogradov 分布与扩展至 √n 尺度的次弧带等经典前沿猜想。
description.en: Use GRH to clear the medium zones and isolate deepMinor, while formalizing classic frontier conjectures on Siegel zeros, level-3/5 BV distribution, and √n-scale arcs.

title.zh: 前沿五：物理空间素数关联与 Ramanujan-sinc 核子猜想
title.en: Frontier 5: Spatial prime correlation and Ramanujan-sinc kernel sub-conjectures

description.zh: 完全脱离指数和平方估计，将次弧积分精确拆解为对角主项与低模近带、低模远带、高模带三个空间 Ramanujan-sinc 卷积和，提供纯物理空间攻关接口。
description.en: Bypass exponential-sum squaring by splitting the minor-arc integral into the diagonal prime-pair term minus three explicit spatial Ramanujan-sinc regimes.

title.en: Rational approximation and minor-arc sums
title.zh: 有理逼近与次弧指数和

description.en: Locate a reduced rational on each minor arc, bound a block of reciprocal chords near that rational, and turn a uniform exponential-sum estimate into a ternary coefficient bound.
description.zh: 为每个次弧点找到既约有理逼近，控制该逼近下一个分母长度区间上的倒弦长之和，并将指数和的一致估计转化为三元傅里叶系数的上界。

title.zh: 特征与分母扩窗
title.en: Characters and extended arcs

description.zh: 在有限特征和与实际弧带上核验例外项、模数扩窗和均方预算。
description.en: Compute exceptional character terms, arc extensions and mean-square budgets with the actual denominators and masks.

title.zh: 深次弧四次矩反驳
title.en: Deep fourth-moment refutation

description.zh: 用独立 ID 提交旧上界的严格否定。
description.en: Submit a proof of the exact negation of the retired upper bound under a distinct ID.

title.en: Quadratic Gauss sums and a 25-billion certificate
title.zh: 二次高斯和与二百五十亿验证

description.en: Evaluate the prime-modulus quadratic Gauss norm, exhibit the obstruction to a uniform conductor cutoff in the exceptional budget, and certify finite prime-log positivity.
description.zh: 计算素数模二次高斯和的范数，展示例外误差预算中统一导子阈值的障碍，并以有限证书验证素数对数卷积的正性。

title.zh: 二进反射与 Levent GRH 零点公式
title.en: Dyadic reflection and the Levent GRH explicit formula

description.zh: 固定一个偶数，按二进余类拆出反射相关，再用本原特征和与带重数的零点和替换细层。粗层预算、零点替换误差与真实零点相位是三项独立工作。
description.en: Fix the even target. Expand its reflected correlation by dyadic residue classes and use primitive character sums and zeros with multiplicity on fine layers. The coarse budget, the replacement error and the actual zero phases require separate estimates.

title.en: Effective cutoffs and the Goldbach endpoint
title.zh: 显式截断与哥德巴赫终点

description.en: Make the arc-disjointness cutoff numerical, join consecutive finite certificates, and connect finite positivity to major- and minor-arc bounds at a common threshold.
description.zh: 给出保证弧不相交的数值阈值，拼接连续区间的有限证书，并在同一阈值处衔接有限范围的正性与主弧、次弧估计。

title.en: Minor-arc moments and binary Goldbach exceptions
title.zh: 次弧矩与二元哥德巴赫例外数

description.en: Sum the squared Fourier coefficients of the masked prime square. A lower bound on each major coefficient and an upper bound on the minor-arc sum then bound the number of exceptions in a dyadic interval.
description.zh: 对指示函数截取的素数指数和平方，其傅里叶系数的模平方可求和估计。结合各主弧系数的下界与次弧指数和的上界，可控制倍增区间内的例外数。

title.zh: 无条件哥德巴赫例外集 4/7 界
title.en: An unconditional 4/7 Goldbach exceptional-set bound

description.zh: 在同一例外集口径下，把 Pintz–Althöfer 公开预印本的 7/12 指数降至 4/7。
description.en: Improve the exponent 7/12 in Pintz–Althöfer v1 to 4/7 on the same set without zero-free hypotheses.

title.en: Explicit major arcs and the ten-billion certificate
title.zh: 显式主弧估计与百亿验证

description.en: Give the modeled major arcs a numerical lower bound, bound their approximation error by discrepancies in arithmetic progressions, and certify prime-log positivity through ten billion.
description.zh: 给出主弧模型的数值下界，用等差数列的偏差控制逼近误差，并验证至一百亿的素数对数卷积正性。

title.zh: 裙边与显式算术输入
title.en: Skirts and explicit arithmetic inputs

description.zh: 隔离第四带自由变量、小分母裙边核及显式等差数列常数。
description.en: Isolate the free variable in band four, the small-modulus skirt kernel and explicit progression constants.

title.zh: 新路线 · Farey 分母对与逆元筛
title.en: New route · Farey denominator pairs and the inverse sieve

description.zh: 在同一个偶数的 Farey 插入层上给中心窗分母加上逆元标记。比较全窗 CRT 和分窗模双曲线计数，再按最小素因子计算筛损失。
description.en: Label the central denominator pairs on a single Farey insertion layer by their inverses. Compare full-window CRT counts with modular hyperbola counts in subwindows, then group sieve losses by the least prime factor.

title.en: Finite verification, ternary representations, and exceptions
title.zh: 有限验证、三元素数表示与例外集

description.en: Verify binary Goldbach through one million, turn a ternary major-arc lower bound into a representation, and pass from dyadic exception counts to a cumulative bound.
description.zh: 验证一百万以内的二元哥德巴赫命题，将三元主弧下界转化为素数表示，并由倍增区间内的例外数推出累积上界。

title.zh: 小偶数覆盖续批
title.en: Finite-range coverage II

description.zh: 在计算边界外核验真素数对，提升粗数轮模，并精确计数陈氏候选中的平方余项。
description.en: Verify prime pairs above the computation boundary, lift the rough-number wheel and count square remainders among Chen candidates.

title.zh: 小偶数覆盖第三批
title.en: Finite-range coverage III

description.zh: 核验已发表端点以后的素数对，推进固定主弧的误差和余量，并改进有限范围的素因子数与陈氏计数界。
description.en: Verify further prime pairs above the published cutoff, bound errors on fixed major arcs and improve the finite-range factor and Chen count estimates.

title.en: Farey spacing and the analytic large sieve
title.zh: 法里分数间距与解析大筛

description.en: Bound the total squared size of a trigonometric sum sampled at reduced fractions with denominator at most Q. The estimate is uniform in the starting frequency.
description.zh: 估计三角和在分母不超过 Q 的既约分数处的模平方总和。该估计对起始频率一致成立。

title.zh: Liouville 相关的整除膨胀
title.en: Dilation of Liouville correlations

description.zh: 对固定目标量化素因子整除条件下的二元 Liouville 相关。一般偶数的符号和与真素数对的联系仍开放。
description.en: Quantify two-point Liouville correlation under prime divisibility at a fixed target. Its sign for general even targets and its relation to prime pairs remain open.

title.en: The major-arc model
title.zh: 主弧模型

description.en: Identify the reduced-frequency Ramanujan factor, control the prime sum near a rational center by progression discrepancies, and give an explicit floor for the truncated kernel integral.
description.zh: 确定既约频率处的拉马努金因子，以等差数列上的偏差估计有理中心附近的素数指数和，并给出截断核积分的显式下界。

title.zh: 在固定偶数上区分素数与三因子补数
title.en: Distinguish primes from triple products at a fixed even target

description.zh: 在同一粗筛候选集上估计三因子项数和反射的刘维尔函数和，以恢复中央素数对的下界。
description.en: Control triple products and the reflected Liouville sum on the same sifted support to recover central prime pairs.

title.en: Sharp large sieve and power-saving minor arcs
title.zh: 尖锐大筛不等式与次弧幂次节省

description.en: Control exponential sums at separated points and on minor arcs. Relate a stronger uniform circle-model estimate to the cumulative number of binary Goldbach exceptions.
description.zh: 控制分离点上的指数和及次弧素数指数和，并将更强的全圆模型误差估计转化为二元哥德巴赫例外的累积计数界。

title.zh: 有符号因子与移位窗
title.en: Signed factors and shift windows

description.zh: 展开真实双线性权，比较冻结深弧遮罩上的偶移平均与指定系数。
description.en: Unfold the arithmetic bilinear weights and compare even-shift averages with the prescribed coefficient under a fixed deep-arc mask.

title.zh: Type-II 二进角胞的结构输入
title.en: Structural inputs for the Type-II dyadic corner cell

description.zh: 把 Type-II 角胞 (1,1) 的深次弧积分拆成三块可独立验证的结构输入：宽弧带的闭性、Fejér 核的平方展开，以及 Möbius 截断恒等式。
description.en: Split the deep-minor integral of the Type-II corner cell (1,1) into three independently checkable inputs: closedness of the wide-arc band, the Fejér square expansion, and the truncated Möbius identity.

title.en: Unconditional circle-method milestones
title.zh: 圆法的无条件里程碑

description.en: Logarithmic savings for prime exponential sums give ternary representations and bound the number of binary exceptions.
description.zh: 素数指数和的对数节省给出三素数表示，并控制二元哥德巴赫例外的个数。

title.en: Vaughan’s identity and bilinear exponential sums
title.zh: 沃恩恒等式与双线性指数和

description.en: Retain product cutoffs and frequency spacing in the Type I and Type II sums that enter the minor-arc coefficient.
description.zh: 在次弧系数的一类和二类指数和中保留乘积截断与频率间距。

title.zh: 扩宽弧区的无条件积分下界
title.en: Unconditional signed bounds on widened arcs

description.zh: 保留已证低模数弧带，按距有理数的尺度拆分其余扩宽弧区，控制总积分中的负贡献。
description.en: Reuse the proved low-modulus skirt and split the remaining widened arcs by distance to rational points.
